After class we often had online discussion forums; she required you to reply to other student's discussions. I would be confident for exams, then it went out the window at the first Q.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Idky she is not rated well. I had zero issues in class with Erin, everything is straight forward and I felt that I not only learned while in class but retained information too. Also, it's a level 100 class it's not hard, just do your homework and study for tests and you will 4.0 it easily. Do not be worried for this class!! :)

Had her for CSS101L in-person and it was quite a straightforward experience. Weekly quizzes, a couple of lab reports, and that was pretty much it. If you paid attention to the lectures you would be pretty set for a decent grade. She even tells you what will be on the quizzes.

I took CSS101L online and had a relatively good experience. Weekly assignments were doable, and graded fairly. Not too much work/content compared to other labs. I would recommend taking this class online vs in person, I had a good experience while those that took it in person weren't as positive. Saves a lot of time too.

This class was horrible. She would give guided notes with material not covered in the lectures making it impossible to fill out. Everything in this class was a guessing game, and good luck emailing her if you have a question. Exams were absurdly difficult, even being open notes the notes did not cover the material on the exams. I would avoid.

Some information was not accurate on lectures. Tests are extremely hard, and some information was NOT covered in lecturers. She never responded to my emails when I had questions, so shes very hard to reach and leaves you on your own for this class. Definitely harder than any other 101 class Ive taken.

Overall, the lectures were old and the information on the study guides didn't always match. On the exams almost every question was a trick question. It was also hard to contact Professor Bosch by email.

Erin was flat trash. She made her exams ridiculously hard. On most exams I thought I did quite well then hit submit and get slapped with a 60. Her lectures are recordings of her talking that are about five years old. At times she seems like she has no idea what she is talking about. Too bad this class was mandatory, or I would've dropped. No Bueno

She's the worst professor I've ever had. Her exams are all trick questions. She does give study guides but that are never material on the exam. It's like she wants you to do bad. I would never recommend her to anyone.

While he is fun to talk to, there is a heavy workload of things to read before majority of the classes, such as 8 chapters of a book. He also is very strict about talking about class related stuff during group work, felt like I was in high school again. PARTICIPATION is a big deal, and be prepared to read lots of articles

Professor is very talkative and can get super annoying. Very long lectures and talking with no break. He just runs his mouth about the information and none of it sticks because his voice is super annoying. Attendance is mandatory and you can't sign your friends in. Would never take this class or professor if you paid me.

Everyone complaining about reading and writing in this class is just... It's completely doable. The articles and books weren't hard to comprehend, especially considering we discuss the key themes in class before and after we read them. Disliking Dr. Bellon for wanting his students to be actually engaged in class is an interesting take for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: very hard not to do well in this course even if the topics aren't really interesting to you. it can sometimes feel disorganized but not in a way that will make it difficult to finish work. lectures can get wordy and hard to follow but i enjoyed this class nonetheless. Deadlines and expectations are made very clear, overall very easy.

absolutely brutal class. lectures and recitations were a complete waste of time and all of the work is done outside of class. he assigns hours of reading per week on top of a whole bunch of other stuff. the most time consuming class you will ever take at msu. do not take iah 206

Every class period I sat on my phone after doing his pointless work hoping a car would crash into the building or the fire alarm would go off hoping that just maybe we would be able to leave early. This is the most time consuming class for how unimportant it is. Genuinely makes you feel stupid paying tuition for a class like this
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: You know when someone talks forever even though it could've been said in one sentence? His entire lecture is like that. And it's not even really a lecture. he just divides people into groups to work on a Google document. He yaps for the first ten minutes, then spends the rest of the time wandering around the classroom. Good exercise for him!

This professor was pretty great and you can tell he cares a lot about students actually learning. He is pretty lecture heavy and attendance is required but there is always opportunities to make up assignments / extenstions or make up attendance points missed.

waste of time. long lectures and makes you stay the entire time for attendance. yaps the entire class about useless stuff. doesn't actually teach anything besides how using ai is bad for your brain. dreadful and boring to sit through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!! Take any other iah there is, if this is the only one open, there's a reason why. He talks so much, and he is very boring. There is so much work compared to every other IAH class. Listen to me, do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: do not take this class he just yaps the entire time and the work is pointless. make friends because you need a group to work with every class. 4 essays which are annoying but not that hard. mandatory attendance and two hour long podcasts every week. don't take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: everyday i walked to class i wish i got hit by a bus. do not take this class. the only good thing is that i made friends that i could talk to everyday. so much unnecessary  work that takes forever if you actually do it. a total of four essays that are many pages long. easy class but takes too much time for it being mandatory. take any other iah.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were pointless made us read 2 books that were a waste of time. Weekly notebook entries on 3 plus readings a week. Not a super hard class just a lot of busy work for a class that has nothing to do with really any major. Wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: While this class isn't hard, you should only take it if you love writing and want to submit an entry every week. Attendance is mandatory and you will work in groups every day. He spends a large majority of the class yapping and doesn't really "teach" you anything. I've gotten nothing out of this class. It's a bunch of work and reading for hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Holy yapper of yappers. He makes you stay the whole class time even when everyone seems to be done. He will talk about random subjects to keep you there longer. Every class you need to fill out a paper about an episode guide that itself takes 40 minutes. At the end there is always a group writing assignment. Absolutely horrible to sit through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice enough guy, but the class is extremely droning and repetitive. Likes to talk about personal issues in the world. Nearly every lecture there's a paper and the recitations seem very thrown together and unstructured.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Bellon is nice, but he tends to go off topic during his lectures. If you want to take a class about the dangers of AI, this is the perfect class for you! If not, then I would steer clear. You get 5 skips total, and there is a LOT of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor was nice but the class was a lot of work. It was constant reading and writing/reflecting. Also participation matters in the class and counts towards your grade.

Doctor Bellon was amazing! His enthusiasm about what he teaches in class is inspiring.He gives weekly announcements on D2L of everything that is due that week. He wants his students to succeed and takes his time to proof read and revise our essays. I can say out of all the teachers I had he wants to help because he has a passion for what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Y'all hating just because it was a lot of work, I loved his class. I feel like a learned a lot, the papers were fun for the most part, and his mini-lectures before the group work were consistently appealing. He taught me more about writing than WRA 101 ever did. 

At the very least, this was good weight training for the rest of college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I have a love-hate relationship with this class. She is a great teacher and is good at explaining things, but her exams are very difficult and almost impossible to study for. You will need a hope and a prayer for her exams. They are long and hard to finish in the time allotted.

Exams are nothing like the mock exams or any study material. Even if you fully understand material, exam questions are completely unpredictable, not enough time on exams as well, 4 full pages with only 50 minutes, 5 exams, weighted very heavily, any other chem professor is better

She teaches poorly and does not prepare you for her exams. She gives you more questions than Dr. Barnard or Dr. Laduca and 20 less minutes to do them. Many people run out of time or rush. She weights tests heavier and provides no extra credit unlike the other professors. Take any other chem professor for a easier time and better understanding.
Just take Dr. Laduca instead and save yourself the annoyance.
Incredibly hard class, is super mean a about a lot of things. Seems like she deliberately tries to make people fail on purpose.

The method of teaching was a lot of doing all the learning outside of class then coming to class to do practice. Her method of teaching just did not click with me as a student who needs in-depth explanations for difficult topics. Not a super hard class but if you want in-depth explanations I would recommend trying a different professor.

I had her class when jamboard was used. Course was flip model, so we worked on materials during class and learned the stuff at home. It was lots of team involvement so pray you have a good team. Most of her exams was very hard since she was picky with the answers. She is seriously one of the harder prof for first years taking intro to chem.

I had Dr. Cass for both chem 2 and my senior seminar, and she is such a warm and caring professor. Her grading criteria is very clear and she is willing to make exceptions when necessary. She encourages thoughtful conversation and engagement with course content and going to her class was always pleasant.

Dr. Cass really wants her students to succeed and if you put in the work, you will be able to 4.0.  Exams can be hard but there is enough extra points with HW and other assignments to cushion your grade. She has really good lectures and explains things well! Very helpful outside of class as well.

The exams this semester were insanely difficult and always had questions we never saw in class or on the mock exam. But there were retake opportunities to bring your grade up which I really appreciated. Got mad at class when everyone did bad on a question instead of realizing that the reason we did bad was because we never saw a question like that.

Exam heavy, lectures are mandatory. Some of the exams were super tough and included material that was briefly covered. There are far easier professors in the Briggs program that offer tons of extra credit and aren't nearly as exam heavy. If you aren't a good test taker don't take this course!

I had LB 171 with her as well and I don't know what changed but class genuinely class began to feel hostile, I know she had personal issues but I do not believe that is grounds for yelling at a class who got low grades (consistently low grades is a teaching problem not a learning problem). Take LaDuca if you can (he guest lectured a few times).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't get me wrong, Cass is not a bad professor at all. She has years of experience in chemistry, however exams can be something else. If you haven't taken AP Chemistry in high school , I would try to take CEM 141/142, which is the natsci sequence. Taking LB chem it is implied that you have a very good understanding of chemistry from high school.
Dr. Cass is the best professor at Lyman Briggs. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Her lectures are actually helpful and her teaching style is top tier. Highly recommend.

Even though the content may be hard, 3.5/4.0 is easily attainable if you put the work in. I will forever preach Dr. Cass's name--she is the best prof in all of Briggs. Take her for any class possible. Her lectures are engaging, she teaches you well, and she is an amazing person. No hesitation, choose this prof.

She is a hard grader on exams, and even though she says that it's based on the work you do, not the answer, she's most definitely lying. I've lost a ton of points because I got a first question wrong, and the subsequent questions were based on it so I got zeros for those, even with the right process. You can do it, but good luck.

Dr. Cass is a great professor who really cares about her students. The course is team-based, so your experience depends a lot on your group. Take advantage of her office hours - they're super helpful. Unstuckstudy was a lifesaver for exam prep.

Although Dr. Cass wasn't the right professor for me, she did everything she could to help the people in class that needed it. She always recorded her lectures and posted them. The exams were heavy, but Dr. Cass always had plenty of prep material posted so you could prepare as much as you needed

This woman made me rethink if I am worthy of an education. She acted so biased towards the men in my class and I truly had no problem with it until she used my womanhood to undermine not only me but also my education. I never expected this from a university professor, nonetheless a woman in this day and age. Frankly disappointed and flabbergasted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is a hard grader and tests are tough, but don't be scared! She is AMAZING. You will not be confused and if you are, she is extremely accessible and will do everything to help. Homework is pretty light (there's not a lot; it's mostly completion grades) and it's never just busy work. Every time I thought I wasn't going to be prepared, I was wrong
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class is very easy and almost impossible to do badly if you just show up. The projects are straightforward, and the instructions are very clear, and gives you a ton of time to complete. Also very understanding and easy to reach.
I was not expecting to enjoy this class and it ended up being one of my favorites! She makes the classes super entertaining and sets you up for success.

I loved having her as a teacher! She made class fun and often moved it online so we could just work on our projects. She is very helpful and gives good feedback. The class is way too long time-wise, so be prepared for that. I got a 100 percent in this class with minimal effort, and she complimented my writing each time.
the best professor ever. made everyday feel like an adventure and i would take her class again.

There is only 5 projects you need to do for this class, very nice and caring lady. Made class fun and got the class engaged a lot. Class didn't feel like 2 hours when everyone was engaged and discussions were flowing.

gets into disagreements with students and it makes the entire class feel awkward. does not seem qualified for the job and we got lectured for 2 ish hours every class over things that aren't relevant which made class feel very optional to attend. it took over a month for her to grade our essays while we had 2 more projects to turn in in that time.

Class time felt wasted on things that had nothing to do with what we are learning. I learned absolutely nothing. Is snappy with students who dont attend class regularly, also gets into arguments with students. Grading was EXTREMELY slow. I turned in my essay like a month ago, have already turned in another one, and the first one still isn't graded.
Very sweet lady made the class very easy and fun

Professor Daugherty was my favorite professor all of fall semester. She is super nice and a really easy grader. Honestly if you just do the work on time like peer reviewing papers and having drafts submitted on time, you'll get a 4.0 in the class. She's also super understanding. Overall amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Daugherty is very kind and wants everyone to succeed. In class participation is expected. Essays have clear grading criteria and are relatively easy. Would take again 10/10.
She was very easy going. Not hard at all. Definitely put effort into the class but so easy to pass
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Fun prof who cares about what he is teaching. Weekly homework and reading are posted, and the schedule stays the exact same throughout the entire semester. Can get hard/tedious with frequent hws, projects, and quizzes, but he's willing to extend deadlines/work with students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He designed the course so he understands the material the best and dumbed it down so anyone can learn. Just like anything you need to put in the work.

Overall, Dr. Mason is a good professor. The amount of time given for the projects wasn't ideal, but it seems like Mason is adjusting the course to account for this. The lectures covered a lot of the same stuff from the textbook, which was a little strange. The homework was fair and the grading comments were always helpful in understanding mistakes.

Dr. Mason was an all-around great professor. The homework and design projects were a bit of a workload, but he gave you all of the material needed to excel in this course. While some people didn't find the required online textbook helpful, I believed that it was a great resource to have before starting a new chapter each week.

HWs were graded by a few things. Sometimes the structure of his courses can be confusing. He is highly caring and the HWs are super well built to enhance your reading. He is a tough grader and his exams are very challenging, however, you build very good study habits from his classes as his structures promotes that. I'd also say he is inspirational.

Your grade truly depends on how much you try. If you show up, learn the content, and study, you will do just fine. He doesn't deal with BS and if you never show up to class, don't expect much help from him (rightfully so). His classes are clearly laid out and lots of content is available. It's actually pretty hard to fail 230 unless you're lazy.

He was ok I guess. He was replacement professor for this class. However, he's stricter and give us even more homework compared to the previous one. This was supposed to be a easy class, and he could make this fun and easy but sadly he wouldn't. There's way too much hw at the end of semester and his lectures are plain as he just goes through slides.

Unfortunately, this is the only option as a professor for ITM. Wants to see students fail. Got upset because the beginning average for the first project was around a 90 and then went out of his way to continually make the class harder. However all of the assignments weekly were pretty easy.

The class was entirely taught by TAs, the professor never taught one class. Very poor structure, you need a 92% to 4.0. I would not recommend taking this was the worst class I've ever taken at Michigan State.

Easily the most defunct class I have ever been apart of. This class is taught entirely by TA's who are nice but most of the time unhelpful. The course structure was completely changed by removing a project and replacing it with an in-person exam, which is completely different than what has been used all semester.

Professor Dixon probably ran the worst class of all time. Majority of the time I have no idea what is due, the content makes me wanna sit court side at a WNBA game, and I dont even think the syllabus is updated for this class. 10/10 do not recommend. If you have to take this class, I am sincerely sorry from the bottom of my heart.

This class is so unstructured and makes no sense. I have had to go into the help room two times and remind the TA's to post the work for the week. Many times I have went in there and they did not even know we had an exam the next day. Also, don't expect fast reponces on emails. Worst class I have taken at MSU.

This professor makes the class way harder than it needs to be. The class/project directions are very un-clear and projects aren't able to be done without a TA. Glad this is my last semester with this teacher.

While Dixon isn't necessarily active in her class, you can tell she changed things up this year compared to the last few years of this class. I truly want to say I am learning a lot about Excel in this class, and I like the format. While it is a big disorganized and could definitely use some tweaking, overall this class has improved.
Very flexible and accommodating. There's a lot of work but It's easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really sorry for your loss Teagan.

Class is taught by college kids. You don't learn anything and assignments are so hard to find. The material that we're supposed to learn is important but the method they use for teaching is easily the worst.

Easily the worst instructor out of any of the Broad core classes. Course is terribly formatted, especially the final exam, which quizzes you on highly specific things about Tableau instead of just allowing you to create something using the platform which is what the rest of the unit was about. Thankfully the coursework is fairly easy

The TA's SUCKED. Almost no learning happened during the recitations.  There was also a huge disconnect between the online lectures, the recitations, and the homework assignments. The course was organized poorly too.

This is the most unorganized class I've had the displeasure of taking, which sucks, as this is a required class for Broad. I wouldn't call the content overly difficult, but the class is entirely run by TAs (you will NEVER see Teagan) so if they don't know how to answer your question (good chance they don't) you're screwed. Needs major restructuring

Horrible class. Teagan is an awful professor and has organized the whole curriculum so poorly. The TAs are just as bad if not worse. Never knew how to answer any question I had and were just focused on getting out class as fast as possible, and were overall just extremely unprofessional. MSU needs to get rid of this course or replace Teagan and TAs

Never met Dixon all semester, but it didn't ever matter. TAs were outstanding. The work could not be easier, easiest 4.0 ever. Not a lot of homework. If you have half a braincell you will be just fine. Everything is online and easily accessible. Grading is super slow and Dixon uses AI for literally everything, like lessons and grading

Course needs to be removed or Teagan needs to be replaced. Very unorganized course but she never shows up. All TA led and they didn't know when our exams were. So many different platforms to use and tests do not match what homework is.

This course is so unorganized. There's so much work that is unrelated to the course and the exams. For instance, BOL, lecture videos, and knowledge checks. Also, the grading is really slow, and every week you have to show up to class just for attendance, then you're good to go. Overall, MSU has to either cancel this course or replace Teagan.

This class isn't very difficult, but the way it is run is horrible. Teagan never shows up, and she is a very slow grader. I am a week out of the course, and I have only been graded on half of the assignments, and some of the group projects that were done in module 2 are somehow not graded. The excessive homework is worth little in your final grade

Throughout the class, she would say she "leveraged AI" to create the videos, which is probably the dumbest thing I've ever heard. She might as well have said, "I'm too lazy to do my job, so I make AI robots do it for me." At least then I would have a little respect for her honesty. I would rather dig forks in my eyes than take this class again.
This class is a complete waste of time.

You never actually interact with Tegan in this class and instead you are up to the mercy of having good TAs (Shoutout Neel and Vivian). Even then, the class is simple enough where you can learn most of it on your own anyway. Genuinely one of the easiest classes I've taken in Broad and is actually relevant to what you might do in your career.

Lecture videos are extremely vague and taught as if you already know what is going on. TAs simply do not care and just want to get out of class as fast as possible. The course does not follow a specific timeline; it jumps around and can be very confusing.

This class needs to seriously be looked at by Broad if they are making it a required class. We are in Module 2 and I still have no idea what is ever happening in the class. The TA's don't know anything and make things more confusing than before. They flip through slides as fast as possible and there is no teaching at all that goes into the class.

The complete lack of effort put into this class  is astonishing. Reading a lazy, and meaningless AI-constructed powerpoint was not only demoralizing for the price I pay to go to this college, but also embarrassing for the professor.

The Lecture to accompany it was two AI voices glazing each other for an hour straight.

SIMnet is expensive too.

TAs lead class in person and you will watch videos outside of class to teach you the material. My TA, Patrick, was the goat so the class was pretty fun for me. Exams aren't too difficult if you do the practice exams and pay attention to the demos. Definitely take advantage of every extra credit opportunity that you get throughout the semester.

The teaching quality was disappointing. Lectures relied too heavily on videos instead of interactive instruction, and the practice exams did not reflect the actual exam content at all. We were also required to pay for an external platform that we only ended up using for four weeks, which felt like a waste of money. TA did the bare minimum.

The TA's know nothing and can barely ever answer questions. You never see the professor. Unorganized D2L page and uses a flipped model so you basically learn everything yourself. Exams are different from what you do in class and group projects suck. Bad class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Needs to choose better TAs for the class, and the flipped model is AWFUL. The in-class demos aren't well thought out & not taught even remotely well. Expect to either learn it all on your own, or rely on groupmates for help. Also the switch to an AI platform (that you have to pay for!) to do the one project not graded by their TAs is...interesting.

Horrible class. You will never see her, the TAs teach the class. One TA I had was good and the other barely knew how to open Excel or SQL. The material is not that difficult to understand but you have to teach yourself everything. She is more worried about sending out articles about sexism in data analytics than teaching the class.

Had to buy a $70 platform to use for 4 weeks. Too lazy to teach so uses flipped classroom, TAs suck. Might as well just put it online and save everyone some time. Easy class, but EASILY one of my least favorite professors here. The only thing she does is post on d2l, but the class page is the worst ive seen. Not sure what she actually does...

This is a poor professor, she has a flipped classroom, the videos are uninformative and are rather difficult to follow as well. The TA's are inadequate too. I wish MSU would put somebody in administration for these "flipped" roles instead since there is no teaching involved. An Arby's or perhaps a McDonald's manager might have enough experience.

I have never seen her in class because it is a "flipped classroom" where the TAs (who aren't knowledgeable) do the teaching. I chalk that up to laziness, she doesn't even have videos for us to watch, just a very expensive online textbook. I wish MSU would do something about this, I will gain nothing from this class because she doesn't want to help.

Not a well set up class in my opinion. One of the most useful classes in Broad, but horribly executed. Everything is ran by TA's, who are mediocre teachers at best. This class structure feels like there was no effort or thought put in. I'd recommend finding an alternative institution to fill this credit.

ITM209 is not that difficult of a class. It does take a little bit of a time commitment, but overall I didn't find it to be as difficult as everyone says. The hardest unit is SQL. There is only homework for the Excel unit. The group projects are ok they are easy if you have a good group. Overall not as hard as I expected.

This is one of the worst courses I have taken due to the extremely poor organization and set up of the class. It is a flipped lecture which means your TA's explain almost nothing to you and put no effort, as well as assignments 4/7 days of the week, all in different places. It is a shame because the information is useful but terribly executed.

It's similar to CSE where she shows up for 3 minutes on the first day and then you never see her again. Everything after the first unit is learned through long, boring lecture videos. She made us pay a lot for simnet just to only use it for the first unit. The D2L announcements which are the only communication we get are very passive aggressive.
Never once saw her in person. Made super long videos we were supposed to watch that were super boring and hard to follow. Only class I haven't 4.0 in at MSU.

...so...

I honestly felt completely overwhelmed and drained by the first day. I understand and expect that summer classes are quicker/condensed, but it felt that no class material was even cut out to adjust for the shorter summertime. Good professor, decent class, terrible approach. Just doesn't seem to consider students summer schedules.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: You basically have to teach yourself everything, the TA's are nice and helpful but Dixon is basically a non-existent factor. Video lectures are a waste of time. There are group projects and exams for 3 units, you learn excel, sql, and tableau, and it is all boring, but not hard to get a decent grade if you do assignments. Overall this class sucks.

I didn't mind Teagan but the class was organized so poorly. It's a flipped classroom, and I rarely even watched her videos. I learned everything from my TAs. The content itself isn't too difficult if you pay attention, but the weekly quizzes and exams are taken on a lockdown browser (but you do get a notecard). Offers extra credit for participation

This class is taught basically all by TAs. She puts content and lectures online, but most of your learning will come from what you learn in-person from your TAs. Probably out of her control, but I'm just not a fan of this system.

This class/professor isn't enjoyable at all. The lectures are all online with a weekly lockdown knowledge check. The professor is extremely boring to listen to, which makes it difficult to retain the information. 2 Midterms and a cumulative final. Paid for a required book and only used if for one unit. They need to restructure this class.

This class seriously makes me wonder about the thought process behind their decisions of this course. Same thing as CSE 102, watch the extremely long and numerous lectures before class and hope that your TA's are helpful. In-class activities are useless, 3 group projects,3 exams, and lockdown quiz weekly. Please restructure this class.
Takes forever to grade everything. Waited about 6 weeks to get some grades back. Also the online lectures are really stupid on how they organize them and make the quizzes every week.

Professor Dixon is amazing and very helpful if you utilize the help rooms and office hours. Ta's are also a blessing in this class, and they are always down to help before and after class. If you watch all of the lectures and read the project instructions carefully, then you'll do well in the class. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dixon was accessible outside of class which is nice. TAs do the teaching, so if they're bad you're screwed. To do good you have to be a genius or watch every lecture video. An important course and definitely helped. So many projects and the end of the semester was thrown together with 2 projects and 2 quizzes due the Friday before finals week.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is disorganized and unclear. In-class sessions are more than useless. Tried to ADR 10% of the class because they forgot they taught us how to use =count() functions & refused to apologize. Avoid if you can, keep your head down if you can't. Don't expect a lot.
Very helpful class in terms of content. SQL unit is incredibly difficult. The flipped classroom format is frustrating and would be nice if it were different.

The worst class I've ever taken. Professors do not come to class and only upload uselessly long videos. The projects are difficult, especially the group projects are terrible, even though she doesn't teach a properly. If you have another professor's class, you should definitely take it! I never wanna take her class again.

Highly disorganized class. Students are expected to watch long mundane lectures and complete projects and exams with no practice of course material. TAs run the class. Practice exams do not relate to exam content.

Worst class I have ever taken. The professor tells you watch the most mundane lectures ever and it is the only thing you are tested on. The classes are absolutely pointless (you learn nothing). Overall, horrible structure.
Teagon doesn't do anything for this class the lectures don't teach you anything, but it is a required class for broad so good luck!
It is very poorly laid out, you will have three projects due on the same day. Taught by TA's, professor just makes really boring and lengthy lecture videos.
Never met professor class is taught by TA's that have no clue what is going on.

Worst class ever. She does not teach the class at all and gives long lecture videos where only very small portions of them are relevant. The TAs try their best but ultimately this is a self-taught class. Threatened about 15% of the students in the class with an ADR on the final project and then takes it back because she was wrong.

Teagan teaches asynchronously which doesn't really help when wanting to ask in person classes. TA's barely know what they are talking about during class periods. Class is very test/quiz/project heavy and have to watch long boring lecture videos. Excel is the only useful thing you learn!

The first lecture video caught me off guard.. lady with a deep voice. The TAs basically run the class and they barely know how to answer your questions. It was pretty much self-taught, but I did all of the work and was able to get a 4.0. There was a help room for projects, and Teagan usually gave practice exams which were similar to the real one.

online lectures are hard to follow because she goes on so many unnnessesary rants. The class final grade was a 70. A 70!!!! I am a junior and I have never seen an exam average that low. she then proceeds to take weeks to grade a project and threatens everyone with ADRS. My stress level has never been so high than when im in Teagans class.

Teagan responds pretty quickly via email and the ULAs office hours help a lot. The lecture videos werent bad as long as you watch at 1.5x. The assignments/projects weren't difficult but read the instructions carefully. She also gives out practice exams that are just like the real thing. Overall, as long as you do the work, you'll get at least a 3.5
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Teagan is a very nice, helpful professor. She went above and beyond to make sure I was able to understand the code and platform so I could do my project successfully. ITM is not a fun class but it is very necessary for the business world and Teagan is a great leader for it.
I dont get taught at all in this class. TAs just assign you classwork and are expected to understand with nothing but a video posted lecture that makes no sense

The material in this class isn't hard, so don't take this rating as a rating of ITM. Sure, availability outside of class exists, and there is knowledge on the subject here. But D2L was organized so poorly, and the TAs for my section were often confused by demo instructions. It was just an unnecessarily stressful class because of the way it was run.

Homework assignments are easy. For the individual projects, the instructions are not clear and the TA's aren't super helpful for them either. If you show up to class, you get extra credit most of the time. Group project was very easy. The TA's run the class. You don't need to watch the lectures either, just skim for tests & quizzes.

ITM209 is taught by 2 TAs and lecture videos from the professor. The class felt very unorganized and I always felt lost but it is possible to do good. I 4.0. Study practice exam materials and go to helproom / set up zoom calls if you have questions on projects. There is a lot of points available in this class. You got it!

This entire class is based off of exams, which have nothing to do with the material taught in class. The whole class is taught a TA who barely even know how to do any of the 'demos' done in class. I never once saw the professor except in lecture videos that you must watch in order to know exam material. If I could, I would choose any other prof.

Used McGraw-Hill SIMbook, which is an absolute crap system, almost shovelware. Lectures were a waste of time, most of the homework is "brain off, follow these exact instructions." Poor quality, and activities don't seem to align well with the stated course objectives. Would be nice if they put some effort into this class. 
Two thumbs down :(

Absolutely the worst class I've ever taken. I can't believe they made me pay money for it. The class is only taught by TAs and most of the work is HW. The worst part of it all is the quizzes. They do NOT match up with what you learn and practice in class or for homework AT ALL. If you can, avoid this class and learn Excel on your own.

Never saw this professor once. Your TA's teach you everything and you have no clue if they're good or not until class starts. Attendance is required. Lots of things to do before each class, multiple projects, and difficult exams which don't focus on what you learned in class. Got early to help room for projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Pain class, you will hate every moment
This class was the worst class I have ever taken. I would not recommend this class to anyone avoid it at all costs. The grading scale was absolutely ridiculous and completely unfair. Worst prof ever.

Awful class, moved through big topics quickly, tested on material not covered in class, Would not recommend to anyone, No curve on anything even from the excel unit where the tech used would randomly mark answers wrong for clicking an extra button etc., insultingly added 0.1% to everyone's course grades, thank you so much for your generosity!

Wish I had more than 350 letters. Poorly organized, class was run with no curve on any exams or quizzes or course overall, Received a raw 79% of all 990 points in the class, and will be receiving a 2.5. Taught completely by TAs, test are completely based on irrelevant information from additional lecture videos you must watch outside of class 0/1000

Participation isn't mandatory, but the few times I wasn't able to attend, I didn't understand the homework -- so I highly suggest attending. Professor Dixon is always available to help, and helprooms are also very useful. There is a lot of homework, but it isn't too bad if you watch the lectures and go to class

reviews.comment: The set up of class could not have been worst. The material was challenging and it was solely taught by the TAs. Both the TAs and the professor were not good with answering emails and when they did, they did not address all of the questions asked. It was very difficult to get helpful feedback on assignments in a timely manner. Overall, -1000/10.

Professor is very absent from the course and office hours canceled often, so good luck finding help. TA's are less than helpful. When you ask further questions on lectures they don't know how to explain better. Course starts out pretty easy and only gets harder with harsher grading so be prepared. Grades are given back late often without feedback.

Professor and TAs are very absent. They do not provide feedback for assignments so you have know knowledge of what to fix to improve your grade. Also, they do not respond to emails in a timely manor and the responses are not helpful. Do not recommend.

Make sure you attend every class, its not mandatory but it is super hard to do the assignments totally by yourself. Use your TAs. Find a good group of people to do the assignments with cause it seriously helps so much. Get into a group chat. First exam is open note. Teagan is totally absent from course, TAs teach, and Teagan is hard to reach.

Overall the class requires a lot more effort than I anticipated. Tests are only based on memorization, so that makes a challenge specifically for the contents of this course. Really difficult to get help from the TA's or professor when you have questions outside of class, they don't respond to emails. Professor is never in class, only TA led.

I think this class is set up really well. The in class assignments are pretty easy, and if you go to help room, the projects are not too bad. She tells you everything you can expect on the exams as well so as long as you study for the exams you will be fine. This class definitely did keep me busy though as their is a lot to do per week.

Im sure he is a great person, but I just dont see the point of having quizzes on EXCEL. The questions are taken randomly out of the textbook and the only way to get 100% is memorizing every sentence. If my ACC or ECON professors made this type of quiz I wouldnt complain, but for an ITM course????
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Beware he will give you either NO instructions on how to do a project or the most UNCLEAR description to the point where he literally changes the criteria mid-explanation. He gives out big projects on Mondays and expects them to be done by WEDNESDAY. You will have no free time and if you choose to "do it later" you're going to fail.

Duke always brightened my day! He's super nice and funny! The workload could be a lot sometimes but make sure to communicate with him as he's pretty understanding and genuinely wants to see you succeed!!

I love Professor Duke. He's sweet, funny, and an incredible artist! Still, this class can be grueling (in-class still lifes & time consuming hw). Either way, I was able to get 100s on nearly all of my assignments. Show up so you can get your in-class hw credit (Iike fr) & you'll be fine. No matter what, I loved having Prof Duke this semester :)
He is a very friendly quirky guy!!! Tough grader but that comes with most art courses! Overall enjoyed his class :)

If you ask for feedback, it will be unclear and not make any sense. Supposedly this class is graded on effort, but it's obviously not. It's clear he wants you to draw in such a specific drawing style and if you don't, he will give you a low C or high D even if you spent hours on an assignment. He's also very passive aggressive.

I was very excited for this course, and at first liked it a lot because the prof was very passionate and gave a lot of positive reinforcement to me personally. As the course went on I realized he is a very strict grader, which I was not expecting for an art class. I will say I did learn quite a bit in this class but it was so so time consuming.

Yall need to cut this man a break lol. I entered this class thinking it would be an easy A and I'd skate by with my previous knowledge. Wrong. This class disrupted all I thought I knew and rebuilt it even stronger. People complain about spending hours on a project.. it's a large final work of art! As long as it's clear you are trying you'll b ok!

PROS: He's a nice guy, has a sense of humor He's a good artist. Lets you redo all assignments up until midterm (there is a HUGE but though.) CONS: EXTREMELY unclear grading criteria, Fairly large assignments due EVERY week. (the BUT... for the redoing assignments) Gives little feedback, what he does give is extremely cryptic.

reviews.comment: Unclear grading criteria, never tells you what he wants from an assignment. Lets you redo assignments, but won't tell you what was wrong and "needs fixing." reviews.comment: No clear grading criteria. Some people got full marks on late work and others who turned it in on time didnt. Professor laughed at student for asking to see their grade. reviews.comment: He's a really good guy, gives great critique and is an amazing artist himself. I feel like I improved. reviews.comment: Duke was a lazy, submissive instructor who fails to realize that painting is dead and needs to be re-invented.
There is no way those 5 ratings are not fabricated. I saw every human being including myself taking this class suffering from the incapability of teaching. Do not take her.

She is the opposite of caring, engaging, respectable. I tried so hard to learn from her but every week I ended up teaching the material myself. She is almost never available for extra help, and she somewhat enjoys seeing her students fail.

This course was frustrating overall. The professor seemed unfamiliar w/the material, which made lectures unclear & sometimes inconsistent. Office hours were conflicted w/lab making it difficult to get the help needed.
Chemistry is challenging, & this course lacked the clarity & support needed to succeed. Be prepared to rely on outside resources.
One of the best courses I took. Great lectures!
Lectures are intense, but the professor is fair and supportive. I learned much.

reviews.comment: hej folks professor demir is a great teacher and takes care of her students. the stuff from slides and additional things i got from her made the class really interesting and exciting. go for it

Dr. Demir is the absolute worst professor I've ever had at MSU. It's a crime that she's even allowed to continue to work at the university. I would recommend to not take the course but unfortunately it's required… good luck

I'm not going to say much other than good luck to the chem majors (b/c there is no other option). reviews.comment: This is the first time I am taking an inorganic class. It has been difficult for me, but Prof. Demir has been very helpful. She is a great teacher. Take her class!

reviews.comment: This is the first time that I get to study inorganic chemistry and I am really loving it. I also did well in the first exam, and I am sooo proud of it! The exam problems reflect the material taught in lecture! I went to the professors office hours which helped me a lot to get ready for the exam.

i just past my first written test and i am quite happy about the result. professor demir is a great teacher and cares a lot about students. she explains quite explicitly all stuff in an inspiring way. the course did raise definitely my interest in inorganic chemistry. i recommend it!

Professor Demir is a great teacher. I am really enjoying her skillful way how she introduces topics and explains even quite difficult details to students. She cares about the students and gives great advice how to recap the matter. I truly recommend the lecture!!
Fantastic professor! I am in Grad School now and super happy that I got to learn from her. True role model!!! Take her class!!
Brilliant professor! Highly recommend her class.
A great professor! I enjoyed the class and learned a whole bunch. She inspired me to pursue a career in inorganic chemistry!

Lots of the 5 star reviews here seem fake and are probably written by Prof. Demir herself. She is frequently rude, mumbles through her lectures, and frequently does not show up to lectures. You will need to memorize every small detail to do good on tests. The grading scale isn't clear. TA is great though.

Professor Demir is very engaged teacher. She really raised my interest for molecular inorganic chemistry and cares about progress of her students. I had some difficulties to digest the many aspects but overall enjoyed the course and learned a lot. Thx!
Just a great teacher with interesting topics in advanced inorganic chemistry. She cares and was available if questions arose. I truly recommend to take her class
Very insightful didn't thought = advanced inorganic is so inspiring and encouraging for learning more about main group element stuff. I keep reading on this things thanks to her great class
My favorite course this semester. Professor Demir is a warm and inspiring teacher. No doubt I can recommend taking this class.

She is amazing! Her expectations are high but the content is pretty attractive too. It meet my expectations for advanced inorganic stuff. She is easy to reach and gives fast feedback. Open hours help too. Brought me to really consider doing research in inorganic chemistry in future.

Professor Demir is a great teacher. I really enjoyed the lectures and learned a lot from interconnecting topics in advanced inorganics. Homework is needed to digest the content fully. No problem because she cares about students and gives quickly feedback.
First time for me to really enjoyed listening nonorganic stuff. Learned a lot and love to keep going with the topic of organometallic chem. Great and easy feedback from Professor Demir if needed.
Hey if you are eager to take a fresh class on fundamentals in inorganic and organometallic chemistry. Thats the on. Highly recommended

She is a great teacher of fundamental inorganic chemistry. Love main group chemistry ::-) Professor Demir cares about the success of her students and she responds quickly to inquiries. Never had a better class.

She is a very engaged teacher on fundamental stuff and gave me a hard time to digest the content. My background knowledge was not good enough. But after lots of homework and conversations with Professor Demir I made it! Glad that I took the class and passed it.

She is a great and friendly teacher but expects a lot. Lots of very interesting stuff. Passing examination with a good means requires quite a bit homework to digest the content. Luckily she is also available outside of class and responds quickly.

reviews.comment: Professor Demir is a great teacher. and very friendly person. I have learned a lot in her course about fundamentals in molecular orbital theory and basic inorganic chemistry. The way she introduced electronic structure-reactivity relationships was an eye opener to me. Just super inspiring. She is easily available for students if questions arise.

Professor Demir was amazing! She made everything easy to understand and cares about her students. She provided direct feedback and helped in many ways when it came to demanding teaching topics. Its more of the some specific content that needs extra work to learn all this and not the professor. She is easily one of the best teachers I've ever had.
She is a great teacher! You wouldn't want to miss out on this. Her class connects stuff in fundamental chemistry in a very inspiring way.
Great professor and amazing lectures! She explains things very well and is accessible outside of class. She also provides valuable feedback.
Professor Demir is very good at teaching. She is extremely smart and approachable. She is also always willing to make an appointment to talk about the lectured material. Would take again.
Great Professor! I enjoyed her lectures and learned a lot.
She's great

reviews.comment: one of the most frustrating and disappointing classes i've taken at MSU. professor demir cannot communicate with students at all. class material is from a german textbook. 1/3 of the course was completely pointless material. the grades are so heavily curved they might be fake. expect to fail her exams. interesting material, horrible professor.

The professor uses notes from Matthew D Law from UCL WORD FOR WORD. She does not elaborate beyond these PowerPoints. The exams expect you to MEMORIZE every small thing that was mentioned in lecture. This is not a learning based course. SHE DOES NOT USE A GRADING SCALE. The average determines a 3.0. The exam average was a 31%, making it a 3.0.

Dr. Demir is easily the worst teacher I've ever had. She is dismissive of students, unenthusiastically mumbles her lectures, misses class frequently, and does not provide a clear guideline on how she grades exams meaning no one knows what they have in the class until the very end. I have had more insightful bowl movements than this class was.

She is uncompassionate, and unaccomidating. Lectures are completely plagiarized from UCI, and she mumbles. Often does not come to lectures or exams, and shows no care for the class or her students. Do NOT take this class if it is not required. The TA is fantastic, but he can only do so much before the prof has to step up and actually teach.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Acevedo last semester and she was definitely a favorite. She was very easy going, caring and the work was never anything stressful. If you face any sort of problem and just communicate she's almost always understanding. Little cornball but we love that for her :)
Beware to be accused of AI plagiarism if you are a competent writer. Beware.

This class wasn't well structured, and it wasn't all Acevedo's fault. She's very caring, kind, and energetic, but the class activities, assignments, and projects weren't the best in my opinion. Attendance is mandatory, but she's a flexible and caring professor.

Dr. Acevedo is kind and clearly cares about her students. The class is easy, with grades based only on four projects, including one group assignment. However, she often goes off on political rants and shares personal stories about past students that probably shouldn't be repeated. Different views don't feel welcomed or tolerated in her classroom.

Dr. Acevedo was extremely kind and always willing to read your essays and gives amazing feedback on what you should add or take away from your essay. Class is mandatory but she understands if something comes up. I would 100% recommend taking WRA 101 with her especially if you like to mess around. Dr Acevedo likes to keep things fun and is genuine!!

Talk about deranged. Denise had a political meltdown every other lecture. Always complaining about the administration has absolutely no respect for students who share other beliefs. Avoid her at all costs!

Love her!! It's clear she loves her job and adores her students — very flexible and willing to work with you. Highly recommend, her class was very educational while maintaining a fun, relaxed atmosphere :). Takes student feedback into consideration and actually applies it to her curricula. Highly recommend!
I absolutely loved WRA 101 with Dr. Acevedo. She cares about the success of all her students and goes above and beyond to help. Definitely one of my favorite professors at MSU.

A very nice person who cares for her students. An Hour and 50 minute lecture is way too long and it shows but a very easy grader and understanding as well. There are four projects and she gives you a lot of time to work on them. My only complaint is she isn't very clear with the projects and it's almost like she changes her mind mid way through.

Dr. Acevedo is the best. She truly cares about her students and thats reflected in her class. Assignments are easy and so is the grading but if you're stuck with a group that doesn't help then let her know and she'll try her best to help. Shes also absolutely hilarious and brought in ice cream for the class.
Taking WRA 101 with Dr. Acevedo was pretty easy. You have 4 projects throughout the semester and you get lots of time to do them. Some projects are with groups. I'd recommend taking WRA with her.

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo is the only prof I've had that cares to get to know you. The 4 projects in this class are a little odd, but the reflective essay at the end of each one isn't hard. You definitely have to like writing to really enjoy this class tho. She talks about her own life a lot but is super funny so I like listening to her stories. Grades easy too.

Dr. Acevedo is a great professor who genuinely cares about her students and their success. The projects in this class are a little insane, but it makes it interesting. Highly recommend taking WRA 101 with her.

Prof. Acevedo is super easy to get along with, and is super fast with answering messages and questions about assignments. She's understanding and assignments are straight forward. The class isn't super hard but theres a lot of writing but she gives good feedback and will read papers before you turn them in if you ask.

Imagine every white narcissistic vain egotistical teacher you had in hs and amplify it ten times. Dr.Acevedo has no sense of her own classroom and the students in it because no one has ever walked out of her course having learned anything or smiled once. Please do not take wra with her because you will not enjoy one minute of your time

Dr. Acevedo is a really good person but her work is a little insane. This definitely wasn't treated like a 100 level course. This class did 4 different group projects and then after each project we wrote a reflective essay. So be prepared for writing a lot of essays. Her grading was pretty easy though, I got a 100% on all my essays.

The entire class is doing group projects which is a pain, and she overcomplicates things for no reason. I found her to be culturally ignorant with the latino culture as well it was quite uncomfortable. She was very nice, but if you missed a peer review she would automatically take off 30 points, and if she didn't like your peer review she dock.

I took IAH 231B with Dr. Acevedo online in the summer, and she is one of the best professors I have ever had. She actually reads and responds to each student, and her assignments are clear. You can tell she truly puts effort into her class. Would recommend :)

Absolutely loved her classes! I had her for WRA 101 as well as IAH 206 and received a 4.0 in both classes. She grades super easy, the only thing she asks of you is to attend class and participate in discussions. She is super sweet and very caring towards her students. Highly recommend taking any of her classes!
The best professor in WRA!!!
Best prof ever! Super sweet and cares about her students immensely.

That is very good professor in MSU
Best

My grade did not reflect my effort at all.

I recommend her as a prof. I had her for WRA 1004 and WRA 101 and she was the best (I received an A in both courses). Participation matters in her class, but the assignments are not tough at all. She is very caring, understanding, and willing to help you out if you need it.

AWESOME professor. Class is relatively easy and she gives great feedback. Super friendly and available outside of class. I can't say enough good things about her honestly. Hearing "aha moment" all the time over the semester got kind of old but that's about the only complaint I have. I really enjoyed this class.

Dr. Acevedo is an amazing professor. She cares for her students as if they were own children. The class is beneficial as well. Participation is key to passing her class. If you need additional help, you can go to her office hours, give her a call, or just text her. I would definitely recommend to have her as a professor if you can.
One of my most favorite professors at MSU.

If you have the option to have Dr. Acevedo as a teacher, DO IT!! She's an amazing teacher! It is not hard to do well in that class if you do the reflections, go to class, and participate! Would 100% take another class with her!

I would recommend this professor to anyone and everyone. Dr. Acevedo is an AMAZING person and professor. Her class is enjoyable (as every class should be) and she keeps every lecture interesting and engaging. As long as you put forth your effort, participate and show up to class, you'll get a 4.0.

reviews.comment: Loved WRA 150 with Dr. Acevedo! She's one of the only professors I've had that truly cares about their students. Participate in class, go to office hours if you need help, and if you have any questions ask!

The only professor I've had who actually seemed to give a damn about their students. She makes sure she gets to know you and you know her back. She's always there to help with whatever you need even if you're not in her class anymore. I really enjoyed her class because she makes sure you understand what to do and how to get the best grade possible.
She was sooo nice! LOVED HER! take war 150 with her! i got a 3.5 on most my essays. she was so easy and nice

Dr. Acevedo is one of the most caring educators that I have ever had in my entire educational career. She absolutely LOVES her students, and goes go out of her way to get to know them better.
