I hear stories on how for 491 he was pretty chill, but for the first semester as an actual required course… I don't really see it. Very strict and even if you study hard, attend helprooms, etc but don't do well, he will say it's your fault that you did poorly.

Mariani is a great professor! I wouldn't pay much attention to the other reviews on this page. He is very helpful when you have a good attitude, but he will not put up with BS.

Coming to lecture and engaging is essential. Thankfully, Mariani is is good at answering questions and helping students grasp the content if they will put in the effort.

Don't take a class with this guy, ever. He has just found a way to do the least amount of work and makes students suffer because of his laziness. All exams/quizzes are cumulative, but he barely helps out students with review guides. He is strict on absolutely everything and just an overall horrible professor.
Put 5 months of back end development on your resume after this class, because you'll be teaching it to yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Provides incredibly few resources for learning and makes thoroughly liberal use of automatic zeros and automatic class failure. Berates students for asking for more resources or complaining about the class. Why he is a professor I cannot comprehend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a good person. Doesn't know how to teach

This class made me hate college. Prof puts absolutely no effort into the course. He takes a potentially really cool class and makes it unbearable.

He is extremely adversarial and hostile toward his students and takes no accountability for himself.  

This class is so bad I created an account to make this review. Avoid this class if you can.

-No extra credit
-Really harsh on exam/quiz grading
-Sick without a doctor notice or something official? No problem! Class dropped.
-Only take this class if you want to drain yourself mentally and physically
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: the class is very hard but he is making lots of attempts to help people pass with extra credit and lots of office hours and piazza help. probably dont take this class with him if you have a heavy load of other classes
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: didn't teach anything useful at all, would just stick to one thing and just rumble away for the rest of the hour. biggest waste of time going to his lectures and the tests were ridiculously difficult. absolutely horrendous teacher

Worst professor of all time. I am a chemistry major and 4.0'd the class, no thanks to Dr. Jackson. Organic Chemistry tutor and other online resources gave me my grade, as well as self-learning. I could quite literally give better lectures than this professor, and I just learned the material.

The professor jumps from topic to topic and makes zero sense. The book and online videos from YouTube will save your grade. The class is made up of online quizzes which are okay if you read and do the quizzes beforehand. The final, my goodness. The final is the worst exam ever. The written portion- not even the father of chemistry can save you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Definitely one of my more difficult classes. Lectures kind of jump all over the place, so definitely read the relevant textbook sections prior to lecture. Not too terrible as long as you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible at teaching in general. Cannot formulate a proper test to save his life. The material in class did not match the material tested on for the first 3/4 of the semester. Get the hell out while you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He gave extra credit after students asked for it; he has evening review sessions every Tuesday. I don't believe that the class was curved in the end, but I still managed to get a 4.0. It is a tough class, but doable.

He can sometimes go on tangents here and there about what somethings can be used for but overall he is pretty good at giving examples in class and always holds review sessions and encourages his students to come to office hours.
His lectures can become cluttered but overall he knows the material and encourages students to as well.

A bad group in EGR 100 will have you spending countless hours doing busy work that makes you lose your mind. The grading system is extremely harsh, and a PHD level English professor couldn't even get over an 85% on a report. Jenahvive herself is a nice person, but she needs to do something to fix the structure of this class ASAP.

The lectures are pointless but are mandatory. Dr. Morgan doesn't grade at all your grade depends on the TA and your group. Pray that you get a good TA and if your group is bad switch after project one.

In my experience, the course layout was harder to navigate than it needed to be. Finding assignments and materials sometimes took more time than expected, which made it harder to stay organized. A simpler course structure would make the class easier to follow and more accessible for students.

Honestly the most pointless class. I am currently in EGR102, and it has helped me so much more than EGR100 ever has. All group work, and because my groups were so bad it was so much unecessary work. I could have been putting more work into my actual engineering courses with the time I put into this class; it needs to be restructured.

This class was fine and Dr. Morgan gave decent lectures. I will say the lectures weren't that interesting or necessary for the class. Most of the points for the class come from the lab. 

There are mandatory exit questions for the lectures that are a bit confusing but she will help if you ask and they are graded by accuracy.

The lectures are kind of redundant and your grades mainly come from the two take-home exams and the two group projects that you definitely have to pray you have a good group for otherwise its up to your TA to decide whether you get a decent grade or not.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You will be primarily graded on group projects. The TA does nearly all of the grading. The lecture and lab have very little to do with each other. The class is overall boring, generic, and basic (block coding, using excel, etc.). You are required to get a >$100 textbook in order to complete the assignments which can be done without reading it.
super easy, all the exam answers are online. chat gpt is king
EGR 100 is just generally a bad class, and Dr. Morgan tries her best with what she has. The lectures are generally not interesting with a small quiz at the end.

The class should be an easy 4.0, Morgan will not affect your grade at all as everything is dependent on your TA and your lab group, just do your work and you will be fine. That being said Morgan's lectures are  long, boring, and completely irrelevant to any work we are doing, and she makes you buy an expensive textbook that no one will be reading

Lets get one thing straight the class is not hard. I think most of the ratings are because of the lab, which is a teacher assistant, not Professor Morgan. In lab, you might find yourself in groups that are lazy and uncooperative so you may end up doing most of the work. Anyone rating this professor below a 3 is one of these lazy people.

PICK A GOOD GROUP. The labs are all group-based. Dr. Morgan sucks. The lectures have no value. The labs are where you actually do things. Don't buy the textbook; just use the free trial to do the reading assignments and skip the last 4 or so. But yeah, she is awful.

She's very unavailable and the kectThe class is a weed out class so don't be discourage if you're passionate about your major. It's an easy A when you put the unnecessary amount of work in. Switch your group of its bad and meet people in your lab! There's a lot of busy work for it o be a 2.0 class but use your resources.

Dr. Morgan seemed like a nice person. Although nice, her lectures were very pointless and people only showed up for lecture assignments. The whole course experience depends on if you have a good group or not. You spent way to much time out of class doing homework and assignments for this class being two credits.

From what I can gather, Dr. Morgan is a generally nice person. However, the class is structured very poorly. Overall, it was mostly just a report writing class. The lectures were a mix of vague engineering and physics topics that aren't fully explained, especially the physics. The class wasn't hard, but the textbook is only for homework questions.

she is very rough in grading, and forces the TA's to grade you horribly and harshly. Her office hours are horrible with 2-3 hours a week, and always 5-10 people waiting in line. Be sure to wait for 45 mins to talk to her. And she is very harsh, the course is structured horribly about stuff and not being clear. She also speaks like a robot in class.

Dr. Morgan is a very sweet lady, don't get scared from her low rating. The entire class is based on if you do the work on time. She does make her TA's grade kind of hard on the reports, but it's only to prepare you for the actual reports you'll have to do in the field. They also give you really good feedback so you can improve for future reports.
her class is kind of pointless but easy. pretty much don't understand what she's saying but it doesn't matter because we don't ever use any of the stuff
she is super nice and helped a lot with any questions i had

Very kind and easy to talk to. Although office hours are limited, you can always email your TA with any questions. Overall, it's an easy class if you actually follow the report rubrics and is a pretty fun course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Haven't interacted with the professor much but the class wasn't bad. Depends a lot on if you get a good group, but otherwise it's mostly about following instructions and keeping up with deadlines.

Grade is entirely dependent on your lab group and TA. Lecture is a little boring and usually doesn't relate to lab content. Attendance mandatory as there are lecture assignments. TAs are pretty harsh graders and will give you a 0 for submitting something even one minute late. Also the textbook is crazy expensive for how much you end up using it.

The only thing you need to do to pass the class is focus on the lab. She does lecture assignments but they're pretty trivial. Exams are open note. You don't really gain much from lecture. It's mostly group projects and report writing so its reliant on a good group. I had a good TA which made it a little easier. Keep the lecture assignments.

The grade that you get is largely dependent on the group that you have in lab. But, you do have the option to switch groups after the first project. I don't like the $150 textbook that you have to purchase to do homework. She is pretty decent at Lectures but most of the things are pretty general that we are taught.

Think her average grade is more indicative of the course itself and not her. Experience largely depends on group members and TA. Book costs an insane amount of money for its use case, and lectures are usually pretty boring. She herself is a nice person, course is just repetitive and quite boring.

This is the worst teacher I have ever had in my entire life. Expect to be spoken to as if you are 3 years old. Has two total office hours per week despite a 500 student class size. Therefore, if you show up to office hours expect to wait 30+ minutes for a short conversation that will be her lecturing you about your questions before you finish aski

most work youll have to do for a 2 credit class, lectures are very boring and filled with unnecessary info, course work is mostly busy work and group projects, overall not hard to get a good grade but not a good class

Dr. Morgan is fine. She seems like a robot most of the time during the lectures. The content of her class is important but is very boring. Even though the TAs do the grading, they follow a strict grade scale for each assignment. You will get a 70% on your first paper, the excuse being "It's a tiny portion of your grade." Do the work, you'll be ok.

Dr. Morgan is one of the most soulless people I have ever met in my life. She is very rigid and unaccommodating. If you come to her office hours with questions regarding grading, expect to leave the room with no shreds of sanity left. Her class may not be difficult, but she is certainly difficult to be around...

I earlier gave her a 5 star thinking she was a great professor. I recently got an email saying my honors option was rejected for this class. I LITERALLY PUT IN HOURS OF EFFORT INTO WRITING A 8 PAGE REPORT for honors option and due to some minor error,SHE JUST DECLINED MY ENTIRE REPORT. I mean how could a professor be this tough on an assignment .

I dont know why do some students hate the professor. I agree a lot of content in class can be done in a short amount of time rather than a semester, but professor does teach well and tries to make students learn.. However, her office hours line is really long, it needs to be fixed.

Your grade in this class will be completely dependent on the group that you get, but all other work is extremely easy. My only gripe with Morgan is the $150 textbook which you HAVE to buy in order to do the homework. It's unfortunate that this class is required since its completely unnecessary but she makes the class as easy as possible.

The professor seems great, but lectures can feel boring and pointless. The class heavily depends on the group project, so your experience may vary based on your team. The TA also plays a major role—having a helpful one can really improve the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class is HEAVILY dependent on the group you get. If you get a good group it will be an easy 4.0 with little work. If you get a bad group, like myself, you will have many late nights and the class will be equivalent to a 4 credit course. My group did zero work and it was the most miserable experience I've had in college so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The lectures were useless, and the assignments reminded me of 8th grade math. The lab experience depends solely on the TA. I had Matias Leon-Miquel. He was the best TA and was so kind and helpful during lab and was a pretty lenient grader. Dr. Morgan did nothing. The TA makes it or breaks it. Overall very easy class though.

The lectures and lecture assignments taught me nothing; it was just busy work. She is also not very lenient on changing grades. The class is heavily focused on group projects, and when people in my group didn't submit the work like they said they would, I got zeros, even after going to her office hours, she said she wouldn't change it.

The course itself is very stupid, so I can't put that on the professor, but her lectures are actually very boring and useless when it comes to teaching us content. She is really strict on changing grades and won't give you even 0.01% credit if that meant you would get a 4.0 in the class.

EGR100 is an unorganized class and the lectures and labs are disconnected. The labs have a ton of reports and projects that are often too much. Lectures are to prepare for exams. The class doesn't introduce students to much engineering besides how to write reports and make scatter plots in Excel. Dr. Morgan is kind and accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easy class but the lectures are so boring and not useful. The lecture assignments are so easy. Grading depends on the TA for labs but they are mostly lenient and good with material.
good overall

Class was pretty fun and easy mostly involving a couple of hands on projects and some highschool level math and physics. She's a pretty nice and caring person. $150 for the text book was crazy, another class I'm taking uses the same platform and the text book is $40 with about 10 times more content than this class.

This class is honestly more work than the 2 credits it is, but it is very easy. Make sure to attend lecture as there are lecture assignments you must complete to 4.0. Dr. Morgan is very accessible outside of class. If you ever need help with anything (grading, late assignments, etc.) don't email her, just visit **office hours**.

This class uses a $150 textbook which has content that can be summarized in a YouTube video. The lecture/exam is mostly an arbitrary combination of thermodynamics, physics, chemistry, etc. This class lecture/exams doesn't really serve a purpose for engineers. Labs are useful, as they introduce report writing and collaboration to students.

She is nice and educates you about careers in engineering. all work in this class is very easy. I've seen people on here claim good group members are important to your success in the course, but you could do all the work alone it would just be a more significant time investment than necessary.

She was okay, but the class is just pointless. I don't know why the university forces engineers to take it. You learn quite literally nothing, the lectures are at 8am, and you just talk about random BS and powerpoint/excel. Joke of a class, and Prof. Morgan was just "Okay". HATED the course though

Honestly this course solely depends on your group members and your TA. Also be prepared to spend around 170 for a textbook that is useless. Once again you need immense luck for your teammates and TA to have a good experience.

Yeah, this class wasn't fun, but all engineers have to take it unfortunately. $150 book was useless but required for points. TA was not a good grader. Lecture assignments were easy. Just unit conversions for the most part. Class just annoying rather than difficult. This class should be an easy 4.0 but there were some close calls from bad grading.

Most problems have already been said. Overpriced useless online textbook, big ego, bizarre grading. Keep your lecture assignments (Yes even after they're graded). The lab TA did all the heavy lifting and was very nice. You will not learn anything in this class.
Dr. Morgan gives what are some of the worst lectures at this university. she explains everything badly. also she makes you buy a $150 textbook that she didn't mention a single time.

Genuinely the worst class I've ever had. She seems nice, but had quick, useless lectures that taught us nothing. My lab groups were DESPICABLE- had to do all the work and I didn't know how to ask for help from prof. No lecture content came up in lab at any point. USELESS $130 TEXTBOOK??? GOOD GOD. AND WE HARDLY USED IT. Bad reviews are true.

Hey guys welcome to the 8 AM lecture, let me speed run 30 slides, so you have no idea what I'm talking about. Oh, hey you also have a lecture assignment on said slides, but you only have 10 minutes, good luck! Oh yeah, don't forget to go to that 2 hour lab and jerk each other.

In her lectures, it's fine 35 minutes of her talking and 15 minutes to do an assignment. HER LAB? SUCKS! You do two projects throughout the semester with a team, if you have a teammate that isn't doing any work and you want to leave their name off? The rules for that are very fuzzy. I hated this class, but it is the first step to being an engineer.

I have never seen any professor that tries to "fail' a student as hard as she does.
She's unreasonably strict and seems like love to give students penalty.

Dr. Morgan is kind but inflexible and overly strict. Missing a scatter plot cost me 60 points out of 200, and despite scoring 98/100 on the final, I got a B. Submitting assignments even one minute late results in zero points. The course demands too much for a 100-level class, the $100 e-book feels pointless, and emails often go unanswered.

Not outstanding, but not necessarily an awful professor. You have very little time to take notes in lectures, and the projects are super mundane and not exciting. It's very unclear what the curriculum is supposed to teach or prepare you for. Depending on your TA, you will be graded super heavily or not at all. Try to take the class with a friend.
Everything taught in the lectures is common sense, all of the real work comes from the lab. Textbook is barely used and very expensive. Professor is nice enough but this class is absolutely useless.

Made me buy a 130-dollar textbook to not use it. This sums up the whole class experience, overall, lectures were unorganized and she went extremely fast. Labs vary greatly depending on your TA and group.

She goes out of her way to stop people from doing well and wastes their time. For example, if work was submitted on time in the wrong portal (she teaches first sem freshman mainly), she makes you come to office hours which are at an awkward time and still might not accept the work even though it was submitted on time just at the wrong place.

the professor seems nice, but the material is so unorganized when it's taught. i had no idea what was happening during lecture assignments. even the labs assignments were confusing to understand. the labs are also two hours and you basically just sit there. they need this to at least be a 3 credit course for all the work and group projects.

Dr. Morgan (you MUST call her doctor or else she will not even respond to you) is extremely difficult to reach and very difficult when it comes to communication. The class itself is not hard, however she instructs the TA's to grade VERY difficult, and would not communicate unless you go to her office hours. I pray one day this class isn't required!

Dr. Morgan isn't the greatest professor, but really isn't as bad as her rating makes her out to be. As a person, she's quite nice and respectful especially while answering questions in lecture. As a professor, her lectures seemed kind of unorganized and hard to follow, sometimes giving us only 10ish minutes to do the required lecture assignment.

Professor is unorganized and teaches concepts that are generally common knowledge. Book is expensive for class that is useless. The only part that is useful is working in groups to complete projects. Should be a 3 credit class as many groups are not efficient and require one person to carry the team.
She assigns a very useless textbook which is 130 bucks. Super easy class.

useless lectures that taught us common sense things like unit conversions. didn't learn anything new, everything was something I new from middle school science classes. labs required a ton of work for a 2 credit class. had to buy useless book for homework, which just glazed engineers and didn't teach us anything.

Overall, class is mostly busy work. Your grade will be determined by how lenient your TA is. Had to buy a $150 textbook that was utterly and completely useless for 10% of the grade. Lecture attendance is required. However, Dr. Morgan is very kind and was always friendly in lecture. Great person, boring class. Wish we didn't have to pay for textbook

This class is a joke. Your once a week lectures are spent sitting there having no clue what is going on, until the last 10 minutes when your handed an assignment and told to do it. Your 2 hour long once a week lab is very TA dependent but with no clear rubrics or guidelines you'll have no clue what to do. Don't even bother with office hours.
Lectures were so boring and I learned absolutely nothing. To be fair, that's mainly a pitfall of EGR 100. Just read off of slides that were mainly dimensional analysis.
Not lenient at all.

This class as a whole is the single most useless information dump ever, get ready to learn about microsoft excel and "problem solving" aka doing random projects for no reason. Other than that, Morgan is not a great prof, she goes through the lecture information too quickly and all the lecture assignments are just copying info from previous slides.

This Professor is the reason my Engineering has so many problems in the modern day. She has said, "We have new students" in one of her lectures she is the reason that so many good engineers quit Engineering because she trys to kick the creative, and questioning students out of engineering.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Morgan wasn't as bad as her reputation makes her seem. Her lectures were decent, but the material presented was pretty useless, as was the class as a whole. She also wasn't very available outside of class, as she usually was not able to talk before/after class and her office hours always had a long wait. Not the worst... not the best either.

If you have any questions for Dr. Morgan that do not directly involve lecture content, she tells you to attend her office hours no matter the question. Once you attend her office hours, she is incredibly rigid and makes you get back in line if you have any modifications to be made. Working with Dr. Morgan is extremely difficult.
Dr. Morgan was very nice and caring, but her lectures didn't make any sense. It felt like she just talked about random stuff and it didn't seem to be relevant or relate to anything.

This is not a hard class to get a 4.0 in, but this was also an annoying class to take. The professor is a good person but not the best at her job, she speeds through the slides and there are in-lecture assignments that you have to do. The labs could be easy or hard depending on your group and TA.

Unfortunately this class is required for engineering majors, otherwise I would recommend that nobody take it. Lectures are super fast and basically useless, it's difficult to keep up. She has mandatory graded lecture assignments so you can't skip. Lab is based almost entirely on group projects and varies WILDLY on your TA and group members.

This class is a waste of time. The lectures are very boring and she doesn't do a good job of explaining so you don't really learn anything. At the end of each lecture, there is a lecture assignment, which is most of the time hard as she doesn't explain the topics but rather reads them off a slide show. This was one of my least favorite classes.

One of the most useless classes in MSU. Her lectures were fast paced and boring. Those assignments during the lecture were so easy. The projects are just waste of time regardless of only 2 credits. Wouldn't take this class again.
egr 100 is the most useless class of the curriculum. that two credit class is more painful than anything.

Morgan is not bad herself and her lectures are fine, but a bunch of calculations are thrown at you and you don't really learn anything. Exams are easy as she walks you through it step by step. BUT, I cannot stress this enough please get a good group for lab or this class will be horrible. Please don't feel bad and leave them as it is your grade!

Dr. Morgan's class was a typical first year intro class. It's easy to manage a 4.0 in her class if you provide group effort and have a interest in engineering. The biggest takeaway from her class was learning how to work in groups. Her lecture assignments were my biggest struggle (not too hard though) due to the intensity of the calculations.
easy class, lectures were just really boring and fast paced. there is lowkey no point in showing up to the lectures besides the lecture assignments because the videos she uploads are the same.

Jenahive herself is nice but it's the TA's to be aware. Most of the class is group work and the TA's are very picky on the projects. They don't grade based on the rubric or requirements and take off points for the smallest stuff. The TAs also aren't very clear on what the projects or reports are supposed to have. Midterm and final exam are easy.

She was ok. Good person, but treated kids like they didn't know anything, like kindergartners. Projects graded unnecessarily hard. Most of the grade is based on 2 projects. Lectures were generally unhelpful and did not flow at all.

Class felt absolutely useless for later in life, way too much work outside of class, especially for 2 credits, and a $100+ textbook that is essentially only used for homework problems (that you absolutely have to buy new; can't get secondhand). Only a 2/5 instead of 1/5 because she was easily accessible through email.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Morgans lectures have nothing to do with the Labs and are very unhelpful, even for the lecture assignments. You never know when anything is due and she fails to remind you to keep the assignments even when you have to submit them at the end of the semester. Its almost like Dr.Morgan sets you up to fail.

Dr. Morgan is a nice, helpful woman but her lectures seem pointless. All the consist of are her going over random calculations that seem to have no correlation to anything we do in the lab. The lecture assignments are repetitive, and the midterm was really weird. The lab is fun as long as you get a good project which can be unfair.

Terrible. No late work even by 30 minutes even though they grade 2 weeks later. Some TA's are the harshest graders. I had more work in this 2 CREDIT class than my four credit classes. This class is also completely useless and your grade is based on luck whether you get assigned an easy or a hard project. This being a mandatory eng class is a joke.
I have spent a cumulative 12 hours in her lectures and have not learned a single thing. At least the labs are pretty fun.

You are required to purchase a textbook and complete reading quizzes which ask questions that are utterly useless. You have to resubmit already graded papers a month after they are done getting another grade to "make sure you keep the papers." And the classes talk about things you would learn better in other classes but she goes way to fast.

Will give you lecture assignments to do, then takes them for points, gives them back graded, and then expects us to turn them in again for what? Why what reason? She does things without reason. This woman teaches with rules. She doesn't flinch at students asking for help or needing more time on slides. If it can be avoided avoid

Never accessible for help outside class except during office hours - will never do anything over email. Makes you purchase a $150 textbook for 5 homework assignments. Attendance in lectures are required and there are graded assignments in them. Dr.Morgan along with her TA's are unsympathetic and unhelpful. You will teach yourself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Morgan is one of the most caring profs at MSU. Although the lab projects can get hard, get with a good group and you'll do fine. She also helps you on the graded lecture assignments each class and goes over stuff to help. Theres lots of opportunities to earn credit as long as you complete everything. There are also only two tests for the class.

Dr. Morgan is a good person, but terrible professor. I had more work in 2 credit EGR 100, than the rest of my classes combined. I didn't buy the $115 textbook, got zeros for the reading quizzes, and still got a 4.0. The group work is terrible if your group is bad. Grading is done by TAs. The midterm was a cake walk if you follow her example demos.

She acts like her 2 credit class is the most important thing in the world.  Her level 100 class had more work in it than my level 300 class.  It was boring and taught me nothing and costs $1000 to take.

This course is completely irrelevant, but a requirement for all engineering majors. The lectures are useless, and group projects are tedious and trivial but can be fun if you get a good group. If you don't get a good group, you will not enjoy this class. Dr. Morgan has office hours twice a week and will help if needed, but this should be an easy A.

The course lecture and required $100 textbook are totally unrelated to the lab and exist solely to be mined for final exam material. Expect to do poorly on the exams and lecture assignments if you do not have a solid physics foundation coming into the course. Labs are all group work, which is great if you get a good group, but awful if you do not.

The lecture, reading (which costs $100), and labs are irrelevant. The TAs vary; some could be very harsh, even on a tiny mistake, but others care. The professor herself is really nice, she tries to make everyone understand the concept and does well in this course. She truly cares for her student and provides constructive feedback towards questions.
The group projects were awful and the TA's grade insanely harsh. It's easy to forget to do work for this class so make sure you stay on top of your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course was irrelevant: lectures had nothing to do with labs and most of the work was done in lab. Lectures were mostly spent going over slides and most people couldn't keep up with her and take notes because she went through everything very fast. TA's did most of the teaching throughout the course, and every TA grades differently so beware.

Dr. Morgan's class (specifically EGR 100) is unnecessarily difficult because there is a lot of irrelevant information in her lectures. Basically the entire semester it is unclear what you need to know. However, I think that Dr. Morgan does try to help students when she can.

Professor Morgan puts in zero effort for her students. The class is unnecessarily harder than it needs to be.  The lectures by Professor Morgan is a waste of a hour but you have to stay till the end to complete the lecture assignment that she gives the answer to. It seems they pay her for her PhD title and not actually teaching proficiency.

Dr. Morgan was of minimal help the whole semester, and her lectures were very irrelevant and unhelpful with the labs. I first entered this course with high expectations and quickly became disappointed for many reasons. Also, the required $110 online textbook was completely useless other than needing it for a few 5-minute quizzes the first month.

Dr. Morgan is honestly not a terrible teacher or person, she's just not a good lecture professor. She goes through things thoroughly but it's almost boring and the lecture assignments are somewhat hard. If she was a TA, it would be much better

EGR 100 is a complete waste of time. The lectures were just boring and the only reason I went was because of the assignment. 99% of the work for the class is done in the lab portion and which is taught by the TA. Class is super easy but will ned to do work on the group projects, so pray you to get a good project group. Projects are also super easy.

Lecture is required but has absolutely no relevance to the class. I'm not sure I've ever taken a class and learned nothing before. Lab is enjoyable but make sure you have a good group or else you are in for it.
They grade based off of "creativity", which is an arbitrary and poorly described metric.

EGR100 is a simple class. Most of the work is in lab and if you pick an easy project, you'll be fine. In lectures, however, Dr. Morgan speeds through the notes and students have no time to write anything down. Everyone took pictures of the screen before she clicked to the next slide. Lecture assignments can be hard, so ask around you for help.

The lectures and lab work are very different but they do relate to what you're going to be doing in engineering. Most of your grade is based on lab work, so hopefully you get a competent group. Projects are decently easy the TA's help you out a lot and the prof gives good resources to use on projects and the midterm in d2L. Attendance is graded!!!

Professor Morgan seems to care about the students and was usually really helpful when I visited her during office hours. However her lectures were completely unrelated to the stuff you did in lab and if you don't get a good lab group you'll have a tough time. Some projects are also way easier than others but you have little say in which one you get

DON'T PAY FOR THE ONLINE COURSE BOOK. It is over a hundred dollars and it's five hours to go through all of the work assigned using your free trial. As for the rest of your class, your group will make or break this so make an effort to actually get to know them. The course material is very basic, be ready for a lot of high school science classes.

The lectures were all recorded and posted, but the assignments were difficult as she doesn't go over the material in detail and expects you to have prior knowledge. The bulk of your grade is the lab group projects, which were awful or great depending on if you got a good group. The midterm was easy since she outlined it in lectures.
I like Dr. Morgan, she seems nice. The lectures are fine, nothing amazing about it. I really hate this class though, most engineers won't use the skills taught.

I saw Dr. Morgan twice the whole semester, I had an in person lecture but realized watching it online was easier. This class is stupid at best the projects you do in lab are equivalent to what middle schoolers do. Hope you get a good group because it will be an easy A. Midterm is worth a lot of points but she has videos outlining how to do it.

Morgan doesn't seem awful, but she isn't really the one doing the teaching outside of pre-recorded lecture videos. Your TA is who does most of the class, the projects (a lot of the grade), and the one who grades stuff, most of them mark you down for the smallest of things. If this isn't required for your major don't take it. Hope for a good TA.

You would have a better time by converting your tuition into nickels, filling bags with the nickels, then having people hit you with said bags. If this was my first taste of engineering I would want to change majors. Unfortunately, at least during my time, she was the only one to teach this class.

Interesting course. Heavy group work. Decent amount of work for 2 credits. Hope for a good group cause some of these sorry engineering students won't do anything in these groups and you will have to pick up.

Dr. Morgan, overall, was not the best professor, but not the worst. Had virtually no student interaction besides pre-recorded videos, which were very slow-paced, and the course required a 100 dollar online textbook that was barely used. Class itself was easy for me, though apparently some TAs are extremely tough graders, so watch out for that.

First, you are required to pay 100 dollars for an online textbook that contains graded reading quizzes which have no bearing on anything else in the class. Your grade is VERY dependent on your TA and project group. Dr. Morgan herself seems nice in her videos but it's not like I would know, since almost nobody in the class ever met her.

We never met with her face to face. She was completely asynchronous and basically did nothing besides create very boring and irrelevant lecture videos. The group projects consumed our time primarily. The TAs handled the project grading and project directions alone. Your grade is entirely dependent on having a competent TA. Pr. doesn't do anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Congratulations! You just spend a space in your scheduling learning how to use excel. Sorry if you already know how, that's not MSU's issue. As far as Dr. Morgan goes, where was she? She did the lectures which were boring and irrelevant. She didn't interact with the 2 large projects which make up almost all your grade. Pray for a good TA and group.

The class was super random and the content was not related. Your grade completely depends your TA. I've had friends take this class and do great but I did not do as well because my TA graded so aggressively hard on our group projects that even though I got 100% everything else I still couldn't end with a A and there was nothing I could do about it

She has the teaching assistants do 99% of her work (holding meetings, grading work, etc.) while she sits there and does nothing but assign you busywork. Such a poorly ran course, very lazy professor. And of course she makes you pay $100+ for a textbook you barely use and frankly don't need. Absolute clown professor.

Her asynchronous lectures are awful. Be prepared to teach yourself everything if you don't have a good TA to reach out to. The workload is ridiculous as well; we lost two weeks (scheduling error) to work on our first project, and we're still getting lecture assignments that burn through time and don't actually benefit us. Avoid this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: As an online class you don't really have much contact with her besides office hours. She was helpful whenever I went to office hours, but I mainly went for guidance on an honors option and not the course content. Her lectures and assignments are kind of random compared to the projects but they're okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: .A ton of this class is dependant on your TA, and if you get stuck with one that isn't too great-good luck. The grading is mostly done by TA's and ULA's as well, and is often super inconsistent between classes, especially because grading criteria is super unclear. It is not that hard to get an A, but it is very draining at times.

Dr. Morgan was great. She helped a lot during office hours and always responded to my emails. Her lectures dont go along with the labs but its still helpful. Final is hard if you dont study. The honors essay seems hard since its 10 pages but if you choose a good topic youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The group projects in the class can be difficult if you don't have a good group. Dr. Morgan is pretty understanding about it though, I reached out to her during her office hours and she was able to help me out a bit with my group. I would say the class itself isn't very enjoyable in that regard, but Dr. Morgan tries her best to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Grading criteria and other instructions were usually quite unclear, but in the end if you put in any amount of effort its an easy 4.0 it just might might be a frustrating experience. Lectures were unhelpful and disorganized. Lab depends on your TA. For anyone considering completing the honors option, it was a 10 page paper.

Horrible at describing anything in detail and quite frankly the worst professor I have had at MSU. Her lectures are painful to sit through. I would not recommend her to anyone even though the class was pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Here is how you enjoy the class -Bring a laptop and sit in the way back -Pay zero attention, as much of it so basic you saving yourself sanity -Work with some kids who did pay attention to pass lecture assignment(20%) -In lab it's 20 min of work, and then an hour of chilling -Study like an hour before the exam and you will ace it.
Dr. Morgan is a great prof, but her lectures and the lecture assignments were the worst. Also, you are put into groups, so if you have a bad team you might find yourself doing most or all the work.

Professor Morgan is a nice lady but the course is straight booty. If you don't have a good team for the lab project, get ready to grind like Hell. Lectures were pointless and there were pop-quizzes at the end of some of them. I think I got less than a 50% on the finals but still ended up with an A, suggesting that this class might've been curved.

Lost some brain cells in her lectures, she made me catastrophically dumber. Her explanations of anything and everything is minimal. The midterm is very confusing and you will need help. Lab and everything else is pretty easy though.

For most people that ended up with As, they either ride on their own work, or the work of someone else. Lie about being unskilled in the first lab, that way youll get placed with people who actually have a work ethic. This class gives more work than a 3 credit if youre doing everything on your own. Try not to lose any points EVER.

reviews.comment: The Lectures are unnecessary and boring and the amount of time spent on the class isn't worth the number of credit hours.

reviews.comment: The lecture is no really necessary. Most of the things Prof. Morgan teaches in the lecture can be found online. Prof. Morgan is really nice, but her explanation and teaching are really confusing. ( She doesn't do well on "teaching" us anything, we as student figure it out most of the time)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures are the most useless and obvious things in the world, but attendance for those is a huge portion of the grade. Pray that you get a good group because you may just end up writing half a paper meant to be written by 4 people. Also, don't schedule a class during open lab hours or else you wont be able to work on projects
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Morgan does not care about her students or their success. Her lecture is basically mandatory because she does in class assignments which are a large part of your grade. There is nothing valuable that she teaches in lecture, I'm convicted she does those assignments to boost her own ego. Dont take a class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was pretty easy. She is very good at explaining things. Attendance is not mandatory, but you have lecture assignments that are 20% of your grade, so you can choose if it is worth it to skip. Most of the work for this class happens in the lab, where you do receive attendance points. The lab is group work based.

Went to less than half the lectures and still got a 47% on the finals and STILL 4.0 the class. The lectures were extremely stupid, and I promise, you won't learn a thing from them. The class is group project heavy, so if you get a bad group, you're in huge trouble. Dr. Morgan also looks and sounds like a porcelain doll. Blatant cash grab from MSU!
the lecture is so boring but theres only two tests that aren't that bad at all
Pretty easy class, There's only two exams: miderm and final
Doesn't actually do any teaching. She just reads articles the entire class period and then gives you a lecture assignment to do in 10 minutes when you really need 20.

Almost all the important stuff happens in lab. Hope you get a good group. Occasionally, there will be lecture assignments and those are the only weeks you need to go to class. Don't expect to learn anything very useful in lecture. Dr. Morgan is nice, but not a great prof. There are readings assigned but not checked, and nobody does.

The lecture is completely disconnected from the lab. 50% of the overall grade is group projects. If in a dysfunctional group for the two group projects then getting a 4.0 will be extremely difficult. The lectures are simplistic yet in-class assignments are 10% of grade so skipping is not advised. The final is nearly verbatim from lecture slides.
Great lady, really funny. Lectures were interesting and quizzes/ exams were easy and open-note. Only one other assignment that was fun, easy, and interesting. Easiest class I've taken, easy 4.0

If you can get past dropping $70 to do homework, its an easy class. You learn a lot about anthropology and Dr. King is pretty passionate about it. Almost everything is online, but you have to come to class in order to get participation. 4 units with accompanying exam, quiz, and homework modules. Follow her rubrics/guidelines and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good 8 am class to have.

This class is very easy but there is a lot of homework that counts toward your grade. Quizzes and exams are taken in your own time so they are open book and straightforward as long as you take notes from the textbook and attend lectures. She uses an app to ask questions for class participation which also goes toward your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very easy class that can be done online, and all the tests and quizzes are open note. The weeks you have a test she cancels class for the week. Also she would end class at least 30 minutes early all the time
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. King's class was very fun and eye-opening. Lecture participation questions via TopHat are worth points, so please go. Readings could be a bit heavy (several articles/papers each week), but once you get the hand of efficiently reading them, they aren't bad. Quizzes and tests were very manageable and online. Great class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All online open note tests and assignments were easy.

She was a pretty good professor! I will say her lectures did feel like they were dragging on, but she seems very passionate about what she was talking about. there was one writing assignment, but she gave you a bunch of options, and it was pretty easy. All of her tests were online/open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is based on weekly PackBack assignments (1 drop), 4 exams (1 drop), 4 quizzes (1 drop), one essay (less than 200 words), and TopHat in class questions for participation. Exams/quizzes are online and open note. Weekly readings were sometimes a lot, but you could skim them and still understand the material. Lectures were boring at times.
Loved her, I'd take her class again. She's retiring soon and that makes me sad.

Dr. King is very sweet, but if you have no interest in this subject, please do yourself a favor and find another ISS. The lectures are long and can be boring if you aren't genuinely interested in anthropology. Still, I managed to get a 3.5 in the class not being very interested. She uses TopHat and online assignments.
Turns in grades very late, she is pretty laid back and attendance isn't mandatory but gives bad feedback on projects.

Dr. King is a sweet person and she teaches very nicely despite not a lot of people participating. She's relaxed in all the good ways. You can miss the participation and still 4.0. Her work is doable, or else I couldn't have added this class on. It's the weight it should be. Exams are doable, class is canceled. HW is HW but she sets up for success.
Chillest prof ive ever had. It can be boring but no more than any other iss classes.

King is maybe the most chill and laid back professor at state. All quizzes and exams are open note and technology. class is cancelled the whole week for exams. Homework every week, and a big top hat assignment due before each exam, not hard, but time consuming. attendance isn't required but there are participation points you will miss if you skip.

Simple weekly discussion posts, online textbook work completion that guides you through it, and the fact I didn't show up to a single lecture and still got an A is probably why you should take this class. Professor responds to emails in a timely manner (rare at MSU). Overall nice person
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Second time taking Dr.King. Super easy, online heavy course. There are in person participation points but as long as you do good in everything else, you'll be okay. Interesting course and Dr.King is super nice!
If you need ISS 2XX credit, take this class with her. Easy grading and somewhat interesting lectures.

It is not required to come to class but you must participate by answering questions on Top Hat to get participation points. You will have 3-4 modules to read per test, if you stay on pace they are very manageable. Quizzes and tests are online, you can take them anytime in the week. She is very helpful, easy to approach, and wants the best for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: ISS220 with Professor King has been great! She is extremely knowledgeable, caring, approachable, and incredibly clear on the class structure. Attendance isn't required, but there are in-class points that you'll miss if you skip. The textbook is online. Highly recommend her class. Definitely an easy A if you put in a little bit of work.
easy would recommned

There's a moderate amount of reading and work but it's not at all overwhelming. There is an attendance grade but it comes from answering lecture questions virtually. You can answer them from home if you can't make it to class. It's really easy as long as you show up for most of the classes and don't procrastinate too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take her course if you are looking to compete your 300 level ISS credit. She is such a great professor and it is very easy to pass her classes. Quizzes/exams are all online and you can work on each unit at your own pace. Very great professor and even though it was an 8 am course, I enjoyed going to lecture.

Overall an easy and enjoyable class, she gives plenty of extra credit opportunities through homework and attendance! Exams were straightforward as long as you went to lecture, not too much reading, and plenty of documentaries viewed in class!

Dr. King is a great teacher! She has interesting lectures. The readings are not usually very heavy. There are weekly packback posts, but those usually don't take very long. The quizzes and exam were all online, and you have the week off to complete them. There was a final paper that took a while to write, but if you start early it's not bad at all.

King gave an honors option for the class along with a volunteering extra credit opportunity. She wrote the textbook for the class which is very informative and insightful. Attendance is taken through TopHat, so you can get your attendance points from your laptop if you can't go to class. Not a lot of workload and the best ISS class in my opinion.

Be carful with this professor. She would get upset multiple times at students for little things like coughing and actually threatened to kick the student out of class for it. She has a bad temperament and I would really advise other students to consider other courses unless you want to deal with someone like her.

I had to take this class at 8AM, and I went anyway because I liked this class so much. Great professor, super interesting topics. The best IAH or ISS class I have taken. There are pack pack discussion posts, which are a nuisance, but everything also I really enjoyed.

Overall the class was super clear and organized. The exams were all online and straightforward and the homework was just one packback and some tophat work every week. Professor King is also very understanding and kind which was nice.

Our homework was a TopHat assignment for each unit and a Packback discussion each week. It was relatively easy. You have to buy both TopHat and Packback, but I don't think it is too big a purchase. The exams are pretty easy and all online. For every exam week, she didn't hold class (which was obviously very nice). She is a very sweet prof.

I loved taking her class, she is a very inspirational person and her course was eye opening. For pre classes and homework it was usually video based which I found to be helpful, but time consuming. Overall I recommend!!
She is great!

Prof King is great at helping students understand class material, but her class uses top hat, packback, and multiple textbooks, so be prepared to spend money on those. attendance and participation are both mandatory as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. King's lectures were helpful for understanding course material. She used Tophat to measure participation. There were readings for most classes, but she usually went over the main points in class. There were 4 open note quizzes and exams, with 1 drop (including the final/exam 4 and quiz 4). This class was interesting and easy to succeed in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. King is super sweet and really takes a liking to the content that she presents on. I found that her lectures were super knowledgable for all that were present to listen to her speak. Her exams and quizzes are straight-forward. As long as you take the notes, come to class for the TopHat questions, and do the pack backs, you're golden.

Prof King is super nice and provides an interesting insight into the medical field through this course! As long as you do the PackBacks and participate in the TopHat, you will do just fine. She gives you a week to do the quiz and exam, both of which are open note and easy. I recommend this course to anyone with an interest in anthropology!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor King was great. I had her for ISS 310, and besides the lectures we used packback and tophat. Both of the two were super easy to navigate and not too content heavy. All the quizzes/exams were open note, though they were a little difficult. It was overall a good class, and Professor King was great and I would recommend.

She is super sweet and very easy to listen to! Exams and quizzes are easy as long as you take notes on her lectures. Likes to give personal stories related to the topics in class. Would definitely take again! She does have weekly pack backs, but they are super easy.

Dr. King is super cool. This class was really easy and really opens your mind if you want to pursue a career in the healthcare field. I wish anyone who wants to be a doctor, nurse, PA, etc; to take this course, we would have stronger leaders. As long as you go to lecture, do the packbacks each week, and do the study guide you'll 4.0

I didnt get the opportunity to take this class in person due to Covid, but even so, prof. King was easily the most uninvolved professor Ive ever had. One of the first things we reviewed on the syllabus was a list of types of emails/questions that she just wouldnt respond to and it felt like every module was just copy and pasted from quizlet.

Not very tech savvy, used Tophat for everything besides some discussion posts. Very sweet person, but had a hard time meeting her own deadlines. The module was always released a day or two late. My class was completely asynchronous and I could get the work done weeks in advance pretty much. Easy, but you get out of it what you put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class caused me a lot of stress for sure. A lot of things due at the end of each week, and she's hard to get a response out of. Make sure to read the syllabus so you don't miss any important info about how things are graded and the criteria you must meet. Since the class is online, she uses a lot of different websites for different assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. King was nothing but unprofessional, unethical, and frustrating. She responded to a student's concerns about lessons being released late with "This put me into therapy," and at the end of the semester, she changed the syllabus in such a way that destroyed several people's grades, and when confronted, claimed it never happened.

I took this asynchronous class online in Fall 2020. We had to use a platform called Packback to post and answer questions every Sunday. These posts are worth 20% of your grade, but theyre really easy. Homework is reading the online textbook and answering questions. Quizzes and exams are open note. The class is really easy. No problems w/ prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Marissa was a phenomenal professor! We had weekly readings to do, along with a writing assignment. They were honestly really easy and helped gather material internally. She also had us listen to podcasts that I thought were really interesting. Overall very related human being that made class interesting even when the topics might be boring.

Easily might be one of the best professors at Michigan State; very knowledgeable about the subject, as well as other topics in general. Encourages discussion and makes class very fun! I had this as an 8 am, and don't regret it one bit. If you ever have the chance to have Professor Knaak as your instructor, take it!
Professor Knaak is a world-class professor, and I thoroughly enjoyed her class. Would take again!

She gives weekly assignments to help gather the material, and they're relatively simple. The class has a lot of writing overall, so if writing isn't your thing, that might be an issue. She is very understanding and flexible with different students. Overall, great lecture and awesome teaching

Amazing professor, had her for my ISS class, if you participate in class, and just do your small easy writing assignments on time you WILL have a good grade. Throughout the semester I had no tests, no quizzes, and no exams. Entire class is assignment and participation based with projects and writing assignments. Would take again, wonderful lady. :)

Lectures are well made and interesting, posts lectures online, attendance to lectures isn't mandatory. Small participation credit and weekly readings for recitation, but all easy. Grade is largely based on midterm and final, with some smaller projects mixed in.

Dr. Wood is one of the sweetest professors I've ever had, she does have very lecture heavy classes but it is important to go to make sure you keep up with in class assignments. She offers so many different extra credit opportunities so take advantage of those. She is super kind, I would recommend taking her class!

She always posts assignments after lecture and they're due that Friday at 9am and it's usually about the lab which we have during the week.  We never know what to look out for during our lab and often barely mentions the assignments due Friday during lecture.  Changes assignment due dates often.

Syllabus and schedule change often. Late work gets 50% off—even if it's 1 hour late—though assignments may be graded weeks later. Due Fridays at 9 AM. Little communication with mentor teachers and minimal feedback before the next assignment. Templates are repetitive. Only .docx accepted, no resubmissions. Do work early.

The professor is super nice, always answers questions, and did online reviews before the exams — sometimes giving hints for the tests. Lectures were a little boring, with a lot of info, and a good amount of work. Do the extra credit, it really helps your grade!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: i loved professor wood! she was really sweet really cares about her job the extra credit really does make a impact on ur grade so make sure u do it! she was understanding when it came to any online issues and her lectures were pretty interesting some were boring ans she do online reviews and give hints for the tests i would take her again!

Not recommended. There are only 10 in-class assignments, and missing two due to illness meant no flexibility or makeup allowed. I earned an A, but only by teaching myself. Lectures mainly involve reading directly from PowerPoint slides.
This class included a TON of work, but if you do the work, you will be fine. Do not get behind! This particular lecture is long and boring but if you put in the work, it will be fine.

very nice prof. lectures are super slow and boring, but she means well and explain everything well. I never pay attention in class, no exams, everything is based on connect quizzes and d2l quizzes (no lockdown), 2 larger assignments. Changes deadlines to help people. has difficulties with technology which is hard when ICA dont work.

Her class was mostly connect assignments and weekly quizzes. There were no exams. You barely need to go to her class and she posts before if there is an in class activity. I missed 1 class a week and I still ended with 540/515. Plenty of EC. Her lectures are very boring but I would just finish all of the hw during class.

idk why Dr. Woods rating is so low. She is an older lady so the lectures can be boring but you don't even have to pay attention to the lectures to pass. There is no exams, multiple extra credit assignments, and 1-2 short open note tests a week. literally so easy. I passed with a 535/515 points because of all the extra credit.

Class is beyond easy. Graded by weekly quizzes instead of exams, homework assignments, in class activities, & 2 application assignments. Everything was easy, we only had in class assignment sometimes. She's very sweet & caring. If she's not answering your email, go up to her in class, her and her TA are understanding & more than willing to help.

Kellye is very sweet and kind. She is willing to answer any questions you have in class or look over assignments for you. The class is long, but we end early a lot of the time. There is a good amount of work outside of class, but if you budget time, it's doable. It is difficult to reach her via email, but she does hold office hours.

You can tell she means well, but lectures are so insufferable. Class is structured poorly, there's weekly assignments and quizzes. Overall, work is not difficult, but she is such a boring lecturer and you will learn nothing. She will randomly assign in-class assignments, so even though attendance isn't mandatory, you usually have to be in class.
Insinuated that I needed therapy because her unorganized, unstructured, lack of proper instruction she likes to call lecture caused me to be confused. Needs to be fired.
Lectures are insufferable.

please please please answer my emails ;( 
ive sent her at least 30 emails in the past 2 weeks and not a single one got a response.

never EVER answers emails and will set you back 3 weeks struggling to try and figure out how to still pass the class being 3 weeks behind without a clue on what to do. debating on switching my certification so i dont have to take this class. help.

reviews.comment: Super tedious about small things that don't matter, yet forgets to open up drop boxes every week....
Lectures are boring, makes it hard to engage... especially since they're so late in the day. Emails left un-responded to, don't take this class with her
Overall seems like a nice lady, but if you're not going to respond to emails, don't teach.
All busy work, lesson plans on top of in class quizzes on top of field assignments on top of in class assignments on top of anti bias assignments on top of placements. So unnecessary
Just don't do it, truthfully. If you can take it with anyone else, do yourself a favor and do that.

Take it with her if you want to pull your hair out due to confusion and lack of structure in the class. 
She also doesnt respond to emails

Legit does not respond to emails. I emailed her a total of 23 times over the semester and she didn't reply to a single one. D2L is confusing and the class is unorganized and chaotic. DON'T TAKE IT WITH KELLYE

If you don't have to take this class with her, don't. She claims we can reach out to her anytime, but does not respond to emails. She assigns 100 different assignments per week and is such a tedious grader that one little typo will cost you -3 points. Lectures are pointless, but required. Unhelpful and overall needs to just be done teaching.

Kellye was a fantastic professor. Lectures could be a bit boring but were informative. Great feedback on assignments. If you go to class, go to the lab, and do the work, you should do fine overall. Many complaints come from people who skip class and get frustrated by assignments explained in class. Not the best tech wise but TA is very helpful.

Shes a nice professor and does her best to answer questions. The course itself is very overwhelming, not super organized, lowkey chaotic. Am I learning a lot, yes? But there is so much information being thrown at us at once that it's hard to remember everything and it feels like you HAVE to remember everything. Lots of overlap of assignments.

Do NOT take this class with Kellye Wood!  Her lectures are hard to follow and rarely have anything to do with the homework assignments. Good professor, better human being. Easy class if you have a few brain cells. Show up, there are pop quizzes. Sometimes curves test grades, offers select opportunities for bits of extra credit.

I very much enjoyed this class. I only took it because I had to for a requirement but I enjoyed it much much more than I thought I would. It is important to go and listen to the lectures but everything he talks about is in the exams and there were no surprises for me.

Everyone that's saying "this class is all memorization and not understanding concepts" is completely wrong, I finished this class with a 100% and cant remember my name most days. If you understand the concepts there is no reason that this class will be hard. Most of the "pop quizzes" you get 100 for just doing it, same for homework. Best professor.

Prof K is getting a lot of hate here so I wanted to defend him a bit. He is a fun guy and loves what he teaches and his material is not difficult. Students who struggled with the class did what he said not to do and spent class taking notes instead of just listening to his lectures. Go over the lectures again to study and the class is an easy A.

reviews.comment: Awesome person, super interesting Lectures. All you need is flashcards. Does not allow computers during lectures, all handwritten notes which I typically converted into flashcards. USE FLASHCARDS!!!

I loved Professor K because his classes are always super fun and interesting. He is also a super funny guy and I will really miss having him. The class is pretty easy if you stay on track I never felt like he asked for too much of his students. Definitely take his class if given the opportunity.

Dr. K was a very fun professor, I recommend taking this course. I found it pretty interesting. There are in-class pop quizzes, if you are there in class, then you will get 100%. Very lecture heavy, so make sure you attend class. He explains the material and what he means in the slides in class, so reading just the slides will not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr K is a very well meaning man with an absolutely abysmal teaching style. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really loved his class! Dr. K made learning about bugs super fun, he wants you to be successful and all you need to do is go to class to understand everything. Not too much homework, a couple pop quizzies, and lots of extra credit on tests!! Really enjoyed him as a professor.
Class is entirely based around memorization. Topics felt more like trivia than course materials.

Only took this class to get my ISB credit but was honestly worth it. He is such a funny guy that really cares about his students. He occasionally gives homework that is relatively easy. Four tests and a couple quizzes. Super easy class if you go to every lecture.

I don't recommend this prof at all. Has nothing to do with insects it's completely environmental and ecosystem-based. He gives lots of homework and always has pop quizzes so you don't miss class. He's overly nice to fill in for the fact he wants to confuse you on the exams. Not an easy 4.0.

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. His lectures are awesome and you can tell he really cares about his students and loves his job. While attendance was not mandatory there were pop quizzes so that is something you should take into account. Defiantly would take him again given the chance.
Chose a different professor for this class, he is a great dude but terribly tough prof, so many exams and they are long and difficult. I attended every class yet still continued to do bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Beware of his exams and expect to actually have to try super hard. There is no way you can get an easy 4.0 I am a 4.0 student and I struggled to keep my head above water. reviews.comment: Ryan's classes are not difficult and are actually interesting. He is a nice guy and gives you everything you need to know for the exams in his lectures. He posts the lectures online, so I would recommend not trying to take notes while he teaches and just to listen, because the material is not heavy and can be digested well by just listening.

Ryan was a great professor. He was funny and down-to-earth. The class is easy as long as you show up to the lecture, he has pop quizzes during the lecture, then you will be fine. If you have any issues in the class go to him right away and he will try his best to help. Would recommend taking one of the ISB courses for your prereqs!

Easiest test ever, he gives you 24 hours to take them with open notes. His lectures are optional but they're helpful for test. On the test there's a couple questions he only answered in class. Overall easy class and would take again.

Ryan is one of the nicest professors I understand. He makes you want to pay attention and participate in class. I took it online (obviously given the circumstances) and he was so understanding and kind to everyone. We often start class with a song of his choice and it makes your day. My only complaint is his exams are a little difficult.

Ryan was a pretty good professor throughout, he is definitely passionate about what he teaches which makes this course a lot easier to get over with. The class isn't really about bugs all throughout so that's kind of the only off thing. He also got rid of the final and pop quizzes this semester, not sure if he'll do the same for the spring semester
He has been the funniest prof I have had in years. Dr. K cares about your education, and his class was easy and fun.

Dr. K was a really great professor. It's an easy 4.0 as long as you show up to class. He was really funny and it was one of those classes where I feel like I actually learned. He did have a lot of pop quizzes, though, so be prepared for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing-- Ryan is so passionate about what he's teaching. He makes bugs so fun, and it's a super easy 4.0. If you have a 4.0 before the final, you don't have to take it which is always nice

I definitely recommend you choose professor Kimbirauskas for ISB class. First, he is a really fun and nice guy. Even though the class is about insects, he makes it really interesting. Exams are really easy as long as you pay attention in class and go over the slides. Because of how easy his class is, It helped me focus on my other classes.

Homework most of the time after each class but fairly easy. Attendance not required but dont except to pass if you dont go to the lectures. Really nice and funny guy, enjoys participation. Test can be hard but are fair.

He really tries to relate to his students and uses words like crap. He can be funny or sometimes try to be and fail. The lectures were what helped me pass the tests, if I hadn't gone to the lectures I would have probably failed. Overall all a good teacher, in love with the topic, and fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. I had an 8am course with him and his lectures would actually keep me engaged. His tests were the hardest part of the class since his multiple choice questions usually have six or seven potential answers to them. Only other thing to watch out for are his pop quizzes, which can really help your grade if you just go to class.

He is an awesome teacher. He loves what he is doing and makes his class very entertaining. There are pop quizzes every once and a while, but they are usually very easy. I am not a biology major, yet I would take another class that is taught by him because I learned so much from him!

Overall, a great professor. Attendance is mandatory, though it's not bad since the lectures are actually interesting. It's easy to listen and pay attention, he explains everything very well. Very fair grader and actually cares & wants you to do well. Highly recommend this class to anyone that needs to complete an ISB
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Definitely the best professor I have ever had. You need to attend class because of pop quizzes, but it isn't that bad because he makes it interesting. Do the homework and study what he gives you, you'll be fine. However, make sure to double check your exams when you get them back, the TA's messed up my scores multiple times.

He's really chill, and funny. There are a lot of pop quizzes though, so if you don't go to class you can miss them. As long as you pay attention in lecture and study tests are pretty easy. A good amount of homework is given, but it's graded easily and is easy to do. Class is straight points so just do the homework and study and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Coolest guy ever I would definitely take again. Very funny and keeps the lectures light because it is interesting stuff. If you just do the bare minimum of what he asks you will do fine. Very chill and laid back and will help if you need it.

I absolutely hated science and everything about it but this class is amazing! He is a great professor that makes the material interesting and keeps the class motivated. He is not a hard grader, as long as you know you're stuff then you are fine. I recommend this class If you need to take an ISB.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Students tend to like him because he's "relatable" which is fine but he tries a bit too hard imo.
