I didn't learn very much about neuroscience after taking this class. It was like really easy. It was kind of a bummer, but I got a good grade out of it so... who cares? The professor was really nice and funny though.

Very nice and definitely knows a lot about the material, but this and NEU301 are not an easy 4.0. I never benefitted from the lectures but other people might. Recitations are absolutely necessary to have a grasp on the material.

She was okay, but her lectures are a bit messy, and the grading scale is ridiculous. Her tests are insanely difficult and barely have anything to do with lectures. Also, you barely have any time on the test, so if you don't know the answer right away, good luck. The extra credit offered is your only chance at a 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very, very easy class, with a very good textbook. Probably the best textbook I've seen. Exams can be kind of tough, but they're all open book and open note, so you can Ctrl+F your way through them a lot of the time. I didn't feel like I learned a lot, but it was still a fun class, and definitely a good introduction to neuroscience.

I enjoyed the format of her lectures, but the lectures weren't very helpful for the exams, so what's the point, ya know? The recitations and bonus assignments helped much more. I was glad that 0.5 was added to your grade at the end if you completed the extra credit every week, but everyone needed that 0.5 because her grading scale is ridiculous.

Dr. Hedges is very nice and tries her best to help students understand the introduction to NEU. The exams can be constricting for time, and sometimes confusingly worded. She allows for exam corrections for 1/2 credit on missed content. With a fantastic method of grading and a good course structure, a good understanding of basic biology is required.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hedges is very kind, and easy to contact outside of class. However, the criticism is within her grading scales for her classes. I understand the objective, but it makes it significantly harder to succeed in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good not great. People leaving 1 star reviews must just not be able to handle the material, because she wasn't that bad and it was very straightforward on what needs to be done to succeed. 5 star reviews also confuse me. Overall pretty good tho.

I love neuro and admittedly did not struggle with the subject matter, but I can only imagine how much more miserable this class would have been if that were not the case. Dr. Hedges is truly terrible when it comes to communicating expectations and does not offer students equal levels of assistance. I would avoid classes with her at all costs.
She is awesome

Dr. Hedges is a great professor. The lecture material is all inclusive and the weekly quizzes are not that hard as they could be. Neuroscience is a difficult topic regardless of the professor. Dr. Hedges challenges you, but if you put effort into understanding the material and be ready for exams - easy 4.0. She gave extra credit & exam corrections
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really enjoy Dr. Hedges, she never fails to make me smile even while taking this class remote. The content is hard, but she lays out the information clearly and provides review questions throughout lectures. It is a hard class but she manages to make it bearable. As long as you study and keep up with lectures you'll do well in the class.

Dr. Hedges presents information in a clear, easy-to-understand manner, but you will need to put in the work on your own to fully comprehend it. She made the online class more enjoyable with weekly discussion boards, and while there is a weekly recitation, quiz, and self-assessment, these help you to understand the material much better.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Switched my major because of her. Extremely difficult tests. Weekly recitation, quiz, and self assessment. Would not recommend at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bad explanations could teach material better

Neuro is difficult but Dr. Hedges does NOT make it simpler to learn. She is a great person but bad prof. I studied for WEEKS prior to exams and still failed due to trick questions & harsh grading on the short answers. Multiple choice options can range from A to J with some saying "B, E, and F are true" or "Only A and G are true." A nightmare.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Hedges and would recommend her to anyone! She's very funny and straight to the point.

Dont blame the prof for the material. the class is not a walk in the park but it is so interesting and if you put time in to it you realize how well she explains and prepares you. she gives daily extra credit and if the whole class is not doing so hot she gives out even more extra credit. shes cool and just wants people to learn and do well.

Sometimes rude. The type of professor that only cares about a select few students. I always go to office hours but still have a hard time. Goes out of her way to make most questions on her exams and quizzes very difficult. Like others have said, even if you know the material by heart, the wording of her questions is very frustrating.

Exam questions are too difficult, even for someone who visits office hours and completely understands all of the material. This also applies for the weekly quizzes. She definitely needs a reality check and realize that we are undergrads and not phd students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She does not know how to create fair questions for an intro level course. Even if you understand the material, her questions set you up for failure. So many friends of mine spend hours studying for her weekly quiz and still end up confused. Don't let the grade averages fool you. I hope she is either replaced or learns to create fair questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I didn't really like her, he exams are tricky and confusing. she grades really heavy on the short answer questions. shes rude sometimes when answering qts. her quizzes are hard too, their is one every week. I dont recommand her at all. weekly quizzes are 18.5% you can drop 2 only out of 14, exams are 61%. donttakeher. I wish I didn't take her
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I did not really like Dr. Hedges. She tries very hard to be relatable which can be annoying, but her class comics are funny. The way she grades isn't very friendly to bombing an exam. I didn't even fail the first exam but to get a 4.0, I had to get all the rest of the points for the rest of the semester. Her exam questions are also very confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Hedges is ok at teaching I dont fall asleep while I'm in class so that should say something, but her exams are ducking hard she words it in really hard way no matter how much you study eithr you understand it or you're ducked, her study guide is objectives which is annoying. 61% of your grade is exams and barely any extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wonderful professor. Content can be difficult and although the book is not essential, it's recommended for good reason.

Dr. Hedges is so absolutely incredible I literally don't have enough characters to convey it. Probably the best professor I've had at MSU. She's very new to the university but She. Knows. Her. Stuff. Probably the best hire MSU neuroscience has ever gotten. Exceptional and effective teacher and wonderful human being.

This was Dr. Hedge's first semester teaching here, and I WORSHIP HER. She is super fun in class and loves to incorporate memes into the presentations. She keeps it simple, even when the material is difficult. All the info you need to know is on the slides, so no extra note-taking needed. Much extra credit. DOES NOT BELIEVE IN CUMULATIVE FINAL EXAM!

He was reasonable in his grading and very clear on what he expects to be in the lab report. There are lab practicals after every unit, but he provides the exact questions ahead of time so if you just put in the effort you can easily pass.
This professor was the best professor I have had for biochemistry. Anyone who rates him bad did not put in the effort needed to succeed in this class.

The lectures did not cover the material on homework or exams. He does not respond well if he believes he covered your question, very passive aggressive. The grading system is the most confusing I've ever had, it's very rarely explained why you're losing points but you lose them for every little thing.

Could be a great class but unfortunately turned out to be my worst experience in college so far. Grading feels unfair most of the time and there is no feedback on why your data is inaccurate (only points taken off). Attending class feels unrewarding when exams and notebook questions are 80% on calculations you will never be taught how to do.

just bad. The guy's nice and so are the other professors, but the lab reports and homeworks are just ridiculous, they don't show you how to do it, you just gotta figure it out. The grading on the reports are absolutely horrid. You don't have any other choice but to take this guy. All of my other class have higher credit but I got 3.5 to 4.0. Badddd
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Weise is passionate about biochemistry. He encourages questions but often responds harshly if he feels the question isn't valid. I've not only experienced this myself, but witnessed this toward other students. He is a nice person and can carry interesting conversations, but his responses sometimes made me feel uneasy about asking for help.

Weird structure. Lectures only dive in knowledge and none on the calculations, while homeworks and exams are extremely calculation heavy???? I'm not even bad at math but some of these homework questions are not even mentioned in the lecture or the lecture slides, like at least mentioned how to do them or something. Grading criteria varies. Badddddd
He was the worst grader I have ever had for a professor in college. Unfairly graded all my assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BMB 370 is definitely a challenging class, but it's doable. Dr. Weise is very helpful during office hours, but participation in class is extremely important. Lectures may not require attendance on paper, but Dr. Weise won't help you if you don't go to class. Overall, it was obvious he cared that you learned biochemistry.

Dr Weise is a great professo, he's clearly very intelligent and id passionate about his work.

BMB370 on the other hand is definitely the hardest course I've enrolled in thus far. Practicals are almost impossible to study for, and the final is very difficult. 

If you take this class, you need it as a priority in order to get a 4.0! Very difficult

He is an awesome person and very nice, but BMB370 is very hard. The practical exams are one of the hardest exams I have taken, you have to go to the lab and do everything by yourself and graph the data and everything in 3 hours. the exams are based on previous labs, but are very hard still. He doesn't answer conclusion questions on office hours.

You can tell that Dr. Weise cared that you learned biochemistry, but he was kinda passive-aggressive. The 8 am Monday lecture was not a good time for anyone and he got upset when people did not show up or learned the content. The lab was a bit unorganized and the exams were unfair given the knowledge and time we had to take them.
kind, fast talker, encourages questions and gives good answers.

She is a very kind a helpful person. She gives a ton of extra credit and is very willing to help in office hours or through email. The midterm and final were hard, but you do get a cheat sheet, so it's not that bad. Overall, I really liked her and would take the class again.

Although CEM 252 is rough and can be hard taking this class with Dr.Vasileiou is a must she is so nice and understanding. I had ran out of tries on my aktiv homework she would reset them for me and my friends and she really cares that her students are learning. She gave us a 1pg cheat sheet for the midterm and 2pgs front and back for the Final.

It is clear that this professor cares deeply about this content, while also understanding that for most people, this class is a necessary stepping stone toward other classes. I really appreciated her enthusiasm, and it helped me get through the class. Also, for exams, you get a cheat sheet.

I took this course in-person. Seems to be much tougher when taken in person vs online. Does offer a ton of extra credit though. Attendance is not mandatory. Very little homework.

Would recommend her as a professor, but take online if at all possible.

She was an solid professor. She taught fairly well, but her Greek accent sometimes was hard to understand, but it wasn't too thick. Naturally, since this is orgo 2, it wasn't really easy, but that'd apply to any professor. Only major complaint was that the midterm (and probably final) were very difficult and had poor averages.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a professor, she is good, not bad, but not great either. Lots of extra credit makes it easy, but you can learn the topics much more quickly by just attending recitation. Many times, I found that teaching myself while doing the homework was much more efficient, and the lectures were useless besides earning extra credit points.

I took the online version of Orgo 2 (I think they are getting rid of it though). Had sooo much extra credit. Responded to emails within minutes. Was always willing to stop lecture to answer questions. Great professor.
She was a great professor, this is a very hard class though. Don't let yourself fall behind at all, or you are cooked. You need to remeber stuff from cem 251

Dr. Vasileiou is a AMAZING professor for orgo II. Lectures were twice a week, and attendance was rewarded with extra credit, which she also gave ALOT of through quizzes, homework, exams, etc. Her lectures were super easy to understand, and she was always willing to answer questions throughout the lecture or through email. Best professor for orgo!!!
So so sweet and understanding. TAKE HER FOR ORGO.

Online organic chemistry 2 with Vasileiou was significantly easier than organic chemistry 1. She is a great teacher who is always willing to answer questions during lecture, with quizzes and exams that match up well with what was taught in class. She offers a lot of extra credit, through TopHat questions during lecture and other opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou was a great professor, I was worried about the class since I took it online, but despite the content being hard, it was taught well. There is tons of extra credit in the class so it made a high grade easy to achieve. Professor Vasileiou was super easy to reach and very accommodating if I needed to switch a quiz to another day
Made it so easy but recitations are necessary if you don't understand, lots of time that content specifically came up on quizzes
Lots of extra credit provided, so make sure to get as much as you can. Everything is online and she provides help for any homework in her office hours

TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE WITH HER!!!!! Seriously one of the easier classes I've ever taken, extra credit for just going to the lectures online and answering the tophat questions. Weekly quizzes and 2 exams with no lockdown browser. Basically gives out extra credit for breathing. Super sweet lady and explains and teaches orgo extremely well.

Love this woman, she makes this class incredibly easy to do well. 10% extra credit, lecture is optional, recitation is optional. Only downside is it is a late zoom lecture from 6-7:20pm but she records the lecture. Exams and quizzes are very fair and based off the homework, and all exams + quizzes are online no lockdown browser.

I was nervous to take organic chemistry over the summer but Dr. Vasileiou was an amazing professor. She understood we had lives outside of lecture and often recorded it and gave extra credit to those who watch the live lectures. She was very clear in teaching and broke everything well. If I have a chemistry class I would take it if she taught it.

Organic chemistry is a difficult subject to understand, but Dr. Vasileiou makes the topic easy to understand. She offers so much extra credit so make sure to use those opportunities. Although this is a virtual course, she is EASILY accessible: easy to meet for office hours or test/quiz accommodations. Online homework is a bit tricky so ask for help

Words cant explain how grateful I am to be able to have had Dr.Vasileiou as my orgo professor. If you want to 4.0 this class, YOU CAN! She makes it easy as long as you put in the work and are willing to learn. You don't have to break your back or be a try hard. she gives lots of extra credit and should I say makes enjoying chemistry possible?

I did most of my learning from the textbook, but it goes way more in depth than what is required. Lectures are optional but have tons of extra credit as clickers. There's a good amount of other extra credit too. She is very nice and will give extensions on the quizzes if you need. Accessibility is limited but expected for a class this large.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher for ORGO . Gives many opportunities to do well in the class.  10/10

She is an amazing woman and is always available to help you out. She is quite knowledgeable and makes 252 so easy to understand. She also offers lots of extra credit, and is flexible when you have to miss a quiz. I would advise to do the cengage homework early so you aren't cramming at the last minute. Super chill.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I truly love this woman and I only wish her the best. The class is hard, but she makes it easy for her students and she truly cares about everyone. Homework is hard and most of it is not like what we do in class. She offers lots of extra credit and she cares a lot for her students. Quizzes are MCQ, exams are MCQ and short answer

Dr. V is amazing and clearly cares about the success of her students. The amount of extra credit she offers is insane, and assures students' success in the course. Homework is hard but extra credit accounts for that. Quizzes and exams are easy and also have extra credit in them. If you see her as an option for orgs II definitely choose her.

Class overall seems fine but the homework is infuriating and goes against her reasoning for it helping you learn. You get five attempts per question but the question changes with each attempt and it doesn't actually explain what you did wrong or show the correct answer making is useless and irritating. At least tests are multi choice.

Her teaching style makes topics clear and easy to understand which helps you succeed on exams/quizzes. She's very kind and gives tons of extra credit opportunities. The homework can be annoying but it is really helpful. Easy to get a good grade and to actually understand orgo.

She is fine if you want to take this class and then never think about it again, the only way you will really learn in her class is by teaching it to yourself. she doesn't really teach anything apart from reading the slides. the only way to do decent in this class is by doing the extra credit which you have to pay for. DONT take if you wish to learn

Please take her class for orgo!! She is such an amazing professor. She really wants her students to succeed and offers so much extra credit it is literally impossible to fail the class. People saying its her fault that the averages were so low but organic chemistry is an extremely hard course that I thought she taught very well. Would recommend.
best orgo professor

Dr. Vasileiou was quite literally the best teacher I have ever had for any chemistry class i've ever taken. Not only does she give lots of extra credit but explains the material perfectly. Her tests are exactly what the lecture is on and aren't too difficult. I think it would be impossible to fail this class.

Lots of extra credit offered in this class. Quizzes/ exams are very clear with what will be on them. Personally, I thought the bookwork problems were sometimes more challenging than the tests. Attendance to lecture helps grade with in class EC everyday! She walks through the practice questions which I found really helpful.

If you need an easy orgo class Dr. Vasileiou is your best bet. I do think, quality wise, she is good, but with how stale the lectures are and how easy she makes earning extra credit, actual learning is difficult. I do not recommend if you will actually need orgo in the future unless you can concentrate super well.

This professor was the fairest professor I have ever had for a chemistry class. She gave so much extra credit that if you do it all it is IMPOSSIBLE to get anything less than a B. She gave amazing practice problems for each lecture that were nearly identical to the quizzes. The midterm was a bit tough but very doable. I recommend taking orgo w/ her

She seems like a nice lady, and you will get a good grade in this class if you apply yourself. My problem is that the class is too easy and I didnt learn anything. As a premed student thats a problem. I had her class online synchronized, her zoom lectures are awful. Camera off, cant ask questions just chat, made it difficult to engage.

Great Orgo prof. Class is not overly hard. Dr. V's office hours are very good, you learn a lot when you ask her questions. By far one of my favorite profs I've had so far. I also retained a lot of what was taught in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was great and made it super easy to do well in the class. Everything was organized and there were no surprises when it came to quizzes and exams. Tons of extra credit to boost your grade if you need it. The homework can be a pain at times (but the TA's at office hours are extremely helpful). Super nice and accommodating if you have to email.

Loved this class. She goes slow with the content so you actually understand. Makes orgo easy and fun to learn! Her tests are not crazy hard and are simple. Definitely attend lectures and take notes tho because due to her strong accent its hard to rewatch and properly make sense of what is being said. However, she is amazing and accommodating !
She is really nice. Since it's Orgo, make sure you attend her lecture and ask if you have any confusion. The extra credits will save your life but try to score well on quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Without her generous amount of extra credit I probably would have had a 3.0, but ended with a 4.0. She has moves very quick but gives direct lectures that are easy to take notes off of.

Such an amazing professor. She makes a weed out class like orgo into an easy a. So much extra credit is offered on all quizzes and exams. Focus during her lectures and it will be easy to pass. Activities even replace the lowest quiz grades. Do the practice sets she offers before each quiz, and you will be fine. Also answers emails very quickly.

She wants her students to pass, and she offers a lot of extra credit opportunities. She is understanding of health issues and let me take a quiz at a later date when I was too sick to take it on time. Textbook is required to purchase, but I never used it. As long as you attend all lectures and do the homework you will easily pass.

She is a very nice professor, she explains things thoroughly although can be a bit confusing at times. Orgo is going to be a hard class in general but I found keeping up with her pace and organization a bit difficult.

This professor makes the class so easy to understand. Some of the hardest topics of organic chem are made easy because of her teaching style. She is very fair with grading and her quizzes and exams are super easy and straightforward. She gives so much extra credit is almost impossible to fail or even end with a C for that matter. Her class is great
I absolutely adored Professor Vasileiou! She explains organic chemistry in an open way that makes it easier to understand. Definitely one of my favorite professors so far!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou made organic chemistry manageable and enjoyable. I took her for the summer class which is accelerated, so be ware that it is fast paced. She is superb in her abilities to explain concepts and gives out practice problems that replicate her exams. Attending class is extra credit and it is super manageable to 4.0

It's orgo, it's going to be hard. Being online made it slightly easier to access notes, but there is lots of studying! All lectures were posted, so most attendance weren't mandatory except for quiz periods, but extra credit was offered DURING class. She's slightly hard to understand but she knows her stuff. Plenty of points in the class!

Good class. I was challenged but I learned a lot. She offered a lot of alternative assignments to continue our understanding yet have the chance to earn extra credit. Going into this class I thought I was going to hate it but now I actually enjoy organic chemistry

Dr. Vasileiou made Orgo 1 more than possible to 4.0, let alone pass. Her lectures are very clear and to the point -- take notes on what she taught, stay on top of homework, and do practice problems -- you will be just fine. She offers lots of extra credit which is helpful considering the difficult content. I highly recommend her as a professor!

Dr V was amazing for orgo 1. Her extra credit made the class very forgiving if you did bad on the quizzes. If you take notes based on the lectures the quizzes will be super easy for you. Def take this prof

Overall a cool prof, hard class material but nothing much you can do about it. Allows honors option, answers emails fairly quickly. Quizzes and tests are kinda hard but she doesn't try to trick you, answers every question during lecture, lots of opportunities for extra points.

She is an amazing professor. She has very clear grading criteria, and offers a lot of extra credit points. Many people complain about organic chemistry being a difficult subject, however she breaks it down so nicely. Her exams and quizzes are like her notes, and she is very flexible with grading and due dates! She wants to see students succeed!

I loved her. She cared so much if people understood what was going on in lecture and answered about every question people asked which was almost a little too much because at some points I wished we would have already moved on. Each quiz and exam has extra credit on it. Responds to emails very timely. Wish she was teaching orgo 2 in the spring!
Great professor. Lectures are very easy to follow and understand and she gives a TON of extra credit so it's very hard not to get an A.

She gives the best lectures and makes sure that you understand the concepts. All her lectures are on chalkboard so she does not post her lectures online. She provides ample practice problems which are really helpful. DO NOT FALL BEHIND, otherwise it will be very difficult to catch up. make sure to do the practice problems and mechanism practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: if you don't get an A in this class you should probably reconsider your major.

AMAZING teacher and the class is not too difficult given the topic is orgo which in itself is hard. Gives lots of extra credit, and explains topics very well. Definitely the best in the organic chemistry department at MSU. Do whatever you can to get in to her class vs others!!

Dr. Vasileiou is an AMAZING orgo prof. She is very clear on what she expects on all of her exams and 'pop quizzes.' They say the quizzes are random, but she will give you a heads up about them and tell you exactly what will be on there. As long as you attend the lecture and take thorough notes, there is no reason to not 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Everything on here is absolutely correct. Dr. Vasileiou is an amazing teacher and a LIFESAVER when it comes to orgo. Don't take anyone else. Extremely nice, everyone in the class LOVES her. Takes really difficult material and breaks it down methodically. Whatever they're paying her, it isn't enough!
Amazing professor who knows what she's talking about. She makes orgo understandable. Prepares you really well for every quiz and exam. Also gives you many opportunities for success and extra credit.

Organic chemistry sucks, but taking it with this professor made it better. Her accent makes it a little difficult to understand her at times, but you can expect exactly what the exam is going to be like and she is very clear with her notes

She writes all notes on the chalk board which i liked. Exams are all written with maybe 4 multiple choice questions. 3 exams and a final and 5 quizzes. one quiz and one exam gets dropped. Would recommend doing the honors option, a 10-15pg paper on a drug or a concept, really pretty simple. She's super nice and really chill.

Dr. Vasileiou is the best for orgo at MSU. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see you succeed in her class. There is a lot of material and it's a tough class but she is very straightforward about what will be on exams and quizzes. Highly recommend going to recitation, it's really helpful! Extra points on every exam and quiz too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nothing from lecture gets posted online so if you dont go you wont pass. Class is fairly easy considering the challenging topics
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She writes lectures on the chalkboard so you need to go to class. Recitations were helpful too. An 85% is a 4.0 so it is do-able. She puts extra points on quizzes and exams. Graded by 4 quizzes, 2 exams, and a final. If you study and go to recitation it's not impossible. The workload is low since there's no homework, just studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She makes the exams fair and gives students every opportunity to do well in the course, she knows the material extremely well and is very good at relaying this knowledge to her students.

This lady completely sold me on organic chemistry. The exams are reasonable, and the lectures are interesting (especially when she gives you backgrounds on some of the chemicals she's talking about). She's very helpful if you have a question, and won't hesitate to give refer you to someone for research.

Only grades are exams, quizzes, and possible extra credit. No homework to cushion your grade, but less work to do overall. Exams are very hard. However, lots of partial credit is given if it shows that you tried. Hard subject but best professor to teach it.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This class is all lecture and memorization. She is Greek and has a very heavy accent. I would recommend taking this class at a time other than 8 am. Do the practice problems or it will be nearly impossible to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's such an amazing professor and really knows what she's talking about. She's open to class discussion. She gives difficult tests, but they don't stray from the class material. She never tests on anything that she doesn't explicitly lay out in lecture. I highly recommend her for anyone taking organic chem.

Very organized professor, sets students up for success (gives EC and drops 1 exam and 1 quiz). Gives lots of practice problems. What you need to know for the exams is made very clear. She is very Greek and has an accent but I have never had a hard time understanding her. She writes very clearly on the board. I 4.0'd 251 and I'm in 252 with her now.
Great teacher. Gives lots of extra credit on each test and quiz. Also gives two chances to do extra credit assignments.
stay away from this professor, he needs to retire.

He's a very nice guy but the quizzes are setting you up for failure. He doesn't give you practice questions so you're blindsided by the questions. The midterms are very difficult as well. He doesn't even try to help his students do well
The mid terms are rough, it's like 25-30 multiple choice questions and then 2 short answer questions with like 8 parts each. I would never even finish the exams.

His class was by far one of the most difficult to sit through. He is a really nice professor, but the class is difficult. I would recommend going to class and reading the book because it really helps. Otherwise you will be completely lost.
hardest class you will take as an econ major or even at MSU. But professor Woodbury does a great job making sure you understand the material. He gives chances for extra credit, so go to class.
I liked his class EC380, quiz's were very easy, midterms kinda hard, final was pretty tough but an easy 3.0 overall. Good class and good teacher.

Dry, uninteresting lectures. Book work was easy, yet didn't have much to do with what was done in lecture or on exams. Overall an easy course, just be careful not to fall asleep: it's really easy in this class.
Completely unable to connect with students. The work was easy, but the lectures are tedious and uninspired.

Dry class, dryer professor.  Be prepared to listen to mundane details like OSHA-specified toilet seat dimensions.  Be prepared to get no credit on homework because you didn't staple it.  Be prepared to get test questions wrong because he gave the wrong answers.

World's harshest grader. Says he wants “robust” answers, but no matter how hard you try it's not good enough. You can have the answer right on assignments but he will mark it wrong because it's not “robust” enough.
qwertyuiop
Very laid-back course, watch lecture videos and then complete an open-book quiz. There is a presentation due at the end, you have a lot of freedom in selecting the topic and it wasn't too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Receptive to feedback about how the class is structured and not a harsh grader if you put a decent amount of effort in. Almost weekly quizzes based on the horrifically boring textbook, but he's cutting the textbook for future semesters! Group projects could be rough if your group didn't show up but he would accomodate if you reached out about it.

Interesting discussions that are done mostly in small groups in class, can be frustrating if your group members do not show up but if you reach out to Dr. Wilson he will penalize them and is willing to work with you.

Dr. Wilson was a great ISS professor. There was almost no outside of class work except for quizzes that we had a week to do. There was group work, but it was often worked on in class. His lectures were interesting and talked about a variety of subjects. Overall, I would highly recommend this class if you needed to take an upper-level ISS class.

Dr. Wilson is a great professor, his class is very organized, outside work is rare (besides short readings) and his lectures are interesting. Highly recommend if you're looking for an upper level ISS!

The course is okay, but feels all over the place, and Dr. Wilson feels like an odd pick to lead it. He's a fine guy, but he doesn't really bring any unique or applicable knowledge to the content. His assignments are also pretty hard to follow and feel confident in. It seems like it would be far better suited as a CSUS class with a CSUS professor.
Great professor! Loved his lectures and he was by far a bright spot during my first semester. Has online quizzes which are not that difficult. Would definitely recommend this course.

His instruction can be hard to understand. Takes FOREVER to put grades in. He finally puts in group project grades and ridicules my group for "insufficiency" and that we were supposed to be writing our projects formally. This was NEVER mentioned neither directly or in the rubric what kind of writing he wanted.

I went was a car accident early in the semester. This left me without a car and living alone. Because of this, I fell behind in class. DO NOT FALL BEHIND FOR ANY REASON. He is unforgiving and even emailing his asking for grace because I was in a car accident, he would not give me any extra time. Don't have any unexpected major events in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wilson seems to be the worst professor ever because of not properly teaching the material to other students in that class except listing 2 words yet he didn't seem to explain what the terms are except it was covered in Robbin's textbook

One of my favorite classes I've taken! The content was genuinely interesting, and even a year after completing it, I've still retained a lot of the information. He is a very passionate and cool guy. I recommend taking this course.

Very easy and runs his classes great! One notable thing he did was give us midterm evaluations to fill out. He did this to ask us things that we like to change about the course, then proceeded to make the changes we asked for. He really wants all his students to succeed!

I wasn't sure what to expect from this course, but it ended up being one of my favorites! Usually online courses are iffy, but I felt I learned and really enjoyed the content. It was clear what was expected from me as a student, and I would 100% recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Wilson was great! Before this class I didn't really like geography but he sparked a new interest. On Tuesdays he would lecture, and on Thursdays we would watch an episode of a docu-series. We had a couple group projects, but nothing impossible. No midterm or final. Overall a class I looked forward to going to.

Dr. Wilson is a very nice professor that cares for his students. The class was very interesting. There is a lot of reading and you take one quiz per week on the reading. There are also group projects but no midterm or final. Tuesday were lecture days and Thursday he would show episodes from Parts Unknown from the region we were learning about.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Each unit was basically a whole continent. We had two attempts at each quiz and this was a majority of our grade. We also had to create an entire website about a random geography thing happening in the world.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Jeff Wilson for both Fall & Spring semesters of my Freshman year, and both courses were in Geography. I really enjoyed going to his lectures and learning about different cultures and places around the world. Jeff is definitely a very relatable person and you can tell that he cares about his students.

I took this class online and it was the BEST decision ever. Each week you learned about a new region of the world. The weekly quizzes were easy as long as you read the material/watched the video. He replies fast to emails and cares about his students a lot. If you can take this class ONLINE instead of the in person one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a good professor although the class was weird, like we had to watch Anthony Bourdain almost every class and attendance was mandatory for some reason. No final though, just a group essay and the quizzes are all straight from the book.

Dr. Wilson has no sense of direction in his class. He will tell you this class is about veganism on Tuesday but on Thursday, we would be talking about Indigenous history. Additionally, he did very little actual teaching, majority of his class his spent watching videos. I would recommend a different professor especially for an ISS class.

The professor doesn't have a good grasp on the course of the schedule and completely disregarded quizzes on the academic calendar so better have everything in check and scheduled correctly. Good luck cooperating with him when reaching out if you have issues in his flawed way of his class system.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Wilson focuses the class on  a travel food show with each world region to incorporate culture and excitement into the class. There is a textbook you need for homework quizzes and he assigns lots of NYT articles. You get put in groups that you do most graded assignments with. There is no exam only a final group paper.
I like his class structure, especially the individual conference where I usually receive very helpful feedback.

He seems super nice but he gives minimal criteria and zero guidance. His comments when grading an essay were “good” and that's it. He's nice but he doesn't teach you anything about writing and repeats himself a lot during the lecture.
He's easygoing, but more importantly, he's a truly original professor. I really appreciate his efforts to make the class engaging and the many creative ideas he brings.

Took his writing 101 course for this semester. He's a cool and super friendly teacher! Always willing to help you when you have questions. A lot of small homework but they only counted as the participation grade. 3 essay, 1 research paper, and 1 remix Video throughout the semester but they were really easy. Easy grader.

He does not use D2L in a user-friendly way; it is nearly impossible to find materials, and he does not enter grades into the grade book, so you have no idea what the grade is for the whole class. During the two-hour lectures, he talks in circles and often will pick on someone to read because he does not want to. He is very nice but not the best.

Very easy professor, has lots of online/no classes due to one-on-one zoom conferences after each project assigned. However, he often gives unclear and bad feedback. Is a very easy grader but does NOT put grades into the grade book at all. There is no way to see your grade on d2l, and he has extremely boring lectures. Take if you want a 4. though
The class can get boring, but he's a super sweet and understanding professor. There is homework, but it is really easy, and he's a really easy grader. I would recommend him as a professor

He's pretty straightforward with the assignments, He's really nice and understanding. If you're sick or anything and miss class he's flexible with that. He does have an accent which can sometimes make it hard to understand but he's so nice and is an easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: You do so many assignments and it doesn't go into the grade book, only the papers go into the grade book. I think maybe it counts in the participation part of the grade but it's not a large enough portion to make it worth it. Easy grader, didn't mind having him, fun guy and really sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, very understanding. Do the work and its a guaranteed 4.0
Would take again

Extremely boring lecturer. He doesn't prepare in advance, rather choosing to open up the textbook and figure it out as he goes --- often leading to several minutes of silence as he stares at the board trying to figure out a mistake. 

Email communications with him were oddly aggressive and created an unwelcome classroom environment.

Avoid.
Unorganized and very unenthusiastic lecturer. Put zero effort into preparing for lectures and often made condescending remarks.
The best geometry professor ever.
It is my first coding course. I loved it.
Best experience ever
It is fun for this introduction course. I had zero background for statistics before taking this course and I was so confident now after taking it.

The prof truly cares for his students with his primary goal being that course helps prepare for the CS/DS job environment. However, the course is very unorganized when it comes to prep for quizzes/exams. focused on statistical theory rather than implementation in code. I recommend using the stanford videos on youtube to help learning the theory.
Learn so many from the class
Love his class!

I enjoyed having Dr. Xie for CMSE 201. He is funny and good at encouraging class discussion. The course heavily emphasized being a "flipped classroom", but I think the "lectures" should have been longer, and I did not feel there was enough direct instruction from him. Sometimes I had difficulty understanding him. Also, the TAs were excellent.
If you never coding before, then Prof xie will be the best person to let to getting start. I will absolutly recommend you to choose his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very caring. Enjoyed the class. You need to have required preliminary courses before taking this one. A lot of students couldn't even do integral before taking this course, which would be a disaster.
He is a great professor. Had him for Stt 441 two years ago. Really want students to succeed and is helpful in and outside of the classroom.
Great teacher

Professor Yuying Xie, XYY, Superman, Clark, or whatever you want to call him is (for me) definitely the best professor I have had at MSU. I have had him in multiple classes and each time he has been helpful, engaged, and understanding towards students. His high level courses (i.e CMSE 382) will most likely whoop you but he makes sure you'll pass.
Good experience
Enjoyed

I liked how he did multi-week labs so that we didn't have to show up every single week, however the tedious lab reports were killer depending on who your lab partner is. There were 7total labs, and 7 written lab reports. They weren't crazy challenging but definitely took time and got annoying fast.
Great lectures. Well prepared and knowledgeable

Best professor I have had for Physics at MSU. Xianglin is very enthusiastic while lecturing, easy to understand, and leaves you excited for the next lecture. Xianglin makes sure every student in his class understands the topics that are being covered. He also asks students questions about new content to further engage the class. Amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Rens class was online for me, and it was probably one of my easiest classes. You are only graded on about 7-8 essays throughout the semester, thats it. I will say however, she didn't grade anything for me for about a month and a half. But overall it was a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Xuefei Ren class. She talks a lot about urbanism and how it's related to sociology. Lot's of interesting perspectives and readings.

The entire semester is only out of 100 points so you cant miss many. The only grades were 5 short essays and 2 exams. The grading scale is really generous. The essays are easy 100%s but the exams are not.
Great prof! Class based 70% on tests, but grading scale is great! (4.0 90%, 3.5 80%, etc)

He wears a mask during class which makes his talking very muffled when he speaks, so it is very difficult understanding what he is saying. The class structure wasn't decided by him directly but it makes it hard to succeed in the class.

Mike Wiser has given attitude each time I have raised my hand and asked for help. Not only is he very discouraging, but his class has the worst structure that any class could possibly have. I would also like to add that it is impossible to hear Dr. Wiser even when I am 100% focused.
I truly felt he had the class set up to fail. You get 3-4 different assignments during class to do with your group. Class is a waste of time and money.
"Active learning cycle" is not an excuse to not teach your class

for some reason we have to teach ourselves all of the material outside of lecture and then we go to lecture just to sit in a group and do an abnormally difficult worksheet. Plus he is rarely very nice to a student who has a question or is not understanding the iclicker assignments.

So much work for a 2-credit lab. Knowledgeable about the material, but he aims to correct rather than teach you where you are. If you don't know how to use RStudio, learn immediately. Incredibly strict grading. would not take again

Dr. Wiser is a fine lecturer. Easy to understand and learn from, but don't even try asking questions. He interrupts students and is extremely condescending. I can tell when he grades my assignments because he is out for blood. I hope he knows this is an intro course. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN, I have suffered all semester.

Seems very conceited and snobby, and not very good at lecturing. Unclear about what certain assignments are what, and doesn't respond to emails. Avoid participating in his class, as multiple times this semester I witnessed other students get essentially made fun of by him for wrong answers. If contemplating taking him for honors, don't.

idk why he has such bad reviews. maybe people don't like his stern-ness/attitude. he was very helpful, reached out to me when he didn't have to and graded very fairly. he definitely enjoys biology. attendance is necessary, but you can miss a couple and be fine. only thing i could see is he can be a bit condescending sometimes, but probs needed lol

Truthfully, I don't think your professor matters that much for bio 161. All the classes are ran the exact same and is a flipped classroom. You do group activities in class, and watch the lectures as homework (awful). I pretty much taught all the material to myself, and the only reason I got an A was the help room videos. To get an A, 100% watch.

In his class be prepared to spend 1-2 hours before watching the pre class activities where the recorded lectures are for the day that is not taught by him. There is also in class activities everyday to complete. Overall my biggest issue with this class is that he didn't teach me anything, I did all my learning from google docs and a womans lecture

Dr. Wiser is a overall great professor. Gives good feedback, connects well with his students. One thing about bs 161 is there are video lectures and a pre class activity to complete and then during the class you work on an in class activity after he gives a short lecture. The ULAs and the professor are really helpful when you have questions.

Dr. Wiser is a really nice guy, I always enjoyed and appreciated talking to him! I'm not a bio guy, but he made the lab enjoyable enough for me to not dread it every week. Heard a lot of people complain about his grading, but the rubrics and instructions are very clear, and he gives feedback on why you lost each point.

He was very helpful in class and took the time to get to know students and teach one on one. I went to office hours a few times and they really helped. He's a bit awkward sometimes but has very good intentions and teaching style.

The slowest grader I have ever met on the planet. Also takes off random points for no reason and doesn't tell you how to fix it. Takes weeks to upload the lecture slides to D2L. Answers every question with another question and makes you feel stupid. Not a great prof, but if you do the work and go to class it'll be ok.

The professor himself is interesting to listen to, but the way the course is organized is horrible. There are in-class assignments every day that are extensive. Tests are unfair and graded heavily. I had an A in the class until the final that was completely irrelevant to anything we learned and reviewed. I ended up with a 3.5.

Mike is probably the worst professor I've had during my time at MSU. He is very condescending and provides unclear answers when you ask him questions, he does not respond to emails, and there were multiple times that I had to contact my advisor and the BS department chair. VERY easy course but he makes it far more complicated than it needs to be.

This class was required for me and seeing the ratings for Dr. Wiser intimidated me in the beginning but after reading past ratings I think he has changed the structure of the course a good amount. The topics were pretty straightforward and the exams aligned with the material. The one thing I will say is that the homework is very harshly graded.

If this is the only professor open for BS162, take it the next semester.  He grades hw harshly, takes points off for things on exams that are objectively right, has no sympathy, and is lazy. He takes points off on the exams for 0 reason when the answer is right. This is the first review I have every written on a professor, I felt it was necessary.

He gives no drops, no makeups, and zero sympathy for mistakes. ULAs also take points off for things like a spelling error. His HW questions are ambiguous, and you get marked off if you answer in a way he doesn't agree with. One of my exams I failed, even though objectively I got every question right, but he didn't agree with the explanations.

At first I thought he was great, he talks like hank green and was just a harsh hw grader, but then I submitted a blank homework on accident and it was worth quadruple the amount of any other homework and I asked him even if I had proof the file wasn't changed if I could get SOME credit and he was stern about not changing it and I literally cried

This guy is extremely harsh when it comes to grading home work, doesn't add what you did wrong, and gives you a bad grade. Another thing is the lectures, in lecture you cant even read the board half the time, either its too blurry, or to bright, another thing is he always skips through the slides, whenever you try to take notes he will just skip it

The layout of this class is a lot initially and will be tough to navigate.
My advice is to take the pre-lecture videos extremely slow and draw and understand everything before class. You NEED 1-2 hours of work on the pre-lectures if you want to do well in this class. Attend lecture, learn more. Study the RIQs for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you take BS 161 at MSU the class is structured the same for all of the classes, that's why none of the professors teach in this department. He expects that everyone knows everything about the upcoming lecture BEFORE class time. He said the text book is mandatory and I never bought it and I still passed, I just watched the videos he posted.

This was by far the hardest class I have had to take. You have to teach yourself and come to lecture very prepared. The content learned outside of class is nothing compared to what they actually have you complete in-class. Attendance is mandatory because your in-class assignment is graded for correctness which is shown through i-clicker.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!! He believes that his students do not do well because they should study harder but in reality he just does not teach. You are assigned online lectures that are not in depth and does not relate to the quizzes or exams. Spent hours upon hours on this class and still really struggled.
Terrible class. Quizzes every week that they grade harshly, a lot of inconsistency when grading the 2nd attempt of quizzes.

This class was way harder then it needed to be. The topics were very basic and easy to understand but the exam questions were so hard and confusing. The people who grade the exams and homework are also very picky and take points off for the littlest things. The professor did give a very generous curve cause everyone was doing bad so that was nice.

This was Dr. Mike Wiser's first time teaching this class and you can tell. No textbooks at all so you can't read anything outside of class. The lecture content was easy but when it was time for exams, the content was all of a sudden difficult, and not all what he taught in lectures. He also doesn't seem friendly or nice. I would not recommend him!

Makes content seem very simple in lectures, but then tests on content that has not been taught. Exams are much harder than practice exams and in class activities. There will be questions that you were never taught how to answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He made the course is harder than it needs to be for a 100-level. His homework and in-class assignments are unlike the actual exam content. He gave us useless material at noon the day before an exam like it was helpful. His exams are the majority of the grade. This was his first time teaching the course and he was very unforgiving. So frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unfortunately, "Professor" Wiser will read these reviews and say, "Well if only my students studied harder!". He has an ego that everything is based on his students performance and that he is the best professor. What he fails to realize is that his teaching methods are flawed and in 90% of cases so ineffective that 50-70% of his students fail! Haha

I feel like I was set up to fail. Normally this should be an easy class. This was his first time teaching this course, and he made it so hard. The material itself is easy, but the entire grade is 70% exams. He is a very harsh and picky grader. It doesn't matter if you are good at bio, if you don't do well on exams, you are screwed.

Dr, Wiser is possibly the worst professer I have ever had. He sets you up to fail unless you are the smartest person in the world. The disrespect he has for students is beyond me especially when they try to particpate in class he embarresses them. When asking for help he answers questions with questions and made me feel dumb. Plus tests are hard!

He should not be in a classroom. I strongly believe he should stick to what he knows - his PHD and research. Do not teach a low level class and mess up all of your students mental health. He ruined my love for biology and my love for studying in general. I don't know why MSU let him teach. I wish I dropped out of his course and took it later.

Dr. Wiser is a pleasant person, his lectures aren't the worst, but they're not engaging. The work we do in class does not prepare us for the exams because of the different wording and pressure. The concepts are the same but they make it difficult to understand compared to in class work. You also will need to attend lectures to be able to pass.

Many reviews say that exam questions don't match the material, but I think it's more so that students aren't  prepared properly for the high level questions given. He's pleasant as a person but makes this course too hard for 100Lv class. I wouldn't say you should be scared to take his class but definitely be prepared to study. I give him 2.0 grade.

The beginning everything was going well with the pre-recorded quizzes because they will say what is right or wrong but after that week. The quiz does not give you the answers and every lecture I have no idea what is right or wrong anymore. The RIQ in the first week was 1hr but now is shortened to 30mins and I cant skip the question no more
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Story and his ULA are so kind but MAN they have no clue what is going on. Expecting things to be graded but then they aren't, not knowing how to explain what the rubric requires on the assignments, VERY specific word-by-word grading... unless you're always asking your ULA for their opinion, you're kinda screwed on grading. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've seen a lot of people on here say he is condescending and a terrible professor. I have never once felt he was either of these things. He gives extremely good feedback and is always willing to help. He also tries to make a connection with students and that's not something I see a lot of professors do. Definitely would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: 100% the worst professor I've ever had. Anything he says in lecture contradicts any lecture videos or anything on the quizzes or exams. He is also very condescending and rude. I 100% will never take a class he teaches again and wish I would have read his reviews prior to enrolling.

Honestly, one of the most condescending people that I have ever met. I had him for BS 172, and I received a 25% on the first lab because my box plots were not the same color. If you can avoid taking him, please do. He expects everyone to understand the RStudio, when I have never coded before in my life.

Dr. Wiser is incredibly smart and understands what he's teaching. The problem is, he can be very disrespectful in class and unavailable outside of class. I had him for lecture and he always seemed to be in a bad mood, especially when iClicker wasn't working right.

I would not recommend taking his class, however, it is not the end of the world.

Dr. Wiser is a bit of a nerd- but he knows what he is doing is excited about it and is good at explaining things. Sometimes he'll talk your ear off but is genuinely a nice guy. The class was pretty rigorous- use every extra credit opportunity even if you think you won't need it.

Where do I start!??! If you're currently picking classes and his name pops up DROP IMMEDIATELY. it is borderline impossible to get above a 80% in any of the assignments he grades. I've unfortunately taken two classes where he was the primary grader and I was torched by him.

Do not take Wiser if you have a choice. I had him for BS172 and BS161. In BS172 specifically he was clueless. He graded post labs, taking off points for the smallest things. He answers questions with questions. He is condescending when you asking him things. He will NEVER respond to your emails, he literally refuses. Overall, DONT TAKE HIS CLASSES!

Dr. Wiser gets a really bad rep. but I honestly did not mind his class. I had him for lab instead of lecture so I know this class is a LOT easier than this lecture class. We had two professors in this class and I think everyone in my lab preferred him over the other professor. Only cons is he is a tough grader and answers questions with a question.

BS 161 is definitely a weed out class. Its meant to be hard. The professor definitely knows what hes talking about  so i ranked him well, but he makes things harder than they need to be. A word of advice: really study for those exams(especially #2) bc you get 3 questions at a time & arent allowed to back track to questions you already answered
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Literally 3 quizzes a week plus reading plus outside lectures. Only do iClicker and group work in class EVERY TIME. Doesn't even lecture or explain to help anyone understand what we're doing. Grades extremely harshly on written questions on exams and didn't tell us what would cause us to lose points until AFTER. Overall, worst prof I've ever had.

Dr. Wiser seems like a good person but he talks a LOT and it gets boring fast. This class is ALL work outside of class, you have a pre-class assignment, pre-class quiz and pre-class lectures to watch before class 2x a week. Then at the end of the week you have to take another quiz. All you do in class is group work which can suck with a bad group.
Such a condescending person who shows no respect to students whatsoever. No help with anything in regards to the e portfolio and expects you to figure it all out with no help.

Such a condescending person who shows no respect to students whatsoever. No help with anything in regards to the e portfolio and expects you to figure it all out with no help. Worst teacher I have ever

Worst professor Ive ever had honestly. Your entire grade relies on the Exams. Iclicker quizzes on zoom are hell too, 15 seconds per questions and are graded for accuracy. Never had a professor give a pre class assignment, pre class quiz, in class assignment, in class quiz, and review quiz on every single class day, so draining. Run.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class spring of 2021 but am coming back to write this to warn people to AVOID this professor at all costs. He is the most condescending person I have ever spoken to and I have never seen a more poorly organized class. You could spend 24 hours in a day studying the material he provides and non of it would match the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you can, take the lab on a not busy day. Long 3 hour labs with no break (unless you count sitting in silence with your group a break). If you have questions he or a TA is usually in the help room. Lots of group work, you are basically stuck with the same group all semester, so if your group is bad then you are in for a headache.

reviews.comment: He is not a bad professor but he can be a bit confusing sometimes. The class can also seem a little disorganized. The lab is very presentation and group work heavy.
