reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bad teacher lectures are forever long and if you miss even one you can guarantee yourself that you will fail the quiz. So much stuff to do and you have to take time out of you testing to scan your documents turn them into a pdf and turn them in online. I would never take her again she was absolutely no help. If you can't learn fast don't take it.

I took more notes in class than I learned. If you want to learn whats going on, you need to go back and read your notes over and over again, or watch another professors videos. Her class is also very fast-paced. Then theres all the hw on webwork, which has a registration fee. Ive also pulled all-nighters studying for exams.

If you want to do well go to lectures and print the notes she gives you. You can also drop 2 quizzes and 1 exam which is nice. She teaches at a very good pace, just stay on top of notes and homework and you will be fine. Definitely recommend and would take again.
I had to watch the other teachers lectures to understand the material.

I never went in person to a lecture, because I could never pay attention. Exams and quizzes are always more difficult than what you learn in lecture, no extra credit, but you do get drops. Overall wasnt the worst ever, but wouldnt recommend if you cant learn at a fast rate!

I am usually a straight A student and this was the only class I didn't 4.0 in. Ruined my gpa. If you don't attend her lectures (which are fast and don't help at all) you have to watch Griffens lectures which made me feel like I was having a stroke. My TA was also no help. Tests every Friday and no matter how hard you study you will never get 100%.

I would rather eat a bowl of gravel than take this class again. Instructor just does rather than teaches. If you bring the printed notes to class and are trying to follow along and fill them out, good luck. This class is taught by amazing teachers, but I think that the curriculum was horrible.

reviews.comment: Whatever you do, please do not take this class. I ended with a B average in math in high school and now I am fighting for my grade and spend almost every night crying. reviews.comment: I was advised to take this course, but I didn't listen and im fighting for my life before my exam tomorrow at 10:20. Do not take this course please listen
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Sue Allen wasn't a terrible teacher but the entire MSU math department needs work. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Allen isnt too bad. She helps with webwork if needed and answers general questions. About half the exams/quizzes are nothing like the notes or reviews though and its frustrating.

You do not need to attend lectures, and all notes are posted outside of class. If you are not familiar with the material already you need to attend lecture! All exams have reviews that are almost identical to the tests. Next to impossible not to do well in this class.

Ive never struggled in math before until Math 103. Prof. Allen DOES NOT CARE if you fail. Lack of communication and help in this class. Tests are significantly harder than any review that is given, almost like she wants you to fail. I would NOT recommend taking this class at MSU and I will be retaking the course at my local community college.
She is the worst professor at MSU. She doesnt care if you pass or fail and she can't teach anything. Don't take her class.

So, I am taking this math course for the first time my first year here and a lot of people agree that her teaching is to fast to the point where you can't retain any information. I have always been a straight A student, but somehow have a D in her class. As a professor I think she's ok, but she can d better for sure. She doesn't really explain.

The instruction was hard to understand at best, completely incompetent at worst, The TA and Professor are not hard-working when it comes to review and aren't even making a comprehensive review for the final, there was content on the last exam that wasn't in the lectures, recitation, or review. I wish I had more space to say what I want to.
doesnt teach you and blames the students for failing, i am currently in this course and I know maybe 2 people who are passing

The class overall shouldn't have been as hard as it was, I did not talk to one person throughout the semester that was doing well in the class, so clearly there's a problem deeper than our understanding of the class. Also, the fact she isn't providing an exam prep for the final is absolutely ridiculous. Good luck if you have to take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Allen, probably the professor that cares about her students the most out of all the professors I have had. She goes out of her way to send review videos, finished notes, and ensure her students are ready for upcoming exams and quizzes. Not a super difficult class just follow along with notes and spend some time reviewing before exam

Do not take mth 103 with Sue Allen. This is the hardest class I have ever taken and I ultimately ended up dropping it. Quizzes and exams are very difficult and nothing like the study guides given. Beware

This class was the best. I took ap calc in high school but wanted an easier math class and this was the move for sure. She was so understanding and accommodating in regards to the pandemic. Had a bunch of help sessions and answered emails fast if you needed extra help. Definitely a teacher who wants her students to succeed, 10/10 would recommend.

One of the toughest Professors I had this past semester. Homework was easy to understand and get credit for but the exams were graded tough-every little detail to each problem needed to be shown. However, the lectures were really easy to understand. Technology issues were not excusable in the class (which was difficult when everything was online)

Prof Allen was helpful considering how many help sessions she held before exams but she simply made MTH103 way harder than it needed to be. She has little sympathy for her students and was very rude to me and those who had questions during recitation. The exams were quite difficult and the webwork was brutal. Avoid class if you struggle with math!
I had quizzes every week except for the weeks I had exams! Lectures not mandatory but recitation is!

Professor Allen is extremely nice and caring. If you need help she is more than willing to help during office hours. Print out the weekly lecture notes on D2L because it is easier to follow along. Make sure to study your lecture notes before exams and quizzes. There was a lot of homework, but just use piazza and it can be really easy.
She rushes through everything and notes from class aren't easy to apply to homework or quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Allen is getting a bad rep because she teaches math and most students struggle with math. I wouldn't avoid her just because the class is difficult. reviews.comment: Professor Allen is not a good math teacher. She was not deliberate in lectures and made many mistakes in her work, which caused me to be very confused. reviews.comment: She puts all of the notes online and quizzes are fairly easy. She gave exam #3 six days before the final exam. She also gets very upset people talking in class and would call them out for it.

reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sue Allen knows her math. She moves quickly because she's been doing this for ages. It is your job to show up to class and try. However, focus on the notes for exams and not the webwork and you will pass with a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If I could give her anything lower I would. She doesn't know hoe to teach. half the time the paper isn't even visible to the class and she is always making mistakes. She always makes you teach yourself and ends up hitting you with a hard test. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS UNLESS YOU WANNA DIG YOURSELF IN A HOLE!!!!! p.s. she can be very rude sometimes

Professor Allen is a very nice person, awful teacher. I never skipped a lecture, went to MLC weekly, and had a paid tutor. Her reviews that she gives aren't even made by her and not even remotely close to her exams. She goes through lectures too fast and the problems she shows us are the easiest ones possible. If you take her prepare to fail.

Sue Allen is a less than mediocre professor. She moves through her lectures VERY fast and does not care to go back to any of the concepts to make sure you understand. I would not recommend Professor Allen to anyone and would avoid taking her course(s). She moves extremely quickly through her lectures and often makes several errors while teaching the material. She also focuses too much on how many people are showing up to class rather than putting her energy into properly teaching the students that do show up.

If you have the choice, don't take Professor Allen's class. She makes you feel stupid for asking questions and often makes mistakes while solving problems during the lecture. She gets really irritated if you ask her a basic question and she goes over notes REALLY fast

reviews.comment: She teaches "simple" things that most students have learned already in high School. This should make her class an easy A, but the way she teaches makes everything more confusing. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Sue Allen is a good professor that gives students every opportunity to succeed. In-class lectures give you a base knowledge of subjects but the webwork includes more challenging problems that you will likely have to get help with. As long as you come to class and do the homework the class should be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Excruciatingly long and boring lectures with weekly homework that can barely be completed and has little to do with what she teaches. Get ready to teach yourself because she'll show easy examples of how to find the solutions but then the webwork will be completely different. Thank god the quizzes were easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you took precalculus in high school, this class should be fairly easy. Quizzes every Friday, though, and a lot of Webwork. Webwork was probably the worst thing about this class honestly, exams were not too bad as long as you look over your notes. Class is not really that necessary, all of the notes are online.

Sue Allen is a great choice for a math teacher! I loved the was she taught and how she really cares if you do well in the class. She actually cares if you understand the material being taught. I highly recommend taking her class!
Lots of webwork and quizzes, tough grader when it comes to credit on those quizzes, but she does want you to succeed.

Lectures are hard to pay attention to. She skips over a majority of the notes and doesn't go into detail on what she does cover. Cares more about completing notes in time than if the class actually understands. WebWork is nothing like the content of the notes or the exams. If you don't do good on the exams you're screwed bc that's half your grade.

Professor Allen is AMAZING. She's such a sweet lady who is an amazing teacher!! She's always willing to help, and she explains everything thoroughly. She cracks jokes during class and as boring as math can be, her class is the opposite!

Really good teacher. I barely went to class and thats on me but you really dont need to. All of the notes are online and you can watch videos to understand things you didnt get from the notes. Good at office hours and very helpful. Super sweet lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: One of best online professors I have ever had. Her lecture videos are very helpful. And the exam questions come from everything she teaches. if you are required to take MTH 103, I highly recommend you take her online summer class to get those credits out the way. I could go on and on explaining how great prof. Allen is but Im going to stop here :)

Math is hard! But prof Allen makes it easier to understand and takes it slow, it also helps that shes funny and relates the material to something interesting about MSU most of the time! Make sure you print out the notes and bring them to class, those are very helpful with the online homework and studying for quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Liked her abs a person and a prof, it felt like she really wanted everyone to succeed. The class wasnt very challenging but it was a lot of homework and quizzes all the time.

You could study for hours and get 70's, which i guess is good since it was normal for people to get 30's. My TA was much more helpful and clear when explaining. Textbook isn't used

reviews.comment: She will not budge on final grade even if 0.1% away. Ruined my GPA
She's really sweet and helpful and has good pace during lectures.
This class is just super boring in general. Unless you live and breath math then you probably won't get a kick out of this one. Allen is nice nothing really negative to say about her.

She speeds through the lectures but is willing to stop and answer any questions. reviews.comment: Sue is a really great teacher. Thorough, easy to understand, is willing to take questions, and wants you to do well. I strongly recommend her.

For this being my first college math class, Professor Allen did a great job of making the transition from high school math to college math as smooth as possible. reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She was kind and joked in class but also got stuff done. She always explained the material very clearly. Overall enjoyed the class and loved Mrs. Allen.

sue allen is the best math professor that i have ever taken! she is so caring and will respond to any questions that you may have. although I'm not doing well in the class (I'm not good at math), she makes it easy to learn! i would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Allen is very sweet and nice. Her lectures are not quick but not too slow. She usually keeps pace with her timeframe so don't expect getting out early. 4 exams and 1 final, 7 quizzes, and 28 homework assignments. If you don't make it to class, you can get the lecture notes at MLC.

Professor Allen is great! She's always happy and you can always ask her for help (or the MLC, they're great). Her notes and lecture are EXTREMELY helpful and she's willing to explain things as many times as you need. The work load isn't bad at all, and if you just do the practice problems and the math homework, you'll be fine on tests and quizzes.

She's a great teacher. I am terrible at math but I still managed a 3.0. I suggest attending all lectures and taking notes. Do webwork the same day as the lecture so it is easier. If you struggle GO TO OFFICE HOURS or MLC! She will help you with your homework and with your grades. She gives practice problems that aren't due, but really help.
Very clear lectures, lenient, hilarious ( a must for an early class), and her grading is very fair.
Sue Allen is a very good professor for MTH 103! She is very helpful and has a great sense of humor! Easy to get along with and have a conversation with. Would definitely recommend her for MTH 103!

I really like Sue Allen as a person and a teacher. If you have to pick a professor for math I would recommend her. My only complaint about the course was that we had a test or quiz every week, so if you are not good at testing chose a different course.
Sue Allen is very good at explaining how to do problems and has good notes that will help you loads with webwork and tests. Always there to help before and after lectures, very friendly woman.
Makes constant mistake during lectures, exams often have questions not covered in the sections.

Sue Allen is my favorite professor! She is very helpful and clarifies everything if needed! Everyone knows she is a sweetheart! Her lectures are short. Her class was very easy for me as well. I didn't buy the textbook and you definitely do NOT need it. (unless you really struggle with math, because it just gives extra problems)
Really easy class, pretty much just review everything learned in high school. Don't buy the book unless you really need help with math. I like the professor a lot, she's very sweet and funny.

She's a really awesome person and there to help. As long as you go to the lectures and take notes you'll do fine. A practice exam is sent out before every exam and it's just like the exam except with different numbers. Easy 4.0 DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK, SHE EVEN SAYS YOU DON'T NEED IT

Sue is a great lady and a great teacher.  The class itself is rather fact-paced, but she makes it manageable, and the overall material is not too hard; there is just a plethora of material at all times.
I loved her! She is awesome. Phenomenal teacher and makes the cutest stupid jokes.

The class isn't necessary to go to as long as you get the notes. Make sure to do the webwork, it's pretty easy and helps a lot. The textbook is very unneeded except for the practice exams, so make a friend who has it. Go to all quizzes, the recitation does help!
I loved Sue Allen. She is very personable and very approachable. She answers any questions you might have and she explains the notes well.
Doesn't review and flies through the lectures! AWFUL!!!!!! DONT TAKE! Recitation is quizzes and exams and unless you get a great TA you will never review! DONT TAKE!

I love Sue Allen. She is my favorite professor. She makes math easy and fun. She always cracks jokes, and makes me laugh. She has the cutest dimples and the softest smile. She makes me want to take MTH 103 twice. I love her so much. I definetly recommend her!
Funny, friendly, great.
Easy class to pass if you just show up for notes. Really nice teacher, explains everything. Don't need the text unless you want extra help.
Easy class. As long as you attend most lectures you are likely to get a good grade. Allen is willing to answer any questions and explain material.

Super friendly. Didn't use my book once. Sends the notes to you and makes them organized, all you have to do is fill them in. Tends to rush at the end of lecture. I hate math but she made it less painful and is always available to help.

Tends to spend unnecessary amounts of time on some sections and always ends up rushing her lesson as time starts running out. However, all in all, she's a good professor who is clear and straightforward!
Very nice and helpful lady.  I do not enjoy math, but she made the experience a good one.
She's an awesome teacher. Explains things really well. I def. recommend her for MTH 103!
Sue Allen is a very good math teacher, all you really have to do is the book work and you'll do good on her tests.

I love this professor. She's hilarious and makes cheesy jokes during class but it's still funny because she's just hilarious in general. She makes math easy to learn and she's extremely nice if you ask her a question, i love her. go sue!!
I love Professor Allen! She makes trig fun

Hate math, but if you fail or do poorly, it's your own falut. She's a great teacher and provides great resourses...notes emailed to you to be printed out the day before class so you don't have to write a lot during lecture
Sue Allen is the most awesome teacher I have ever had.  You should definitely take her if you have to take any math classes.
math sucks but i couldnt ask for a better teacher
If math is your weakest link, take sue allen.  She is so sweet.

Take this teacher. Mrs. Allen is the greatest college teacher I have ever had. She explains things so you can understand why. She is also just a genuinely nice person and fun to be around. I strongly recommend taking her whenever possible.

If you have trouble with math, get Professor Allen. She is a really nice person, and she even helps students out in the Math Learning Center, so if you don’t understand the subject you can get help later on right from your professor. She is a very dedicated teacher.
Dr. Wachuku's class was very easy, for someone who didn't use the textbook, I still got a 4.0

Don't take it if not required. Many quizzes have small numbers of questions but are closed-book. There is too much content to retain each week from the textbooks. The required books are too expensive. The professor is not clear on assignment instructions. I haven't learned anything that I already know from this course.

reviews.comment: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO

She is really nice & upbeat during class, but this year she went back and forth between two websites. It was hard to keep up sometimes because she constantly changed it and there would be some problems (link not working, quiz not letting you see your results) but she explains things very well and the material is generally easy to understand.

This professor was not helpful at all. Her office hours were inconvenient, and she never replied to emails, which was really frustrating. She was really cheerful during classes, and seemed like a nice person, but was not the best professor. Her scheduling was confusing because she constantly changed it. the homework was easy, but exams were not.

This professor was not very prepared. She never returned any of my emails, and her exams tended to cover material that we went over in minescule amounts compared to what she actually talked about. She changes the schedule constantly. She was nice as a person, but not the best professor in my book.

Professor Cagnato was very unprofessional and was not willing to help outside of class she was always late to class and  never returned any of my emails. you have to check angel everyday because she is always posting new assignments without notice.

Overall, the class was okay. I found it incredibly hard to understand Prof. Appel because he always mumbles and slurs his words. Great prof! Sometimes the material gets boring, but he does a great job of encouraging class participation and getting group discussions going. His exams are very straightforward, 85% of the material comes right off of lecture slides

reviews.comment: Appel's lectures may be boring but they are super helpful. Attendance isn't madatory but if you show up he will occasionally grant you extra credit. His study guides are essentially the entirity of the exam and even offers XC on the exams as well

I don't really understand all of the hate for Professor Appel. He seems to genuinely care about the topic he's teaching on and respects the students as long as they respect him. Like any college class, if you pay attention and participate you will pass easily and enjoy the class more.

reviews.comment: His lectures were pretty boring and were hard to make it through. There is a lot of reading for the class and he also gives 11 pop quizzes throughout the course so you can't really skip the class either. Reading is mandatory to pass the quizzes.

I took PLS 140 online and it was the worst online class I took. The quizzes did not always follow what was taught in the lecture and readings. The module assignments were extremely difficult and did not align with readings. She grades super tough and feedback on assignments is very confusing and contradicts what she said in previous assignments.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Sarkissian had a lecture everyday about the content we read for class. Throughout the slides, she would include iClicker questions that counted for attendance and participation. They were often easy, and she would pause to review. The exams were easy if you paid attention in class and there were many opportunities to earn full credit.

This is a 300-level course, which is upper-level in the PLS department, so expect a lot of reading (4 texts) and writing. Prof. Sarkissian is great, but you cannot wing this class. This is a discussion-based course, so you are expected to participate. There is a participation grade, discussion posts, three essay exams, and a book report.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly avoid taking this class if you're looking to 4.0. The content and course itself is very simple and easy, as it should be for an introductory level class. However, the exams are purposely worded in a way to trick you. Also note that an A in this class is a 93-100.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: 4 Exams, lowest is dropped and the other points come from participation points that come from attending lectures, answering pop questions via iclicker, easy enough if you do the reading and pay minimal attention to lecture. Issue is in the exams, multi-choice questions feel completely random, rubric for essay is there but not applied to grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tough test grader despite simple material. Does Iclicker quizzes with lots of dumb/poorly worded/trick questions. Only missed 1-2 classes the whole semester but got a 75% attendance grade because the clicker quizzes were so dumb. Not an unbearable class but frustrating at times.

Professor Sarkissian is extremely knowledgeable about political science. The course itself is pretty straightforward but exam questions can be tricky sometimes. I really enjoyed this class and I appreciate her answering my questions on politics inside and outside the class. Participation portion is easy to achieve points. No extra credit options.

Extremely hard grader on exams, homework, and even in-class participation. Hours of homework per night. Lectures are based solely on homework discussion questions, isn't really teaching you anything, just talking about the book. Very blunt, says she doesn't understand your thinking and doesn't offer any suggestions to do better. Wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this Professor's lectures. This was my first political science class I took. At first I was hesitant about poli sci but this professor made me truly consider continuing to study political science. She really knows what she's talking about and I believe she loves teaching comparative politics. She is also really nice and friendly.

Very kind, understanding & inspirational. She knows that Poli Sci has got some confusing concepts sometimes & will absolutely make time to help you. She loves answering questions & makes sure students don't hesitate to ask. Ask her about any current political events you are curious about too! It actually really helps you connect course concepts!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Sarkissian is a very good professor and very funny. She clearly cares about her students and our wellbeing, inside and outside the classroom. Very little homework besides reading the textbook, which is $1 per chapter, and you only need 11 chapters. Very clear and good at explaining things in lecture with good conversations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Sarkissian was not only a very effective lecturer, but was very engaging as well. Her depth of knowledge with comparative politics is inspiring and I had fun with learning the materials. Her exams require you to understand the lectures/textbook readings well and encourages you to consistently analyze the context around what we're learning.

This professor was one of my better online instructors. Her lectures were clear and very easy to follow. The textbook was only $11. Criteria of assignments was very specific. The only downside is that tests could be a bit tricky, I never scored higher than an 80% but grades can be made up with other assignments.

She's caring and stuff but she explains things so confusingly. It could be the most straight forward assignment and somehow everyone is confused because she used 10 pages to explain it. Even the syllabus is SEVENTY THREE pages long. She literally confuses everyone. Even though I got a good grade I felt like I was going insane reading instructions

She's a good professor, but for being a half-online class, it is the most work I have ever done. It's just busy work, but it gets annoying doing it every week. It's all group work, so it's not that difficult in class. If you miss class, you have to do alternative work, which is much harder than the in-person work, so you should just show up.

She is decent. I personally never had a love for the topic so I didn't find the class that enteraining.
Its all group work so being in class is a must you get 3 skips for the semester
The group work isnt bad its just sometimes annoying to do when you have alot of other schoolwork to do
Mostly it is in class work though, final needs is done outside

Professor Bierema is a very nice lady, but I genuinely would not recommend taking this class in person if it is a requirement. Her D2L is terribly organized and the instructions for assignments are overwhelming. No examples are given, and she generally gives overly detailed explanations that make understanding worse. Not content.

Bierema is kind and clearly cares about the wellbeing of her students. She's easy to reach out to and gives lots of reminders about due dates and homework. D2L-wise, this is the most organized class I've ever had. There is a lot of work in this class, but it's super easy and Bierema is an easy grader.  Show up to class, look at the checklist, easy.

She's a really nice professor. The class I took was only once a week, and you definitely had to go to receive credit for the in class assignments. But the in class assignments were so easy and you got to do them with ur table ur assigned. I never felt like the class was too difficult or stressful.

She is the kindest professor I've ever had. She cares about her students and not deadlines & grades. The second I told her I was have a mental health episode, she immediately created a plan with me to get back on my feet and didnt question or shame me in any way. If I could take her course again I would. The class is easy just a lot, stay organized
She's a nice lady but the workload is CRAZY for a gen Ed class. It's like she wants you to fail with how confusing her assignments are.

Dr. Bierema is a really personable professor. My class was hybrid, once a week. She had lots of Packbacks each week but the structure was really simple in her class. One presentation for the whole semester with a group. Seems super caring and biomed was scaring me but her course was really simple. Would take her again. Easy 4.0 if u stay on task.

Professor Bierema was very nice, but the course material was extremely confusing. The book you have to read has little to nothing to do with what you learn or do in the class and is only relevant to some of the homework. If you don't like working in randomly assigned groups, this class is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you want to take a class where you use 4 different sites to do things that can be accomplished on D2L here you go. Grading criteria ranges from clear for the final project to impressively vague. It really seems like she does the least possible work while giving her students a massive amount. The textbook is extremely odd and uncomfortable.

She's a nice person, but she gives so much unnecessary "busy work". It's a big class, but she doesn't lecture much, the class is heavily based on group work and there is not much individual work. She makes the content understandable, but at times it is uncomfortable and weird. Overall, she's very understanding but I would not take the class again.
She's nice, big classroom

Please please please if you have her as an option to take, do it. This was the easiest class I've taken and she was super super nice and an easy 4.0. She barely gives homework maybe two things a week and there's never a test or quiz. The majority of your grade is graded based off completion and not even correctness.

Mrs. Bierema was literally the sweetest. She is an amazing professor and the class isn't difficult at all. Highly suggest taking it if you need credit. There are quizzes and class activities so make sure you go to class but usually its only one day a week.

Professor Bierema was the easiest professor Ive had this semester. Isb 204 is a hybrid course but once you get the hang of the weekly routine its nothing. I HIGHLY recommend you take advantage of all the extra credit she offers cuz it helps boost your grade. But overall, easy 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, he wants the best for each student and makes compromises when people didn't like things that were in the course. The labs are fine, but poorly structured. Exams cover a lot of content, but cheat sheets are allowed. Overall funny, nice, and a good professor.

Great professor. He is very passionate and wants students to succeed. One thing I think he could be better at is being consistent. For example, We had an exam review only for 2/3 midterm exams. And for our final exam he didn't post a review video until the night before.... The exam was at 12:45pm the next day.
The best professor ever, super kind, caring and flexible. Actually helps us get through the course.

Great professor. He focuses on learning the material in an engaging way rather than just strict deadlines and difficult exams. The material covered in the 410 course is very relevant to the packaging industry in the real world.

Dr.Joodaky is a very good prof, in the words of the esteemed American physicist Richard Feynman, If you want to master something, teach it. Dr.Joodaky has mastered this balance, thus leading to a rewarding class for his students that is constantly evolving to become better.
He is very caring of the students. wants them to do well
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hes a nice teacher and seems like he knows a a lot. The lab reports were time consuming but graded fairly. Exams were in person and kinda hard, but he had some drops and extra credit at the end of the semester. There was also weekly hw but it didnt take long most of the time. Overall i liked him
Great professor. Helpful feedback and listens to students. Also very willing to help his students.
come to class because pop quizzes are done during class for attendance.
He was awesome! Very understanding and loved student feedback.
The class was hard, but he is very caring and does everything he can to help students succeed.
One of the better packaging professors.
Good professor who is understanding and willing to work with the students to make it better for us.

He was great. Super understanding and helpful when communicating with, and was willing to help whenever he was needed to. Explains everything really well, but the class material is difficult and requires time and effort to understand the information.
He was awesome! He loved student feedback, and was very understanding!
Very engaging professor. Test and lab heavy with a good amount of homework. If you go to class you're good.
Class was hard, but he is very caring and does everything he can to help students succeed.
Awesome, funny and is very thoughtful when it came to late submissions.
Great professor would love to have him again in the future.
very friendly and personable, Lab TA's make this class very easy because they give 100% on everything
I love this guy, wish he was my dad fr man.

Weekly long lab reports and no extra credit even if a class average on an exam is 40%. One time I stayed after class to ask a question about the homework and he just had me stand there and google it. I just wanted to know if it was explained in a previous lecture. Definitely the kind of prof who is there to do research & teaching is an afterthought

Dr. Joodaky is one of the best professors in the school of packaging. PKG 410 is a difficult class, but he wants to help you succeed. He is funny and caring about his students. Outside of class he will help explain things and he encourages you to get involved. I did a research project with him and it was a great experience.
Professor Arnold is awesome! The class is well structured, and Professor Arnold gives very thoughtful feedback on assignments. I would definitely recommend this class to others.
Great person! Really cares and loves hearing your ideas. Interested in your work and always opened to talk.

Amazing amazing amazing. Super down to earth and relatable to students. Understanding of missing class and gives opportunities to make up points. Big project at the end of the course/throughout but I really enjoyed working on it
Best prof I have had so far at MSU. He truly cares about women's voices and the subject he teaches. Is very flexible with deadlines and cares about his students. Would take him again 100000%

Professor Arnold is a great teacher and you can tell they genuinely care about their students. It's really easy to get a 4.0 as long as you complete the assignments. Probably the easiest class I've ever taken and doing the assignment each week didn't take much time.

Professor Arnolds class was amazing. I felt that the material was good and easy to understand, and they were extremely understanding for every single assignment that there was. There were also no exams! Overall I really liked this class.

Pat is the sweetest professor I've ever had. They clearly want all of their students to succeed and make it a point to get to know every student individually. It's very easy to 4.0 their classes as long as you complete your assignments!

Course was easy and the professor was very caring and tried to make connections with students. I personally took this class for an honors credit so I didn't enjoy it too much, but i can see how others would. A lot of videos and readings. 1 major assignment a week with readings, articles, and ted talks to inform. Spent an hour a week for this class.

Prof Arnold is easily the best professor I've ever had at MSU. So knowledgeable, welcoming, caring. Everything you could ask for. Content of  class was so interesting and I honestly can say I learned a lot. Two in person participation projects required but are up to you as far as topic/event. Was fun and worth it in the end. Nothing bad to say!
very kind and understanding. easy assignments
Pat was super accommodating and did everything in their power to make sure every student succeeded. Very easy, but interesting, class.

Professor Arnold is one of the most caring professors you will have at msu. They are very understanding and want you to succeed. There is an assignment due every other week that only takes about 30 minutes or less to do and 2 campus event reflections. As long as you complete your work the best you can, they will give you a 100!

Super nice and actually cares for students. The class itself is super easy and has discussion questions every other week which is really nice. Grading is super lenient and the assignments and readings are easy. Sometimes you do not even half to read the book to answer the discussion questions. Honors option is also easy.

i took this as an elective, easiest class ever. prof arnold is very sweet and such a nice person. this class requires little to no work. there's 1 online assignment a week that normally took ab 10-20 mins. u have to go to 2 events of ur choice during the semester. no tests/final. love prof arnold!!!

Pat is a wonderful and easygoing instructor. They only have a few assignments per week that are based off of the assigned readings. Attendance can be made up each week by doing an extra assignment. They are also very helpful and their lectures are super interesting.

Pat is an amazing professor. They assign weekly homework but it is all engaging and may include readings, documentaries, videos, poems, etc. This was my favorite class and I appreciated the flexibility. If you were to miss a class you could do a small extra assignment from home, but the class is so engaging that you won't want to miss!
He is a really nice professor and doesn't assign any quizzes or exams. The modules he assigned had really interesting videos and articles. He gives lots of extra credit during class.

He's a genuinely nice person, and makes it known that he wants everyone to feel as comfortable as possible in his class. There's one weekly assignment, and most of them are opinionated, so I'm honestly not even sure what he grades,
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: They are so nice and you can tell he really cares and is passionate about the subject matter. The class is easy (basically never any tests, just discussion posts) and consists of a lot of in class discussions.

He did a wonderful job conveying the topics. This is an easy class for anyone who regularly engages on topics of gender/sexuality in their personal life + a good intro for anyone that doesn't. He's super understanding and genuinely wants you to succeed. The assignments help you understand the content better, which is almost never the case.

She's very understanding about any issues if you just talk to her in-person. I recommend going to the TA's office hours regularly because her slides are hard to interpret on your own, and her accent makes long lectures hard to understand. All quizes an exams are on D2L asynchronously. Concepts are easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: All quizzes and tests are online and open book with no lockdown browser, and she offers enough extra credit. If you want an easy 4-point, Professor ALZ's class is perfect. But if you want to actually learn, don't take her. She's pro-AI and the class is so easy that it would be hard to learn anything unless I was REALLY interested in the material.
Very easy class, every assignment is out of class and online. Plenty of extra credit opportunities, and slides are super helpful for studying. Would recommend, seems nice and class is easy.
Dr. ALZ is an amazing professor and prioritizes the learning of her students. She offers a lot of extra credit which had me prioritize my learning over worrying about my grade.

Dr. ALZ is a Wonderfull professor! She is a very fair grader, and she goes through the lectures at a steady pace. She brings in a lot of guest speakers and gives out many extra credit opportunities. She also does demonstrations on certain types of software that students often have trouble navigating.

I really enjoyed this course. The professor really cares about the students and will often be very lenient about assignments and quizzes. She also gives a bunch of extra credit opportunities which can REALLY help boost your grade. The only downside to this course was the TA.

She's very sweet, but unfortunately often hard to follow during lectures, and the slides themselves can be a tad confusing. Dates for quizzes weren't really communicated until the class before or the day-of, and I flat-out missed one or two of them. That being said, there's TONS of easy extra credit to be had; I felt clueless and still got a 4.0.

I knew this class would be tough when she started the semester offering 40 points of extra credit. She ended up offering over 80. I earned 60 and still only got a 2.0. Her accent is horrendously difficult to understand and her lectures are not very clear. Weekly quizzes on random days of the week, and the assign

I often found myself very bored in this professor's class because she reads straight from the lectures that can be accessed online. Attending this class often felt like a waste of time, however, attendance was mandatory, but she allowed 5 absences. She also offers a lot of extra credit, more than any other professor I've had before.

Professor Ligmann-Zielinska does not teach well and only reads off PowerPoint. She covers stuff we can easily memorize instead of going in-depth on how to do the math and coding the course requires. I am giving her a good review because of how much extra credit she gives. I failed almost every quiz and got a 4.0 truly amazing.

This prof is fine. Sometimes it's difficult to understand her point when she can't find the right words, especially for such a technical class. There is so much extra credit that even if you have no idea what's going on you'll be fine. Very sweet lady, kinda funny. It's easier to pay attention to the recorded lectures so you can go back and listen.
Terrible prerecorded lectures. She does not know how to teach online. I want to pull my hair out listening to her stumble on her words during recordings.

This was all online and she was a professor that didn't understand how to teach online. All lectures were pre recorded so if you were confused you would have to figure it out yourself, which was almost always. But easy quizzes and not stressful course load, just wait to take in person if an option.

Nice and funny professor. The quizzes and exams are all online and you have 24 hrs to take them. Although she said that you don't have time to look at your notes during them since they're timed, you do. I used my notes for every exam and quiz, so have good notes from the powerpoints. She offers reasonable extra credit too.

She's nice but not very understanding at all. You have to read the textbook to begin to even understand the lectures and the textbook is so dense that it's very difficult to grasp the concepts. If you miss a class, you fall way behind and good luck catching up. The lectures are also dense, and you are fighting desperately for participation points.

I dont get why we are letting foreign people become our future professors, its so hard trying to communicate with them and be on the same note. They dont like taking criticism and also think they are always right and not wrong. Simply does not understand how to operate an online class, should stick to lectures irl and be more clearer in the future

I wouldn't take this professor again or recommend her class to anyone. The class instructions are extremely vague and the professor doesn't handle feedback or questions well. Simply giving a 1/5 feels complimentary.

This is by far the best experience I've had with a professor at Michigan State both during not during COVID. The way her MI360 class was structured, I was able to get the work done when I needed to, and I always felt respected and treated like an adult. The textbook is required, but it's honestly good. 10/10 and would definitely recommend.

Kept changing the class rules during the semester; used TA's to walk around marking points; group assignments were awful; class participation was cringey and felt like a fight for points. Overall, great class on how to not teach a class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a professor who genuinely wants you to be successful, but you will have to show up, participate, and do some studying in order for it to happen. She is very clear with her expectations and sets you up to do well. The quizzes and exams rely very heavily on the built-in quizzes in the online component of the text book. Study those!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: not helpful at all

Professor Arnold is a fantastic person and an excellent teacher. She really cares about the students and wants us to succeed. Attendance is very important, and there is a lot of work, but she grades very generously, and as long as you put in a little work, you'll succeed. She is very understanding and provides excellent feedback on all papers.
Awesome professor! Would totally take this class again, so grateful for professor Arnold. She genuinely cares about all her students and she's extremely passionate about teaching !

She was an amazing professor. She's super caring and respectful. She does a great job of teaching the course. It's extremely easy, you just have to show up. It's basically 5 projects spread out over the course and they're all super easy. She's an amazing teacher and I am so sad that the class is ending. An easy 4.0!! Love her!!!
Beware. This man is a sex offender and got charged with aggravated assault... got found with CP. Great guy though.

professor takes attendance on certain days but tells you at the beginning of the semester. homework is super easy as long as you review the in class assignments. exam is harder, but graded relatively easy. final project is the most difficult and is based on everything you do in the semester, but no final exam.
Amazing professor. Truly about students educational and personal success.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's fine tbh

I originally made a bad review on Professor Gupta. After further consideration, I understand him a lot more. He comes from a great place, definitely has a few issues to work out in the coursework, like the Quizzes being super heavy, and in my opinion drastically different from lecture. Not at all a bad man and really does want to see you learn/win.

Hes not that bad. "Coding on chalkboard" is good because it feels like he is writing it with us and easier to follow. "Errors" that he makes while writing code are very small like spelling something wrong. Grade is based 60% off of weekly quizzes. Lots of extra credit. Sometimes he is grumpy and crashes out most of the time he is pretty funny

A lot of the hate could be mitigated due to his first time teaching. Yes, he can improve on the lectures, and yes the blackboard is tedious. More than half your grade is basically free, all you have to do is the projects and the labs. The quizzes are definitely difficult, and will require thorough reading. Not as bad as they say if you just work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not as bad as ratings say. I've you've taken a coding class before this class should be easy, if not, it'll be a lot harder and you'll have to do a lot more out of class to learn the material. Quizzes are worth a massive chunk of your grade for no reason. Use the TA's to teach you cause they're the most helpful.

Wasn't as bad as people say. Projects and labs were free points. Chalkboard's annoying, but he gives class-wide extra credit for catching his mistakes. Quizzes are tough—I got 60–70s but will still 4.0 thanks to the end of semester bonus project. Not the best prof, but easy to pass.

Pretty chill and lenient with grading. Ok at lecturing SOMEtimes, but often easy to get lost. Homework & lab relies on figuring concepts out on your own and if you have no coding experience that's essentially impossible. TA teaches more in 5 minutes than he does in 40. Extremely disorganized & clearly an inexperienced professor. 

"Oh dear" indeed

About half the grade comes from weekly quizzes, which can be tough if you don't read the recommended textbook. Isn't the greatest, but isnt as bad as everyone says. He isnt too organized, and uses a chalkboard. He makes mistakes, but when pointed out, he gives the whole class extra credit. Really isn't that bad, but def learn on your own. Use chat!

Attendance is not mandatory, only gives bonus points. Labs are mandatory (highest you can get is 50% w/o attendance). I like the chalkboard, it's like he's writing the code with us and lets us learn by catching mistakes. Quizzes covers textbook content. Those who say that it's on stuff he hasn't taught just haven't read the textbook.
Very test heavy and not clear on what tests will be on
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a computer science class, Gupta loves to NOT use his computer. He writes on a chalkboard that's barley visible, commonly gets his own examples wrong, and he takes attendance via a piece of paper that he usually forgets to pass out. The quizzes don't cover what he does and I hope I never have to take another of his classes again.

BEWARE if you take this class, be ready to read code off a chalk board. Ayra, is so funny that he sometimes he doesn't know his own answers. He also has weekly quizzes that everyone fails because the quizzes are topics that he doesn't even cover. Attendance is also mandatory with a piece of paper that you need to sign and he forgets to give it out.

Professor Gupta is quite the guy. Mandatory attendance, and if you miss two quizzes you receive a zero in the course. We didn't have a syllabus until the second class and since then we've had 6? iterations. He is not very good at lecturing or explaining, you won't be able to see his code and even if you could you wouldn't be able to read it. GL!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ashley is caring, fun and genuine. I loved her class and woukd definitely take one of her classes again. She is very understanding and down to earth. Beautiful soul.

I loved Dr. Moore, and I had her for TE101. After reading negative reviews, it seems that people are upset due to the difficult discussions that were had in class, but Dr. Moore was always respectful to everyone while sharing her thoughts, and I never felt attacked or judged. She can be quite opinionated, but once you're used to it, it's all good.
Removed a student from her class for difference of opinions, the TE 101 and 102 classes are a complete joke and waste of time and content.
Had us turn in a rough draft, and then graded it on accuracy. 0/10, wouldn't recommend, would choose a different teacher.

I liked Ashley! She was super sweet and cared about our personal lives, would ask a group question at the start of every class. Class is only 50 min but flew by. Last 6ish weeks are student led presentations. Didn't ever really want to skip this class. Easy homework and the papers aren't bad at all. Would take class with her again any time!
Dr. Moore is a caring and accessible professor. She can be nitpicky with assignments but gives great constructive criticism. She pushes students to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore was an amazing professor. I would recommend her class. She grades kinda hard, but she makes the class fun and makes everyone involved.

Strongly recommend having her as your professor for TE-102. She makes the class feel like a community, allowing every student to speak and feel heard. She is very caring and understanding and is willing to give students extended time on any homework as long as they communicate. Amazing lectures, if you plan on taking TE-102 soon, take it with her.

Dr. Barnes Lee is kind, but the class needs improvement. We focused almost only on racism against African Americans without covering other groups or discrimination (sexism, ableism, etc.) and human development. Lectures were mostly her reading slides and the book. Discussions weren't guided and became personal/therapeutic rather than academic.

Dr. Barnes-Lee is hands down one of the best professors I've ever had. The discussions she facilitated were wonderful and productive. She was caring and relatable. Completely unrelated- but she has impeccable style. LOVE HER.

I took her 310 course in Fall 2023. Every time I left this class I felt refreshed and relaxed. She can be a harsh grader, but if you truly believe you deserve a better grade, then she is more than willing to go back over the assignment and see if there were any mistakes in grading. On one assignment, I bumped my grade from a 72% to an 89%.
He could care less if your writing was "good" or not, he just wants you to try your best and write something. Just don't turn in things late, he doesnt like that.

He assigns a ton of work, but he is very nice and grades pretty easily. There were so many different writings/assignments that I stopped trying 3 weeks in. He takes attendance but you have 4 skips. Rambles a lot during class  time but if you  just do the assignments you'll get an easy 4.0.

Professor Astle is an easy grader and likes participation. As long as you complete assignments, you will get a great grade in the class. A lot of busy work, but honestly, it just helps your overall grade in the end. I would 100% take a course with Professor Astle again.
Very good professor, super understanding, very compassionate and super willing to give extensions.

Although he rambles during the lectures, he's very caring and pretty laid back. The class is paper heavy, with not too much time in between papers. There are occasional group projects. He gives VERY detailed feedback. His grading style is weird. Each assignment regardless of size is 2 points, but you can fight for your overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's super chill, the lectures are always very fun and while he does ramble a little bit it's usually entertaining or thought-provoking. You will often get out 15 minutes early or be doing individual work for the second hour of the class which I liked. Not a harsh grader and altogether the class is an easy + fun honors credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Astle has easily been the best professor I have ever had. The classes are long but all WRA101 classes are going to be long. He has a great sense of humor and extremely caring to all of his students. Definitely take your writing requirement through him if you can. He is amazing.

Dr. Astle is probably my favorite professor this semester. He gives insightful comments and will gives full credit if you show effort. The only thing is to keep an eye on assignments because there's a lot, especially in class, and you could miss some. He doesn't always remind students of due dates for writing projects so be on top of it.
Way more work than other WRA profs. A lot of unnecessary busy work.

Dr. Astle showed obvious care for his students with his assignments and deadlines. His lectures were philosophical in nature, and honestly had nothing to do with his papers, but he was very kind and thoughtful. You don't really need to go to class to pass, but always keep an eye on assignment deadlines. All assignments are posted online.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Astle is a very caring and helpful professor. He gives good and detailed feedback about your writing. We had a lot of mini writing assignments that I think were kind of unnecessary. He also talks a lot during lectures. Classes usually ended pretty early and the exam was stress free.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The professor graded clearly and specifically, but he is very generous. Even though the amount of work assigned was heavy, finish all of them and you have got a sure A. The lectures do not really relate to the work, but they are not mandatory, so your choice. He is also very kind and understanding, accessible and helpful outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's a really great prof who grades pretty easily and gives great feedback. As long as you do all of the assigned work you should get a good grade. The course has a heavy emphasis on reflective writing and he focuses a lot on the concepts of intelligence and learning as well. There can be some abstract thinking but I found it to be worthwhile.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is essentially a ton of busy work. The lectures aren't super important, and they are long and boring. As long as you put in decent effort and submit all your assignments on time, then this class is no big deal. Dr. Astle is nice, but he doesn't hand out extensions like candy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: 99% of the class is writing a million mini essays on one topic, which i dont hate at all. the assignments themselves were relatively easy but this dude talks for a very long time while saying so much nothing. 7/10 since class ends early most days
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awesome class got B+ the only reason why was because I scored 77 on a major assignment but overall great professor . Take this class!!!!!!

Professor Astle was overall great. Did a good job organizing the class and was always willing to help the students. The course work can be time-consuming, but as long as you work hard, you should be solid for this class.
Awesome teacher very caring if ur a freshman highly recommended. If ur not the best at essay he really works with you and cares.
He grades really easy. this lectures don't really matter, and you don't have to take notes. 10/10 would have hime again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really great prof. He gives really good feedback on all assignments and grades pretty easily. Highly recommend him for WRA 101. He really cares about his students and wants them to do well.

For the most part, I think this class was very well run. Aslami set her expectations, and if you followed them you were fine in this class. I personally had a difficult time engaging in the theory, but she still found a way to help you understand and make connections in class. I would definitely recommend her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing English professor. Although the readings can be a bit difficult to comprehend, any motivated english student is going to adore her class. For eng 280 you delve into theory, and her teaching style was absolutely perfect for it. I would take this class again if I could, it was amazing.

Aslami is great. I had her for ENG 280 in the spring of 2023, as well as this last semester for ENG364. Grading is dependent on participation, but she also offers a notetaker job for students who feel a little overwhelmed about speaking extensively in front of the class as a way to get some credit. Her essay critique is helpful and light on grading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Aslami's English 210 class. Overall, the class was engaging, and I learned a lot from her. Your grade relies heavily on class participation, but she makes it feel very easy to do so. The feedback on papers and close readings are very helpful for improving in the future. I would highly recommend her as a professor.

The class is hard to get through if you don't like the books she uses. If you don't LOVE literature and writing I'd steer clear of her classes as she can complicate things and make things more confusing. She relies on class participation and if you aren't a big talker in class I hesitate to recommend her class cause your grade relies on that a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: ENG 280 is the most boring class ever. She tries her best to spice up the class but my god the readings are the dullest things I've ever read. Prof. Aslami is a great writing teacher - my essays got a lot better over the semester - but I don't think I can overstate just how boring the class was altogether.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Professor Aslami for Honors English 1 and had a great time. You read the texts and then come discuss them in class. She is very funny and keeps the class light-hearted but still pretty intense in terms of the analysis you do. All in all I would definitely recommend.

Amazing professor! She is very passionate/knowledgeable - and cares deeply for her students. Her classes are relatively easy, but you will still learn so much! I highly recommend taking a class with her.

She was confusing and talked with very large words that no one really understood. The lectures are very boring and very hard to understand and relate to. I would suggest getting into a different IAH class.

Although she usually teaches literature, I had professor Aslami for an IAH course. She has very little experience with teaching this course or even delivering lectures. That being said, paying close attention during "lectures" will benefit you immensely for her IAH courses. Obtaining the information needed was much more difficult than it had to be.

She was consistently strict to the point of being unreasonable, and her tone often came across as dismissive. It's frustrating how she would make personal comments about students, often trying to define who we were or what we were capable of, which felt intrusive and unprofessional. The class environment was tense and unsupportive. don't recommend

You can tell she really cares about her students and her goal is to get everyone a 4.0. As long as you keep up with the work, which never took me more than 3 hours a week, and go to class you'll be successful. It is very discussion based and 3 hours long, but Dr. Moore makes adjustments for quieter students and gives breaks.

Dr. Moore is an incredible professor.  She is open about every decision made in the class. After the Feb. 13 event, she was helpful and reached out with support and resources. She was understanding of mental health. Her teaching requires participation and discussion, but she has reasonable expectations. Her reading is light and easy to follow.

Dr. Moore is a great professor! She does not require a doctors note when you miss class and is very understanding. She is very open to extending due dates and grades fairly. I would take this class again for sure! You need to buy a few things but she will work with you!

Ashley was one of the most caring professors I have had to date. She is very understanding and always wants you to take care of yourself before school. I think that she is very fun and always asks for feedback. She doesn't just look at our feedback either, she takes it into consideration and accommodates it to the best of her ability.
An amazing teacher! I took TE 101 with her and am going to take TE 102 with her again! She makes the 3 hour long class fly by. You could go get a cup of coffee with her:)

She is a professor who truly cares about each of her students and their well-being. She is respectful of everyone in the classroom when discussing important topics. She is so real with her students and this helps with her teaching which she is very well organized and prepared for. I would highly recommend taking a class with her.

I had her for a TE course and she is just phenomenal. Dr. Moore shows constant respect for her students and does a fantastic job at making sure you are interested and engaged with the course material. Genuinely one of my favorite professors and I would highly, highly, HIGHLY recommend her to anyone.
I absolutely loved this professor! she was funny and knowledgable and helpful. I would really love to take spanish from her again.

She is OK.  She seems more interested in trying to impress us and she seems uncomfortable when explaining difficult topics or if people have more in-depth questions.  I would take her again because she is nice but you might learn more from a different prof.

Professor Moore was one of the best profs I've had so far here at MSU. She's extremely helpful and does a great job with the course material.  She loves teaching and Spanish and it shows. I would highly recommend taking her courses if you can!

Horrible lectures. Reads straight from PowerPoint with little to no added substance. There was no additional homework when I took the class, so you just had to pray you did well on the 5 major exams. Stress.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Triplett understands that her class is hard, and she is always willing to help outside of class. Granted, the lectures are not super interesting, but it's a fair trade because the all the homework can only help your grade (so long as you actually complete it). You'll have to study hard-- exams are difficult. But she offers tons of extra credit.

I had Ashley for KIN 216 in 2020 and KIN 411 in 2023 and both times she was a great professor. I'm glad I finally had an in person class with her as she is a caring and funny professor. She can be tough but it is because she knows you know the information and just doesn't want to give you the answer right away. Overall, a great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't bother going to lectures because she'll just read PowerPoints word for word at the speed of light. Dr. Triplett seems nice, and I'm sure she's probably well versed in human anatomy, but she definitely should not be a teacher. Tests feel harder than they need to be, and the course doesn't feel like it's set up to actually help students learn.

I personally loved this class. While class may not have been the most entertaining, the prof was very helpful with tips of what to study for the exam (go to exam review sessions!!) and her slides were straightforward. There were no surprises on the exam. Definitely a memorization class and takes lots of studying, but good instructors.

Professor Triplett was a great professor and KIN 216 was my favorite class this semester. There's a lot of content but her lecture slides are well-organized and easy to follow. She provides great resources for studying.

5 exams. awful prof. not understanding at all and very rude and short with people. doesn't actually teach prob cause she doesn't know the content. never wants to be there and often comes late. my friends and I all ended up teaching ourselves. good luck getting assignments dropped even if you have a literal disease

Terrible Prof. Doesn't teach, reads off slides but clearly doesn't know the content she's "teaching" cause she pronounces half of it wrong and corrects herself constantly. Lectures more harmful than helpful, resorted to teaching myself. Not understanding at all. I literally have never had a worse professor or teacher in my life. AVOID HER CLASSES.

This class was very hard for many students but the TAs were extremely helpful and so was Dr. Triplett. Highly recommend this class as it was very interesting but quite challenging. Lots of studying is required.

KIN 216 is a hard class, I understand, but that doesn't dismiss the fact that Dr. Triplett did not teach. Reading straight off of the powerpoint slides does not constitute teaching, and it didn't really seem like she wanted to be there. I am disappointed with how the class turned out, and it could be structured a whole lot better.
love her, very kind and understanding to students, tests are straightforward
great teacher, cares about her students
She literally doesn't teach at all the TAs are always unhelpful and the lectures do not help you for the tests at all.

Very bland when giving lectures. The biggest challenge is not taking notes, but trying not to fall asleep. I get ecstatic when I open a lecture and it's a TA's voice. Takes over 10 days to grade exams and will NOT respond to a SIGNLE email no matter how important. It seems as if I'm going to 4.0 this class, Dr. Triplett is just aggravating.

I had to teach myself pretty much this whole course with the help of family. Asa normally read off the slides and just skimmed the surface of the topic but never went into good detail with it. It almost seemed like he was learning the information with us. Clicker during class and the homework helped, but I don't think lecture helped me at all.

All exam questions come from past exams, iClicker questions during lecture, and homework. Take advantage of the online help room, the TA's are always making sure you truly understand what you're confused on. There are two homework drops, and one exam drop. Lectures are kind of boring but important to pay attention to.

Professor Brigandi was very chill and straight forward. He made is clear what was due and gave students the choice of coming to lecture or not. You'll do well in this class as long as you know most of the material. Only thing I didn't like was having to pay $100 for the textbook, but overall an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Asa does not give much explanation on the topics for lectures. He skims the surface of a powerpoint that is clearly made by someone else, and sometimes it feels as if he's reading the information on the slides for the first time. No leniency on the homework: Had to teach myself the entire course. Would not take again.

The class was an easy A, but class attendance is a portion of the grade. You have to buy the textbook to get online homework access, but you can go over the homework in office hours and get 100%. Really receptive to questions. Review lectures and study materials really helped with exams.

I really enjoyed his poetry class, I learned a lot about poetry. Class was built around reading and in-class discussions, with some on-demand writing/annotation exams. I would definitely recommend him as a professor, he clearly knows what he's talking about and is easy to listen to.

Great guy! I took his Gothic course back in freshman year, and it was excellent. Definitely some work, but he's an enjoyable professor who really cares. Sadly, I think he stopped teaching the Gothic IAH course, but he's still a very good and passionate professor. The work and readings can be a lot, but it's manageable.

Professor Arch is a great teacher. He really cares about his students and the material that he teaches. Sometimes it isn't clear as to what parts of the exams or assignments will look like, but it's nothing that should cause a huge issue if you read the books and participate in class. There's a lot of reading, but the books are very interesting.

I have him right now and he is one of my favorite professors I've ever had! Very accommodating and present during class. Makes lectures fun and engaging. I was stuck at home during a snow storm and emailed him and he marked me present for emailing him and told me to stay safe! Cares about shaping the future. I hope he holds off retirement!!

People giving bad reviews probably didn't attend lecture and you guys hating him for no reason. Yes you have to read books and he gives you "2 weeks" but dates has been in syllabus since the beginning. He also changed it a few times because the class changes; mainly people who exploit him. Lecture can be boring but he's kind and passionate.

He gave us a 300-page novel to read just 2 weeks from the finals as if we don't have any other courses to study for. NO extra credit at all and 4.0 is only at 92.5%.He is not open to feedback.  He decided what to change in the syllabus a week before the exam,till now we have had 3 exams and 3 different syllabuses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This guy is great. At the start of the semester I thought this would be a boring pre rec but it was actually pretty interesting. The lectures are very interesting and easy to follow. There isn't to much work and as long as you go to lectures and do the assigned reeding the exams are pretty easy.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He gave us 300-page book to read before the finals. He changed the syllabus so many times, with multiple exams. His lectures are so boring and I felt like his lectures are just boring overall. The poetry analysis session was the worst. I felt like the TAs were doing everything in recitation. I was unsure of what he was talking about in his lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He can be funny, and I appreciate how vulnerable he often is. His lectures can be a little boring at times, but he has some really thought-provoking moments. You WILL read a lot, but I didn't hate the material we were given; it's just a little long. If you're a really slow reader, you may regret the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was the best class I have taken so far at MSU. Loved the class and the professor even more. He makes everything straightforward and clear as well! Would 100% recommend taking it!

Great insight into literature, but harsh essay crique. He told me he gives a slightly lower grade than deserved so that students will revise. Not a ton of reading for an English class, but when you do, it's a lot at once. Fun lectures and held a pizza party for our last class. Just make sure to do well on the essays as there's not lots of grades.

He picked a lot of texts that were actually enjoyable to read and made it fun. There was a quiz every day but they were pretty easy and he gave most of the answers in the lecture. Honestly, I only read about 50% of what was assigned and got a 4.0. He was a good professor and I enjoyed having him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taking IAH107 with Professor Arch was a very positive experience. At first, I was nervous about taking a class about gothic literature but this class was exciting! Attendance for lectures was optional but there were 10-point quizzes only available during them. There is a lot of reading but most of it is short stories. Overall, it was a great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: just get ready to read. main grade is quizzes given during each lecture but he pretty much gives you the answers in class.

Great professor, the class has a lot of reading but it's good material so if you enjoy reading you'll love it. The class itself was rather difficult (at least for me) since literary analysis is not easy, and the writings are tough but each has the option for revision and Arch gives great feedback. Mostly discussion & participation based class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Arch was a very engaging professor who used many forms of media to keep students interested in the class content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I absolutely love love loved prof. Arches class. His lectures were funny and he pretty much gives you the daily quiz answers in his lecture. Good choices for books to read and has good things to say.
