Professor Byron is an amazing professor that genuinely cares about her students. Grading takes awhile and there's not much Spanish spoken, but the class I had with her was very easy and she understood we have other issues outside of class. Weekly reading with the occasional paper and discussion post. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Byron is great! Her class is pretty easy and she speaks in English a lot so it's not too hard to understand. She doesn't grade too hard either, and she seems like a fun lady in general. For a 300 level spanish class, it was definitely better than I was expecting.
She was nice, but the class could have been a lot better if she had been organized. She won't reply to emails, her Spanish isn't the best.
Good teacher, lots of fun
Required course but she made it fun. I learned a lot.
Very good prof. Would take again.
Her class is really easy, if that's what you're looking for. But she hardly ever speaks in Spanish.
Was not helpful, even when I went for help, she's smart and she knows it...
She is a great professor, but does not like brats in class. She knows her stuff and she tries hard to help people with the subject. The class was hard, but quite enjoyable.
No Comments
Unclear, dislikes students, hates giving 4.0s
For a lab it had a lot of assignments. The grading was pretty harsh as well. Definitely not as easy as other labs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Gipson's class, however there was often times lots of work due all at once and it got a little excessive for a 2 credit class. Some of the homework was also really difficult for no reason. Overall, I always felt prepared for the skills assessments, midterm, and final. The teaching team wants you to succeed!

He was okay, I feel that both his expectations and the expectations of the class/course load was a lot considering there would be sometimes 3 assignments due a week and the course is a 2 credit lab. Also, the final study guide was not posted until several hours before the exam (I think he forgot?). He just was a bit strict and the class was too.

Dr Gipson was fun, and the class material prepared me very well for any quizzes or projects. It was definitely a heavy workload for this course, but did not feel overwhelming as long as I stayed on top of it. There is a midterm and final that were both cumulative, but he did not make them too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: While the lecture and actual professor was nice, the recitations with speeches and the weekly 50 question readings were very difficult. Having a harsh TA totally ruined my experience with this class.

The professor himslef was easy going however the classes were kind of boring. Majoritiy of the grade are speaches given in recitation. This is the major downside of this class becuase if you get stuck with a bad TA then you are kind of scrambling to lift your grade. Other than that the homework assignments, quizzes, and the final are pretty easy.

Very interactive, make sure to participate in class/group discussions. Lots of group projects throughout the semester and does not give a lot of guidelines for how to do your work. However, his class was very helpful, and he gives useful constructive criticism.

This professor was very easy going all semester and only had a lecture once a week. Even though he had a lecture once a week I will remember this class because his lectures were always very funny and he is a charasmatic guy and can tell he loves what he does. There is a quiz and reading assignment every week and then 4 speeches throughout semester!

Great teacher! Lectures were long but all contents are pretty interesting. There were a few public speech you need to do. As long as you attend the lectures and do the speech you will be fine. Weekly quizzes but they are all open book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: funny guy, he made the class enjoyable for how long it is. lectures are long and there are speech projects you might have to do. overall easy class and I would take it again

I had COM 101 with him in Fall of 2024. His lectures were mandatory but I didn't mind because they were very engaging. The class includes speaking projects in recitation. He has weekly quizzes but they are online and fairly easy.
There are a few speeches you have to give, but otherwise this class was very easy and fun

Lectures were consistently the most engaging and easy to understand of my first semester at MSU. COM 100 is heavily based on your experience with your TA, however when my TA forgot to put in an assignment at the grade deadline, Professor Carnahan helped me to resolve the issue immediately so I could get my grade increased from a 3.5 to a 4.0.
Very easy class, Carnahan is a good guy and you will get a 4.0 if you just show up and do the speeches.
Great lecture, he did drop a few attendance but they are mostly mandatory (lecture + recitation). A lot points you can achieve with little effort. I took that as an elective but I do really like it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Carnahan is one of the best at MSU. He cares about what he teaches, even in an entry-level course. The lectures are mandatory with attendance, but he will do everything he can to keep you engaged. He uses the online McGraw Hill textbook for weekly readings and quizzes, but you should get an easy 3.5 as long as you try. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Carnahan is great, he's funny and super charismatic. Sometimes lecture gets boring, but he tries his very best to keep it interesting. Downside is, he very heavily uses McGraw Hill's Connect platform which sucks bad and you have to do a lot of readings from the textbook.

Really kind and charismatic professor. His lectures can get boring at times and I feel like some things are overcomplicated, but I'd take it again. He can be unclear with feedback and will find multiple things wrong with anything you turn in, but still grades pretty easily so it's cool.

By far one of the most charismatic and genuine professors I've ever had. The class itself was not too difficult, as long as you attend lectures regularly and pay attention. Exams were slightly challenging but not bad if you study. His lectures were always engaging and funny. You can tell he cares about his students and about what he does.
Very caring professor, listens to the needs of the students and helps out as much as possible. Lectures were very interesting
Amazing professor, definitely my favorite class this semester. He keeps the class engaged and interested.

Easy to follow lectures, lots of information but also good at discussions during. Informative and relevant topics and examples. Relatable, kind and easy-going. Not a harsh grader but his exams are essays and fairly challenging.

Dustin has been one of my favorite professors at Michigan State. I was in his communication class in the spring of 2020. When things were forced transitioned online, Dustin was SO understanding. He was constantly reaching out to students and checking in on us. He even ending up dropping the final exam. Would def recommend him!!

Professor Carnahan was by far my best professor this semester. He was very caring during the difficult times and made having to go online due to the pandemic much simpler than other profs did. He always reminded us that if we needed to talk about anything we could reach out to him at any time and showed how much he cared for us students.

Hilarious Prof, really liked to engage with students, and tried to be relatable. Grades his papers easily, although his exams are very tough. Thankfully, he has quite the curve. I absolutely recommend everyone in ComArtSci take this guy, absolutely excellent.

Class is pretty lecture heavy but overall not super hard. Assignments are very interesting and I would recommend for health majors. There's no exams so assignments and participation determine your final grade.

Dr. Carlson is engaging in class activities and lectures, but the work that comes with it is not great. Her grading criteria is very vague and it feels as though she just expects you to read her mind at times while also grading tough. She also accuses people of using AI but uses no AI tracker to back it up so points are docked for no solid reason.

(For HBIO 410) This class was more focused on research than a traditional lecture and exam style class. The exams involve analyzing a paper as a group and answering questions based on it. There are group projects that accumulate into one final project. The grading is strict however, they provide the rubric they use to grade. Fun class overall!

If you do not do the assignment exactly how it needs to be you are going to get marked down. Also, directions are not always clear read every checklist/directions! Final does include two essays and a minute long video with a partner. Weird class material but I did learn some things.

I would have spirals every week after class because he would talk so much and I couldn't keep up. We were guilt tripped at the end. The only reason I don't regret taking the class is because of my classmates. RELY ON YOUR CLASSMATES! When you work together you can make it through this, and hopefully with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor was one of the worst I've ever had at Michigan State. Be prepared to spend all of your money on books because he required 7 of them. He had a fill in the blank portion on exams, and it's filled with the most random and niche details that you probably wouldn't remember anyways if you did read. He also sucks at responding to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: AVOID!!!! So much reading, weekly in-person hand-written quizzes are on random material from the past weeks. Final/ midterm are in person and you have to write an essay that you won't get the prompt for until you walk in on final day. Harsh grader. Didn't take attendance, but there are quizzes every other class that cannot be made up.

The class itself isn't hard if you show up but there are a lot of textbooks to purchase (some which I spent an upwards of $20 only to read a small passage and then discard). He doesn't allow technology so you can't use a pdf. Your buying books for no reason just to read 20 pages and never use it again. Also a lot of group projects and readings.
Makes you buy SEVEN books, never stops talking and can't stay on one topic for more then 10 minutes. Take any other IAH instead.

Brian Burns is extremely difficult to work with, he will not allow any absences as well as make up work. He expects you to sit and listen to him talk for an hour and 50 minutes every class while also ready up to 150 pages a week. If you don't think his lectures are boring that sucks because no technology is allowed so you're forced to stare at him.

Avoid at all costs. Rants about AI constantly, syllabus is almost never accurate, blames students for doing poorly on his terribly written exams, won't answer questions you ask in class so he can continue his meaningless rants. Surprise group projects not on syllabus, extensive reading assignments, never posts slides, worst class I've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take this class

Please don't take this class. you will suffer it's ridiculous how much quizzes and reading there is. Every week there's a quiz also the mid term and final are the hardest exams too. You have to remember lines from the book and know what word fits in the sentence and you have to remember 15+ portraits for the exams.

Do not make this mistake on taking this class .This is the hardest class I've ever took in my college years. You have to buy 200 dollars worth of books where you read not even half the book and then move on to the next one. He Makes things more complicated than they need to be.Don't take it trying to help you out seriously. He doesn't stop talking
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: After spending $200+ on books, you get to then sit through a 110 min lecture where he cries about his sad life and ai more than teaching. Then maybe putting on a movie or quickly throwing up the laziest slide show (same one all sem btw) After learning close to nothing in class expect a multiple page no notes written response only exam. Disgusting.

never take a class with him. no technology is allowed at all but expects us to spend over $200 on multiple books throughout the semester that we read within a week. one quiz per book based on the reading for the day (which is about 70 pages of reading.) exam consists of writing an essay and 32 questions quoting all the books we've read. pls run.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: First of all, seven books and no technology allowed in the classroom... He talks more about how technology is poisoning society than the actual topic. Be in class or you will fail, and there are impromptu group projects. The grading is easy as long as you read what he tells you. I would never take this class again. Choose a different IAH!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: 7 required *paperback* textbooks that we don't even read the entirety of. Talks about his personal life more than valuable information. he's a waste of my money and time, and that's kind.
Non. Stop. Talking.

If you value your free time and sanity do not take this course with professor Burns. He does not know how to stay on track with the course materials and will bore you to death by going on tangents about god knows what.

I saw reviews that said he yaps a lot, but I figured it couldn't be that bad. Do not make my mistake, it IS in fact that bad. None of it is relevant to the course, and is useless information. He took years off my life in this class, please save yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Had to buy 6 books for this class. Very fast paced and was reading 50+ pages a night. Pop quizzes on books we overlapped reading. Never answers emails so don't even try.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: No phones, laptops or tablets in class. No textbooks but over $230 of individual books. That list of books was not correct until the second week. Does not update course schedule. Impromptu essays on exams. D2L was not available until the second week and is rarely used.
Sent me into a mid-life crisis at 13. Now I'm only gonna make it to 26.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

Dr. Burns' entire class consists of 2 hour, long-winded lectures that don't engage students. He is boring, rants, gives vague instructions, and won't respond to emails. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was difficult, and had group essays which I've never done before! But he really helped me grow in my writing, and he definitely talks a lot. A difficult challenge but a welcome one to be sure. If you do not wish to read a lot of content don't take this class then.

reviews.comment: I was very unhappy with Dr. Burns. I emailed him several times for help, and he basically told me I was out of luck. teaches well focuses on some things that dont matter. Easy grader

Lots of writing and reading which is expected of the course! genuinely helped me grow as a writer so so much- his lectures were always amusing and you could never quite guess what would happen next. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Burns for both ISHALL 1+2. Genuinely the worst classes I've taken. He goes on for ages on irrelevant lectures and never drives it to a point. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: While I did a good job grade wise during my year of ISHALL, the year was miserable altogether. If you do even one extracurricular on top of this; don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Burns is a very nice man, but not a very good professor. Best professor I ever had. Definitely chooses favorites which I was one of. Hes an acquired taste to say the least but genuinely wants you to succeed and loves his job. reviews.comment: fun guy, but you have to have a unique sense of humor to like his class. defintley has favorites, so make a good first impression. One of my favorite teachers of all time though, would recommend his class. Talks alot and gets distarcted easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Get ready to read is an understatement. Burns is an interesting guy and can talk your ear off for the entire two hour lecture on any subject his tangent is focused on that day. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Ishall 1 has to be one of the greatest classes that I have ever taken. One of the most difficult, of course, but it is just such a great opportunity for HS students. The lectures are always engaging, as is the large load of classwork, if you put in the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: not a bad teacher, but his lectures are boring and the readings are long. sparknotes is your friend. put effort into your essays. overall; boring, but nice pro tip: ask him to draw a map of europe. you will not be disappointed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: As long as you have a general idea about the readings you will do well in the class. Lectures can be boring at times, but slides do have useful information when it comes to the midterm and final. Overall funny guy, and great class.

I did not like this class very much. My TA was very bias and opinionated. His lectures are possibly the most boring thing on this earth. Going to recitation helps a lot. TAs of all the grading. class is mandatory due to the 7b unannounced quizzes over the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Burns was an okay teacher. He had a lot to say about small details and was always going off on tangents that did not make sense. He is an easy grader, but the homework is definitely not easy. Long readings and difficult prompts. Very difficult to understand and is often not helpful when it comes to group work or homework.

Says cool a lot - which automatically makes him cool. I recommend actually reading the material so you know what you're doing. Grades all details and challenges you to improve. NOT AN EASY CLASS YOU MUST WORK FOR IT! Extremely helpful teacher. I recommend taking this if you want to improve your English skills:

Had him for a year, he likes to ramble about small details which maybe mean something to him but not to the class, cares about the content rather than the grammar, digresses into irrelevant topics, wasnt really clear at all, easy A if you use sparknotes to help you get the main idea, using his analyzations in papers  usually gets you an A.

He does seem like he knows the material pretty well, but he repeatedly interrupts group work with random anecdotes and stories that ramble on. He's an easy grader and seems more focused on content than nit picking the grammar and structure of a paper which i like. Can be funny at times, and is way better when you're one on one with him.
Topic was Frankenstein. Was an ok class with a solid professor. No complaints.

I came into the class without any interest in poetry. However, I managed to get a 4.0 because he is very clear about what he wants in the papers and very willing to answer questions. The quizzes were another story, but if you do fine on the papers, it's not hard to do well in the class.

It is very obvious that he knows his stuff. However, he is not very good at coming across clearly to students. Class consists of 1 hour and 20 minutes of rambling information and disorganization. He frequently ignores student questions and is vague on expectations for tests and essays. One of my worst experiences at MSU this far.
He tells you exactly how to get a good grade. If you do those things you can't go wrong. Good teacher.
He tries to make his class fun. Class is very easy if you do what you're supposed to i.e. papers, midterm, and readings. I got a 4.0 and didn't study much.

Although the class itself was boring, the professor was VERY helpful. You could tell he really loved his job and was willing to do anything he could to raise a grade. The downfall was there were 4 books and they are all necessary. He is an easy grader and a funny guy.
Wouldn't recommend taking this class.
Good teacher and willing to help out. He is VERY specific with what you should get out of a poem on tests.
He is a nice man, but very confusing!  It is hard to decipher exactly what he wants from students.
Eh just a boring class all around. Theres profs who may give you more interesting work with less of the effort of the random assignments.
Honestly one of best professors I have had here. Actually cares and interacts with the students. If you have the chance to take her please do so.

Very nice prof and easy class, mostly just show up and you'll do fine. Exams are a little difficult so study well for those, some questions are very specific to her lectures but she gives a nice study guide to work with. Attendance is mandatory but you get one free drop for it so nbd. Only 4 easy assignments homework-wise for the entire semester
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is extremely easy. Highly recommend taking this for the business minor. There is a lot of work to do but if you sit down and do it for like an hour and a half you can get a months worth of work done. Just don't forget to take the unit exam.

This class is entirely online and consists of completing assignments through McGraw Hill. There's very little additional lecture material or instructor created content beyond what's on McGraw Hill. The workload is around two hours a week, but it feels more like busy work than meaningful learning. If you want to be taught something, do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was very enjoyable and I learned a lot. It is online asynchronous and the course was broken into three different modules and he gives you lots of time to complete each module. There is also an exam after each module. It is through McGraw Hill and I have had no complaints about this class whatsoever and would absolutely take it again!

A great class. Though everything is done through McGraw Hill so if you don't like that website this might not be a good class for you. It's broken up into 3 modules and you get about a month to do each one. They all have about 5 chapters in them. Very easy and enjoyable class to pass as long as you do the work!

Dr. C was my favorite professor. If you miss a class, you can make it up by attending office hours to get credit for the missed class. If you miss an assignment due date shes very chill about letting you turn stuff in late. I personally liked talking to her during our office hours, and she was always lovely and greeted everyone who entered.

i loved her she was so sweet. Pretty much all WRA101 classes are set up the same so theres not much u can do about the content of the class, but she made it easy to handle bc u get so much time in class to work on the assignments. I went to every class and rarely had to do anything outside of class. i had a 8am but it was worth it to me
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely sweet human and great professor. Gives a lot of time for the work to be done and has extremely clear requirements. She knew every student by name and seems to actually care for them. Very easy class with a very good professor if you even put in like 60% effort you should have no struggle getting a 4.0 this class. Highly recommend

Dr. C is one of the most caring professors I have met at MSU, she is truly interested in your journey as a writer and wants you to enjoy class and learning in general. Also very open to assisting with honors options, or any projects that are of interest to you.

My favorite professor ever, never meant a teacher who cared more about her students. Always would help and wants her students to get a 4.0. If you do the work you will 4.0. Do anything in your favor to get her!
Kind, inspirational, and wise.

Prof Ceaser is very sweet and helps every student. She was also very understanding considering all classes are online right now and made sure each student succeeded in the class. 1000/10 recommend for WRA 101.
Very nice and sweet, will do anything to make sure you have the opportunity to pass the course, makes sure you're doing okay outside of class so she knows why you are struggling (if you are).

reviews.comment: gooood

Unfortunately, many of the students that do poorly in has class lack adequate math/engineering skills/aptitude to take the class and have bad experiences. More unfortunate, many of those students graduate!
He is a very good prof.

his exams are difficult. very helpfull during office hours.
The best professor I have ever seen.

I don't understand why he always looks impatiant in class. Always use very difficult exams to show his smartness. After taking one semester of his class, I have to acknowledge this is the worst prof. I've seen.

I had him in the summer.  I rarely went to class but when I did he wasn't very good.  The tests were very difficult but he passed me because it was the last class I had before I graduated.  I guess he's helpful in office hours but I never went to any.
He is just an unreasonable person. He is not even a mechanical engineer! Also his face is full of frowns:( JUST DONT TAKE HIS COURSE!!!
Try your best to avoid this guy. It is a nightmare to take his course.

Ce is a great professor. He speaks in a very slight accent, so it can be hard to understand him at times but it's not that bad. He clearly knows what he's talking about and is very passionate. He goes very slow and can go over the same stuff a lot, but his lectures are still interesting. As long as you pay some attention, you'll pass.
Very engaging and allowed notes for exams

Class is very exam heavy however the midterms are pretty easy. It was the final that was very hard however. He also allows cheat sheets on the exams. There are weekly HW assignments that can be kind of long. Attendance is mandatory because of Clicker but lectures are really boring. He also curved grades for us(cutoff for a 4.0 was a 83%)
Would not recommend. Didn't teach well and practice test did not correlate to exams

Professor was very kind and caring. He rounded up the grades at the end of the semester even though he said he wasn't going to. Homework was easy, lectures were packed but he posts them. I struggles and still passed. Would take a class by him again!

Ce Liu is very efficient in how he runs the class. There are 2 attendance points per class, 1 homework assignment a week, and 3 exams (excluding the optional exam.) The exams are worth roughly 70% of the grade so study up! I am already bad at economics and his teaching style just wasn't for me. He is not very good about answer emails either.

Ce Liu wouldn't be a recommendable professor if economics comes harder for you. On exams, I got a 75% when I played Papa's Pizzeria in class, compared to when I actually listened and studied, I got a significantly lower score. His lectures are very confusing as he spends too much time on the easy questions and too little time on the harder ones.

Liu is a nice guy, and I found his class to be very easy (spent more time reading my emails than anything else in the lectures). The lecture hall is tight for fitting so many students in, and Liu can sometimes not explain things well. But it was an easy class and I would take it again. 4.0 is an 85, so the cutoff is fairly generous.

He seems very passionate about what he teaches but micro is just hard to grasp. I went to every lecture, did all the homeworks, and still scored below a 65% on every exam with each exam being 23% of your grade. Its also in a huge lecture hall and the seats are usually taken up pretty fast, nothing else to note.

Need an 85 to get a 4.0, not as easy as it sounds. Liu's lectures are tough to follow, and I basically had to teach the entire class to myself. Exams are worth about 70% of your total but exam class averages were around a 65% and there was no curve. If you have minimal experience in econ prior to this course I would consider a different professor.

He was pretty good but his lectures made absolutely no sense i studied so hard for this class and went to every single lecture and it just lowkey made me more confused i would take a different professor if you don't understand econ easily
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty good professor, does genuinely care about students understanding the material and pretty fair. I showed up but barely paid attention and still got a 4.0 easily but as long as you pay attention and keep up with homework (which he gives more than enough time for) you have nothing to worry about.

Getting a 4.0 in Micro is hard, even when the grade distribution is 85% to reach it. The professor was great; he went over everything pretty slowly, which was a downside, but it didn't affect my learning. Just the overall content is pretty difficult, and if I were to retake this, I would try to be more attentive.

This was one of the worst classes ive taken. The 85 for a 4.0 is NOT easy. I attended every lecture, took notes, studied, did all homework, and still got below 68 on each exam. Cheat sheet seems like it'll help but since theres only 32 questions on 5+ chapters its hard to know what to put on there, I barely ended up using them. Would NOT recommend
You need an 85 to 4.0 the class but this is more difficult than it sounds. For me what helped pass was I used the econ help rooms for homework and then to better understand the topics being taught.

Avoid this man at all costs, worst professor I've had in all my 4 years. No test curves, no extra credit. Don't be fooled by the 85 for a 4.0, it is not as easy as it sounds. My class average for our 2nd exam was a 61, and he refused to curve it, really just feels like he is praying on our downfall. If you are in ec201 avoid him at all costs.

Attendance is mandatory on iClicker, the lecture is basically just him reading off powerpoint slides. One homework a week which is very easy. The exams are pretty difficult and practice exams don't really help all that much. The textbook is pointless to buy.

Just don't use chat gpt on the homework + attend the lectures and you'll be fine. You get cheat sheets for the exam but they can be tricky. You only need an 85% in the class for a 4.0 though which is very doable. I've never opened the textbook he told us to buy though. Ce Liu is a chill guy overall.

Ce Liu is a dawg. In the past, I've had trouble understanding economics, and taking this class was a breath of fresh air. Professor Liu is interesting. I found it easy to concentrate and take notes in this class. The exams are difficult, but practice exams and problems are provided and are optional. 10/10 would take again.

The class was basically him just reading slides the whole time, which is fine, but attendance is graded so its kind of pointless when you have to go back and teach yourself the material before exams. The class is pretty boring, but it is not super difficult to understand. Plus, all materials are posted on D2L.

Mandatory attendance for a moderately easy class (10% of grade). Lectures were boring but at least the notes are posted. He says textbook required but you really won't need it. Grind practice problems to succeed. He can be a funny dude if you pay attention. Exams were not too bad. Overall, Professor Liu was decent but not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good guy. very knowledgeable just a tough class. if i had to take micro again i would def take it with him
Bro yaps abt some random stuff too much
The lectures are boring, but its not really his fault, tough class to teach. He is funny, but the class is hard.
i love celiu

I personally thought he is a great professor, I just think micro is difficult. in this class you only need an 85% to 4.0 which I thought was very leniant.and per chapter every week you have a 20 question homework assignment. I personally never took any notes and just listened to the lecture and I did fine. I really recommend you take this professor

The professor is friendly, however the class itself is so boring. In the lectures, he sometimes spends twenty minutes on one practice problem, which makes it incredibly easy to get distracted and lose focus. I feel like I had to teach myself a lot of the material before each of the exams.
I pretty much taught myself and the whole class was struggling with the in class iClickers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was sooo boring. The lectures were slow and we would spend half the class on one simple problem which makes you not want to go even though attendance is graded. The class is curved so it's not a ton a work to get a good grade. Overall I would recommend taking this class with another professor.

There are two heavily weighted midterms + a cumulative final with homework and iclicker questions that do basically nothing for your grade. Liu is monotone and quiet and seems unprepared, you basically have to teach yourself. you never know what your grade is bc it isn't curved until after the semester ends.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Liu was a pretty laid-back professor. He is a little quiet when he talks so if you want to do decent in his class, you gotta sit towards the front of the class. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he sounded unprepared for every lecture and he speaks very low and there were several times students mentioned that but it felt like he turned his volume down. if you take time to study and pay attention it wont be that bad but it is a difficult class. there are at least 1-2 quizzes a week with 35 questions 2 midterms and 1 final. t

Ce Liu gives 80 points of homework for free, 15 iclicker questions for free. We have 1-2 hw's due a week and are around 36 questions each, but you get two attempts. Exams are easier than the homeworks and if you do the practice midterm you'll be fine. iclicker questions are graded by correctness, but if you just do the question you get 1/2 points.

Although I did terrible in his class, I thought Ce was a good prof. He was very kind to us and he tried to keep his lectures entertaining. He was kind of funny without trying to be. His class is hard but I just think econ is hard. I would recommend him if you have to take 201.
Good professor the only thing is that he was a little hard to understand but the grading was easy and it was a good class.

Class was not too hard but he only allows for the top 15% of students in the class to get a 4.0. Kinda rude sometimes as well and you never know what percentage of the class you are in as it is graded on a curve that is constantly changing so you arent sure how you are doing compared to others.
He was a super great professor! Was really funny and charismatic. Recommend if you need to take econ

I am terrible at economics and this class is extremely easy. The material he uses to teach this class is very straight forward. As long as you show up to class you will get a good grade. He takes attendance usually but you don't have to pay attention in class. Just do the practice exams and you'll be fine, they are the same as the tests. Easy!

This professor doesn't care enough about you to actually listen to what you say. Nor does he care about you actually learning (told me to answer the questions without access to the material). Don't take this person's class if you are human. I was in a motorcycle crash and broke my laptop. I showed him and he said use your phone without studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very simple and straight forward class. Funny guy. Lectures are as entertaining as any lecture can be on Econ. Show up to class to get the in class participation points. Attendance isn't taken, but is required unless you're very confident in your exam ability.

Posted his lecture power points online so come in to have him explain them. Very personable teacher and made new material straightforward to learn and constantly asked the class if they had questions. Available office hours. Homework due every Sunday, but a majority of it was very easy and could be found on quizlet.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class was very enjoyable. Professor gave amazing lectures and has a great personality. Not too much homework and overall it was pretty easy. If you take notes during or after the class you should be able to do well on the exams. I recommend this professor and class!

Amazing prof, she is passionate about her students and the subject. She treats everyone with such kindness and inspired me throughout the semester to fall in love with language and writing and sharing it. The syllabus can be a little confusing, and the grading scale is challenging (96% to 4.0) but if you put work in your grade will reflect that.

Cindy Hunter-Morgan is an absolutely amazing professor. I cannot stress enough how inspirational her passion for writing is, or how much she cares about her students. She helped me improve my writing tremendously over the course of the semester, and even as an "English person" her class challenged me to become a better writer. tldr; she's awesome!

Cindy Hunter Morgan is the best human that I have met at this university. She has inspired me to WANT to read and write in my free time. She makes you work for the grade but I know that she just sees everyone's potential. I just wanna give her a hug.

Cimberly's organization was extremely confusing, and assignments were very loosely defined, leading to a lot of confusion. The class was extremely easy (as long as you did the very minimal homework) until the last month, when there were multiple group presentations. Overall, an easy 4.0, but can be confusing at times.

Attendance is MANDATORY. If you don't show up you won't pass. Group project is a huge part of the class with multiple presentations. She gets mad at students for having their computers open or doing anything besides paying attention. She will also get mad at you for being 5 mins late.

Overall, the class is an easy 4.0. If you go to class and complete your assignments it's a guaranteed A. The problem I had with her is that she can be very condescending whenever you speak to her, as many have said before. She gets worked up when the class isn't engaged, but gives lackluster lectures that sways no student to be engaged.
Super easy class but she is a micromanager in every way

Cimberly is a very nice professor. But I felt like she would send condescending emails to you if you hadn't submitted a discussion, even if it was before the due date. In office hours, she would be very distracted and not really listening to you. I get she's busy but the multitasking made me feel unimportant.
She wants the best for everyone. Super cool and understanding. wants to set you up to succeed outside her class

Professor Cioni is a fever dream. Shes the "type of Professor that answers a question with a question. She also seems like she secretly hates her class but I can't prove that. Not amazing professor if you wanna learn math.

I took her for MTH 103B and the class was miserable to go to, some days there would be an "extra credit" participation that would also take away points if it was missed. During the classes she would complain about her previous class not participating and would talk down on the class if they weren't answering the most common sense questions ever.
THIS IS THE WORST MATH TEACHER EVER. SHE CONFUSES YOU AND WONT REALLY HELP. THE TA NAMED JACOB IS AMAZING. JULIE GOTTA GOOOOOOO!!

She is an okay professor, I would recommend taking another professor if you have to take this class, I relied on the TA, he is the reason why I passed this class to be honest, she talks when students are taking a quiz, not to mention she can be condescending in a way that she talks to her students. just HORRIBLE. don't take her for your own sake.

If you pay attention and put effort into studying you will do fine in this class, but you will need to be teaching yourself. Cioni was good on some days and others not so much. Every time I asked a question I would still be left confused because she could never answer it fully.

He covered the material once and explained it in a way that finally clicked for everyone  clear, direct, and easy to follow. Terrible teacher
Professor Cioni is the worst professor I have ever had; she rambles on all class and goes off topic constantly, find any other professor!

She doesn't teach hard the time in lectures she will show you brand new notes you've never seen than give you 30 minutes to work on the material you never learned. she also grades in a weird way so if you get one thing wrong yo basically fail the exam. if you have to take this class try choosing a different professor.

She does not care about her students nor the job. She doesn't go over things well enough and the webwork quizzes do not align with what we learn in class. She yaps about random things and does not talk about the actual math material. She is disrespectful when you try to ask her questions and if she does answer it is very condescendingly.

Cioni is actually a caring professor as long as you participate in class, but MTH103A/B throw way too much @ you for a class that is unrelated to most majors yet is required. She does a bad job at teaching math. If you want to learn how to do any of the math you will need to just watch it on YouTube where they explain is 10 times better.

Can be a bit confusing with the way she teaches but overall I had no issue with her teaching style as long as you pay attention in class. She often holds numerous office hours and is very willing to help

Prof. Cioni is a tough grader, and she does state her grading criteria at the start of the semester. With that said, she was a helpful teacher outside and inside the classroom, but she was rude at times, and also she thought that all of the students in her sections had to know at least 3 or 4 of her subjects from high school already.

The professor has a very weird teaching style that makes almost no sense. You go over and do the notes together in class but you only do maybe 3 pages out of like 15. So what you're just supposed to figure out the rest on your own? Yup. Most of my learning from this class came from youtube videos.

Awful at explaining, barely goes over the notes. I basically had to teach myself everything, which was extremely difficult. Every time I asked a question to her or her teaching assistants, I was more lost than I was before I asked the question. quizzes are only graded out of 4, and I was once marked down for "overexplaining" my answer.

The only reason I passed was that I taught myself/retaught myself everything. She can be a little rude when talking to students. She always seems to do the easiest problems in class then has us do the hard problems by ourselves. The webwork also doesn't really help on quizzes and exams. Most of the time the webwork is different than the notes.

reviews.comment: She does go over the material a bit fast during lectures but she's always eager to explain everything after class and during office hours. Prof. Cioni really wants you to understand what's being taught and so she takes her time coming up with great analogies when you meet her one on one. She's surprisingly approachable.
She is a great teacher. She really cares about her students succeeding. Please attend her office hours she will really work with you so you can have that grade you would like.

If you want to sit in a class and be confused for most of it this is your class. The whole semester I felt as if I was being rushed and she had no time for questions and made you feel dumb whenever asking a question. She would try to explain each problem but would simply confuse you even more and leave you with more questions than answers.

I'm a freshman this year and I absolutely love Professor Cioni. She is one of my favorites. She is very nice and helpful. She wants you to pass her class and to understand what she is teaching and welcomes questions unless she is running out of time.

I really like the concept of this class because it is split. However, her specifically as a professor really changed the game. I felt really disrespected half the time. reviews.comment: I rarely went to class but I passed every quiz and exam. She posts everything online. Does not tell good stories to try and explain math problems.

She is the most annoying teacher I've ever had and is pretty bad at explaining the materials (so no one goes to class). spends a lot of time just being upset. if you get all the answers right on a unit, but don't explain something well enough, you get a 2. get one answer wrong and it's a 1 for an entire unit. don't take 103A-B just do regular 103

She is honestly the best math teacher I have ever had and my grades reflect that. I have always struggled with math but not in professor Cionis class. She takes the time to break everything down to the point where you don't just memorize how to do the problem you understand every aspect of how it works with out throwing to much in there.
Great professor! She is very smart and cares for everypne in the class to learn and ask questions. The class is never boring and she good at explaining.

Took MTH102 with her as the lecturer, her lectures are a bit boring and you have to print out note packets frequently. The course itself is extremely easy and there are only 3 tests the whole semester. Recitations are mandatory, the lecture is not.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: I thought she was a great professor. She was to the point and told you exactly what you needed to know. She also did a great job of reviewing before each quiz/exam as best as she could. I would recommend her, she made me not hate going to math lecture.

What is expected is clear and to the point. If you skip lecture you won't know what is going on however the tests are hard. This class was overly challenging as trick problems are constantly thrown on tests.

She teaches MTH 1825 and although I never had as my instructor, I've dealt with Julie plenty. She has this attitude about her that annoys me. She acts way too much like this is a high school instead of a university. We're all adults here. If she has a problem, she should kick them out the room. Instead, she yells and talks like you are a child.

Great professor. She was always very concerned for her students and always made sure everyone knew when deadlines were coming up. She gave everyone a million opportunities to get help or to ask questions and she always had good examples. She also reviewed before every test to make sure everyone was as ready as possible.

(GD 491) SheS nice enough, but not very organized. I found myself frustrated at times bc I was never sure what was being asked of me, and she rarely ever checked in with her students on an individual level which would've been nice because I felt lost sometimes. I like creative freedom but it was almost too open-ended.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall this class was great, but sometimes it felt like we were just trying to fill time with the mandatory attendance. The graded assignments were all clear and straight-forward. Rebecca is amazing and truly cares for your well being, and is always ready to help. Just be prepared to do a bit of supplemental reading outside of the graded work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cifaldi's course was fairly easy, but she didn't really convey what we were supposed to do for a lot of assignments very clearly, and her feedback was not really that helpful. She also doesn't seem that great with the technology, and the class had a heavy analogue focus. She's nice though, and if you put in a little effort you'll do fine.

Cifaldi is a lovely woman BUT a rough professor. I've taken two of her graphic design classes and both have been a waste of my time. All her classes center around is theory and readings - that's all you do is READ. You never actually do any creative projects or use the skills you've learned. I know theory is important but she's so incredibly boring
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Super sweet. Really cares about each student and takes the time to walk around and see how everyone is doing with assignments and projects. The whole semester revolved around group work related to putting together the final project.

Professor Cifaldi is great! She's really kind and you definitely won't have a bad time in her class. She genuinely cares for what she teaches and her students wellbeing. Super understanding. She provides many XC opportunities if your grade flunks. Would definitely recommend, I hope I can take another class from her.

I love this professor. Super nice, communicates well, and truly cares about the mental health of her students. She was also ready, present, and prepared for class, She was super engaging and I wish more professors at MSU where like her. She should be teaching a class on how to be a professor. :)

I loved this class. Prof Cifaldi was an amazing woman who wants to bring new ideas into class. The textbook is used throughout the class, but she provided it for us so no need to purchase it. Focused a lot of new artists, and also artists often overlooked in history. Definitely worth taking one of her classes.
He really cares about what he teaches and is very knowledgeable about reproduction! Cares about his students.

I absolutely loved Dr. Cibelli. I took his class because it was the only thing that fit into my schedule. It ended up being my favorite class of the semester. Dr. Cibelli is so smart, kind, and passionate and so clearly wants his students to succeed. His exams are majorly based on the quizzes and in class questions. 10/10 recommend.

I absolutely loved Dr. Cibelli. I enrolled in his class because it was the only one that fit in my schedule. I did not have an interest in animal reproduction. It became my favorite class of the semester. Dr. Cibelli is so smart and kind, passionate about what he does, and so clearly wants his students to succeed. His exam expectations were clear.

He is a nice guy who knows a lot about animal reproduction. The material itself was pretty confusing and he goes through the lectures super fast but as long as you write everything down from his slides you'll be good. All his quizzes and exams were online and most of the material could be found on his lecture slides.

This prof was AWESOME!! Super helpful and knowledgable about animal reproduction. Everything that was on exams/ quizzes could be directly found in the powerpoint slides, so I'd recommend writing everything down. He kept things interesting and genuinely cares for his students.
He literally just makes no sense. It feels like he doesn't even know what he's talking about. So many discussion posts with confusing wording.

I totally recommend him! Super fun and laid back. He is so passionate about what he teaches and it shows! He's also accommodating and he genuinely really cares about his students. He always has a smile on his face and he loves to see students' work. He does a lot of group projects, so if you're not into that thing, that's something to be aware of.
I 10/10 recommend this professor! He was extremely accommodating, and both the midterm and final project were group projects. We watched a lot of interesting movies, and we often got out early

Professor Emery is really nice and wants his students to acheive. His class consists of lectures, and the midterm and final are group projects, which is nice. Most of the homework you receive is weekly discussion posts about topics you learned in class that week. I would recommend only buying the least expensive book he tells you to purchase.

Professor Emery is kind, and it's clear that he truly loves teaching. For this IAH course, we watched & analyzed horror movies, which I absolutely loved. We watched a lot of really good stuff, and the discussions were also engaging. There was little homework, usually just a discussion post a week, 1 group presentation, a final project, & a midterm.

Prof Emery is so nice and understanding. His lectures are never too intense and he often has breaks. We also get out early more often than not. There are no quizzes/exams, just a midterm group project and final group project plus one discussion post a week. You get 4 absences, your grade goes down by .5 (letter grade) per absence after. Nice class
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Emery is a great prof. The work load of this class can be a lot, but nothing one couldn't handle. Excellent, engaging professor. Definitely one of the best I've ever had.
He is the hottest teacher at this university and he dresses extremely well.  He is funny and entertaining which makes his class great to go to.  I highly recommend it
SHES AMAZINGGGGG

Love her! Recommend 10/10 for the Learning through Drama class!! Easy to talk to:)

Dr. Crosson is a thorough professor and is good at what he does. He is very knowledgable in the content and is super caring/understanding! Dr. Crosson is truly a great professor, and I wish I could have him again.
