reviews.comment: Good course and interesting subject
Excellent experience
I enjoyed this course but you have to put in the work.
Great class. Nice prof

Found the course difficult, but very interesting. It made me want pursue my major in Microbiology. He provided a decent amount of extra credit opportunities, which was nice. If you take really detailed notes and go to all of the classes, you'll be fine. Definitely use the learning objectives! The additional reading was pretty interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Delekta was an awful prof, especially considering the online format due to COVID. His expectations are clear, but it is also apparent he couldn't care less about his students and what they learn. The exams are extremely hard, but open note. Make a really good cheat sheet and it's doable. Lectures are prerecorded from prior years and dry.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She seems like a nice person but her teaching style does not work for most students and the course is very disorganized with no structure. Her lecture slides are random and confusing. The homework assignments have no connection to the exams. The projects have no clarity or expectations so students have to figure out what to do with no guidance.

DO NOT take this class unless absolutely necessary. Homework is insanely confusing and assignments will not be graded until the last week of class (no answer keys either) making it impossible to know where your grade is at and prepare for exams.There is ALWAYS a mistake on exams that has to be corrected mid-exam. She's nice but CANNOT teach.

Her assignments are so genuinely stupid and arbitrary and have nothing to do with what is on exams. You'll spend 4 hrs on an assignment and then it is entirely unhelpful for exams. Lectures are all over the place and there is ALWAYS a mistake on the exams that she needs to fix mid-test.

She would tell students to text her with issues, but then NEVER responded to text or email. I had multiple instances where I needed to set up a meeting (which she encouraged) or had emergencies or technical issues, and she was never available to provide support. her lectures are all over the place and homework is not helpful for exams at all.

Lectures are confusing and never seem to cover things on hw or exams. She posts d2l quizzes to complete hw but you only get 1 attempt and can't access them after; if you mess up you have no way to access the actual problem. Her d2l is confusing and she often has you submit assigments multiple times which can be confusing and easy to miss deadlines.

Very unclear on homework assignments and only gives you a day or two to complete them (very atypical to other engineering classes). Homework assignments consistently have errors making it impossible to complete them correctly. Designs the class so that you must go in for office hours to receive a good grade. Very unaccessible to students who work.

This is Prof Dechand's first time teaching BE 230 and it shows. The lectures jump all over the place and the homework is mostly unrelated. She focuses more on what is not important for exam material, and difficult calculations she skips over. She also has poor communication. She seems nice, but her instruction is truly confusing and unhelpful.
She is good at making sure we all are learning and understanding the material and slowing down if needed and answering all questions

Goes over basic material in class and then makes homeworks and exams extremely confusing with no explanation. Expects you to come to office hours if you want to perform well on homework but it is almost impossible to do alone. Cannot convey material clearly for the life of her. I do not recommend. Class itself would be better with someone else.
The exams were difficult and there was a large range of material to cover but Dr. Dechand is very nice and willing to help.
Sweetest guy ever. Cares so much about his students and the communities he works with. He is extremely understanding of student circumstances and works super hard.

Bro he is obsessed with himself it's kinda insane. He rambles on and on, forces us to read websites about him and videos WITH A PAYWALL. He starts playing good songs and then stops right before the best part. He wears performative hats.

Biggest humble bragger I've ever met. Teaches a prison poetry class in which students go to a juvenile detention center and an all male prison. Very interesting of course, however throughout your journey Guriellmo is going to do his best to drill into your mind what a great person he is for what he's doing. Kind of gross and feels self righteous.

Guillermo is a very good professor who is very committed to his community engagement work. He cares deeply about his students' success and did an amazing job facilitating the incarcerated poetry collaboration project. One of my favorite professors so far.

literal GOAT -  class is a lot of work but if you pay attention in class it is so easy. genuinley take advantage of her teaching style and really try to learn bc the professors for acc202 genuinley dont teach and just excpect you to have learned the topics previously or through the reading. She also offers extra credit throughout the semester.

I am not a big fan of ACC but she made it manageable. She gives a lot of practice test and good homework that aligns. The exams do make or break your grade so make sure not to study last minute. But the TAS are super nice and will help you out a lot. You also get 3 recitation drops which is really nice.

Best professor i've ever had. She genuinely cares about the students and wants kids to succeed. Exams are tough but not impossible if preparation is put in. Lots of due assignments so neither one thing is gonna make or break your grade in the class. Plenty of resources available to get help in the class if needed.

The grade i got reflects the effort i put in pretty much. She teaches well and is available for students outside of class, i just don't care much for accounting. 3-4 homework assignments a week, which make up a decent chunk of your grade. Exams were tough but not impossible as long as you study and prepare.
Just do what you are supposed to do and the class really isn't that bad. Like seriously

Allison was great! I missed a 4.0 by .09% cause I bombed the final, but I wouldn't say that was her fault. HW is easy if you keep up with it and her lectures actually help you understand the material. Super nice too! Go and talk to her after class sometimes

Allison is an amazing professor. As someone who was dreading taking accounting, she made the material easy to understand and organized the course in a way that helped me so much. There is a decent amount of work but if you stay on top of it and go to lectures you'll do fine!

I don't understand why some people are giving her bad reviews and genuinely think they just want to blame her for their shortcomings. Professor Dellapelle does a great job at explaining hard-to-understand concepts and overall is a fair grader. She provides lots of material to help with exams, and she models them after the unit practice questions.

Everyone here is blaming everyone but themselves for getting a bad grade, bc she is a great professor. Great teacher, accommodating, no issues with textbooks. If you take notes in lectures and participate in recitation, the class is a breeze. The lessons and homework are directly related. She lets you use a cheat sheet on every exam.

This class is tough but fair. Some didn't take it seriously and expected it to be easy, so go cry about it. Prof. Dellapelle is a perfectionist who cares about her students. She fixed the homework structure even though only a few had issues. Yeah, we paid $90, but mistakes happen and she handled it well.

There are only 2 quizzes and 2 exams throughout the entire course. SO it is VERY important to give assessments your all. She is not very homework heavy in the course but make sure to go to every lecture since they are very material heavy and she uses Iclicker.

Allison made us buy a $90 online book just to have us not use it for more than 2 weeks. I did extremely well on all assignments, and despite studying HARD I did absolutely terrible on the exams. The exams have trick questions and the study questions she gives are nothing like the exam questions. iClicker is worth a lot of your grade also!
She is a great lecturer with a lot of energy. The quizzes and exams barley correlate with the unit practices and homework. Seemed like the quizzes/tests were designed specifically to trick you.

Lectures were very fast paced and sometimes hard to keep up with. What got me through the semester was watching her lecture videos to take notes and doing the practice questions. There were about 16 points offered for extra credit which isn't a lot but it gave me the small boost that I needed in order to get a 4.0 in the course.

Dellapelle made us buy McGraw-Hill for nearly no use, only about 9 EC points, wasting our money. The class was disorganized, vague, and sloppy, leaving students feeling set up to fail despite putting in work. Expectations were unclear, grading lacked consistency, and the materials provided failed to align with what was on the exams.
Awful experience with her. amazed by how bad she is, do yourself a favor and find another acc 201 professor

I really liked her lectures, i think they were very engaging and informative. I think the material I learned from the class will help me a lot out into the future, but the quizzes and exams are just really different from practice quizzes, homework, and other assignments. It doesn't seem necessary to make the course like this.

Professor Dellapelle is a great teacher, and you should do well in the class if you are willing to put in the work to study. She gives a refined topic list before each quiz and exam which literally give you exactly which subjects you will be tested on, so just study those concepts before the exams and you'll be fine. Very engaging lectures.

I can genuinely say that I learned close to nothing in this class. The lectures, practice quizzes, & homework WILL NOT prepare you for assessments. Allison does examples in class without writing them down, says them and expects us to follow. Ironically, she takes ZERO accountability for our terrible class average. Save yourself and take it at LCC.

Honestly I think half of these reviews are bots or Allison herself. She tells us to prepare by going through each and every units practice quiz, but half of the questions on all these practice quizzes don't pertain to the final exam and only 2-3 out of the 20-25 practice questions on each of the unit quizzes is actually on the exam.

Allison is one of the best professors I have had at MSU. She offers a bit of extra credit, but generally the material in this class is complicated, but she engages with her students and truly cares. If you prepare for the exams, you should learn how these exams work over the semester. Allison truly cares about her students and their outcomes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Accounting sucks, but Dellapelle is amazing. She's a very engaging lecturer and sets clear expectations of what you should be doing to succeed. If you follow her advice and pay attention in class, you'll do really well. Resources like help room, office hours, and HiTA were accessible and incredibly helpful. She wants everyone to do well.

Professor is a solid teacher who explains things very well, while also being extremely organized. However, tests are pretty hard, and material is not directly covered in class. Along with that, purchased a half-cooked McGraw hill class that did not work, and then abandoned it 3 weeks into the semester.

The class is hard but Mrs.Dellapelle is amazing. She is so organized and concise. If you pay attention during lecture and follow her very clear instructions on how to succeed you will do really good in the class.

This class is very challenging. She teaches it as if we aren't beginners in accounting. It is very frustrating because the homework does not match up with the quizzes and exams at all which is very deceiving. She doesn't seem to care at all if you pass or fail the class.

I did not vibe with her, the class itself is hard without her horrible teaching. She is bad at explaining and just tells you to copy her notes and explain it at the end instead of going through the problem with you. She makes rude, sly comments throughout the lectures. The class is structured very poorly and there needs to be change.

The homework consists of overwhelming Excel worksheets and quizzes with only 3 attempts. I can fill out the worksheet but still get questions wrong on the quiz, learning nothing. Additionally, after-class quizzes only allow one attempt, and you can't see your score until the next day, preventing immediate feedback and clarity.

People writing reviews and given their opinions early in the semester of spring 25 are invalid. Professor Dellapine is an awesome professor with CPA licensing to back up her credentials. People saying the exams or quizzes don't match up to the material are wrong and are incompetent of understanding accounting is hard. Too challenging? Switch majors

all the other ratings seem like they're from the professor herself or bots trying to make her look good. She has a long way to go from being a great professor. 50% class avg on first quiz, poor preparation and guidance, rushed lectures, sits there and tries to justify a 50% avg, apologized more times to the class than any teacher ive seen. a mess.

The tests are difficult and dont match up anything on the recitations or homeworks. She purposfully underprepares students and sets them up for failure for the tests, then after the quizzes she goes over what we COULD'VE done after its already way too late.

Good professor. Explained things well in class. Recitation leads were solid, but Allison did a good job of ensuring they were not responsible for teaching course material, but were responsible with teaching the application of content. Well ran course. I'd highly recommend her as a professor.

This class is not easy by any means, however, if I wanted anyone to teach me these concepts it would be from Instructor Dellapelle. She is so knowledgeable and while the concepts can be challenging, she explains them in the best way possible. Her course pack is so organized and helpful. The exams are hard, but if you study you will do great !
Great prof gave every opportunity to succeed. Weekly HW but not too much

Her class is very well put together. The content of this class is naturally difficult but she does a great job at trying to explain things and breaking them down into smaller concepts. Lecture is mandatory with 5 drops. Homework is not bad and exams are ok, be sure to study off of the refined topic list she basically tells you all the questions.

Allison is an amazing professor. Always brings positive energy to class and is an all around great person. Accounting is not easy but she makes it bearable and is very passionate about what she teaches. As long as you come to class and do your homework, you will do fine in this class.

This class is a cakewalk if you show up. Brings in lots of industry speakers, and is very knowledgeable on the subject. Easy class for those who want to learn more about careers in accounting, and weekly quizzes are easy to do.

The class accounting 250-001 was extremely difficult, Mrs. Dellapelle made it very tough for me to pass the course. She did not seem to care about my well being in the class or helping me succeed in the class. I would not recommend this or any class with this professor, by far the worst experience I'v had. She should be excluded from her position.
She is a wonderful professor and as long as you attend lectures and complete the homework on your own, you will do fine in this course.

This class sucks. She goes wayyyy too fast when lecturing. The exam are 20 questions 50 mins so barely any time. They grade homework kinda hard as well. Also the homework is nothing like the exam so I don't understand why they give us it. Definitely a harder class as she does not dropped any exams as well.
She was amazing!!

I respect this professor, however I found her class very challenging.  The lectures were rushed and the exams were time demanding and different than the reviews.  I get it accounting is hard, but I was not able to learn the material well the way she taught the class. Hardest Broad class I have taken thus far.

Dellapelle was easily one of the best professors I have had at MSU, very knowledgeable and passionate about the content. Sometimes speeds through the lectures, but started recording them at the end. Exams are hard, definitely doable. One thing...even if you attend every recitation, to get 100% on recitation engagement you have to ask questions.
Such a good professor. The class is hard but the way she organizes it and goes through the course pack is great.

Allison was my favorite professor so far at MSU. She is super genuine and is clearly passionate about teaching. We took 3 midterm exams and 1 final which are curved. There is a mandatory course pack that she wrote herself that covers all the material for the course. Overall, the course was very organized and managed by a great professor.
Dellapelle was the best instructor I have had. She taught accounting extremely well, and the recitation leaders were amazing. If you focus during lectures and study well it is not bad.
Dellapelle teaches accounting very well, and she is a great professor. She also picked the best ULA's for recitation.
Professor Dellapelle clearly understands the material inside and out and is able to explain it in an engaging and effective manner.

Great professor, and makes an incredibly difficult class somewhat digestible. She truly wants her students to succeed and is incredibly nice. Lectures are fast but she does her best to break it down in an understanding way.

She is knowledgeable and passionate about accounting but speeds through lectures making them impossible to learn from. Exams are pretty challenging, had to learn the material all on my own. Homework assignments are nothing like what we learn in class or what is on the exams. Go to help rooms.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class if you just show up, would take again due to the class being pretty straight forward. I recommend ISS205 for your ISS credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, made class interesting each day and attendance was graded with iclicker. No exams as well, just needed to write 250 words each week which wasn't that bad

Amazing professor! She is very passionate about what she does and is so nice and caring. Very lecture heavy and graded by a few things. Lectures can get boring sometimes if you aren't that into economics but overall, amazing teacher. I want her to be my mom.

Professor Dickert-Conlin is super sweet and caring, and engages with the class/makes it fun even with 300+ students in a lecture. Only graded by a short reflection each week + attendance and no drops, which can feel intimidating, but if you go to every class and simply follow the rubric for reflections, this class was super fun and easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet professor who is passionate about what she does. At first, the class may seem hard, but it is much easier and fun. I would 100% take another class taught by her. She's very forgiving and treats all her students with respect and kindness.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had ISS 205 with her last semester. She was so sweet. It was obvious she takes her work seriously and loves what she does. Attendance was mandatory and she used iclicker.

She was very helpful to me due to being an out-of-state student she was respectful with me leaving early for Thanksgiving break. Another thing she is great at communicating quickly, I had a problem when I turned in the wrong assignment and she was able to fix it in one day.

*this review is for ISS 205, doesn't have that option for some reason*
class itself was easy enough. i am an ok writer so the weekly reflections were easy but no matter how good it is, if you miss ONE part of the rubric it's an automatic zero on the whole week, which was EXTREMELY frustrating.

This professor is a nice individual, but not a great teacher. Oftentimes I found that the exams, homework, and lecture notes did not correlate with each other so I was forced to reteach it to myself on my own. There was a lack of preparation when teaching and she is not great about answering emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a good professor and is highly knowledgeable in her skill set. There is a lot of homework with over 10 pages of homework due each week but if you stay up to date in lectures and go to her office hours she will provide a lot of help in the homework. The tests are structured just like the homework so don't expect easy exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She seems like a good person but is completely incompetent. What everyone says about the homeworks is true, she just seems very unorganized and unprepared to teach. Lectures do not relate to graded material and support is non-existent. Overall, a sporadic and irrational professor who I hope to never take again.

She gives out 11 pages of homework a week and only grades TWO problems from it. So you have to spend hours and hours doing tons of problems only to receive credit for two of them. Also, what is taught in class does not do a very good job of preparing you for the homework, so expect to have to learn on your own time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I've had at MSU. Cares deeply about her students and truly wants everyone to succeed. The class is a ton of work, especially the problem sets, but they are like this to prepare you for exams. To do well you have to do all the homework and her office hours are super helpful. Recommend her so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: To do well in this class you should 100% buy the coursework book, attend lectures, and go to office hours. If you do those her class is totally manageable. She really is passionate about the topics she's teaching and does a good job of making it engaging and personable. She's a great professor.

Grades only 2 random questions per HW assignment that take hours to complete. Expects students to learn in one way, participation of iClicker and lecture. Makes junior level concepts extraordinarily difficult and does not allow for students to learn simply. Kind person, awful teacher!

The lectures barely cover what's on the homework, and the homework is unnecessarily hard and long. She is willing to work with you and help you out, but be prepared to teach yourself or rely heavily on other resources for this class

Khan Academy does a much better job at explaining concepts in much less time. I have spent hours in her lectures, taking notes in the course pack, but I always find myself looking to Khan Academy to clarify. Exams are difficult and homework is too long and not helpful. You're looking at 10 pages of HW a week in this class. Terrible professor.

First and foremost, she is extremely incompetent. Problem sets are a weekly occurrence. The problem? They are excruciatingly long and 20-50% of the material is BARELY covered. In class she tends to focus on extremely basic versions of the problem sets, and glosses over the critically important concepts. Focuses too much on music and theatrics.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor who is passionate about what she teaches. Her course is a 300-level course, so don't expect it to be easy. There's a lot of work and the exams are long and pretty difficult, but the class is very rewarding. I got a 4.0, but I spent a lot of time on this course. Don't skip lectures and make sure to do all of your assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Highly engaging professor.   Takes a lot of time to come up with interesting examples for the material and very clearly demonstrates every skill she expects you to have.  Welcomes questions, and does a good job of personalizing a large class.

I strongly don't recommend u guys take her course. She offers lots of assignments and random pick some of them to be graded. The exams are quite difficult. No multiple choices question. All calculating, graph, words. Never give extra credits. She's such a grade killer.

Professor is often judgmental of those who may need extra help. Often is rude in their responses which are required to be via text messages that she does not respond to. Do not expect help from her outside of class with career advice despite a strong front that she claims she will help you.

I really enjoyed this class and getting to learn more about the sports journalism world. She's great at connecting her students with people in the sports media industry and she cares a lot about her students.

This professor was extremely unprofessional, you are only able to contact her via text and she shows very little respect for students with interests outside of sports. She makes grand claims of mentorship at the beginning of the semester that have fallen flat. She is judgemental and often arbitrary on how she grades stories. Take any other section.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor makes personal derogatory call outs to students appearances. Cares more about being friends with students than being a quality educator. At one point stormed out of class due to our "lack of engagement". Often lets class out early and complains about behind on material. Lets her personal bias effect what material she teaches/grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: LA is the best professor at MSU. I haven't met anyone who has something bad to say about her. Genuinely wants her students to succeed, and is willing to help them with achieving their dreams. Always brings snacks to class!

L.A. is probably one of the best professors I've had. It's clear that she cares for her students and genuinely wants everyone to do well. Work was always super manageable. Grading is super clear, just make sure to read the rubrics. I've taken 2 classes with her and hope to take more. She is so sweet and absolutely a prof to take a class with!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved LA. She is so kind and so willing to help students. She is an incredibly likable professor. And the grading is really straightforward.

Favorite professor at MSU. She is extremely kind and caring and willing to do pretty much anything in order to help students exceed. She's very engaging and I always enjoyed going to class. I definitely feel like my work deserved higher grades, but I don't think it was too bad.

If you do the bare minimum and show up to class you will get a 4.0 she grades pretty easy and you only have to write one 500 word paper every week and it's about sports. If you don't like sports or writing then this class probably isn't for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best professor at MSU. She cares about her students and is always willing to help them career wise. Gives lots of good feedback and advice. Would 100% recommend taking her courses
The best Professor at Michigan State University!! You will learn so much from her. Highly recommend. I have taken 2 classes with her and loved all of them.

L.A. is the nicest prof I have ever had. She was constantly checking in and asking how I was. she also still keeps in contact with me and truly cares about her students. this class can be very hard at times but she makes it seem so easy.

L.A. is awesome. She truly cares about her students and is invested in helping us succeed in our careers. The class isn't difficult and she gives clear guidelines for the assignments. Grades are a bit tough but you can make it work by rewriting your stories.

LA is the mom of J-school. She will ask you 50 times what you want to do with your life and tell you to follow your passion. The main grade is 3 big papers and it is really hard to get a 4.0, but you can do rewrites and the other things are easy to get a good grade on. LA would do anything for any of her students and she has the best stories. 10/10

LA was such an amazing professor. The class itself was probably the easiest class I will take in my college career, but LA made it entertaining. The only homework was writing a weekly paper to prep for class the next week. LA is such a caring professor and if you take the opportunity, she can be a great connection to have.

L.A. is almost too nice. She wants to help everyone get the job of their dreams. She is willing to help you if you talk to her. She's great for making connections with professionals. The class isn't all that difficult, but be prepared to turn things in multiple times. Taking a class with L.A. will almost guarantee you the chance to make new friends
For me it was probably 3+ hours a week for homework, and he even had assignments due Saturday night. Yes, it did really improve my Spanish I believe however it was a long semester with this class.

This class is taught by multiple professors and I imagine grading is roughly the same. He is passionate about teaching Spanish and you will really get to know the people in your class. He assigns more class work than you can get through in class on top of the homework that you must finish and will get frustrated at people for not working faster.

I am so happy to have met this professor. He is such a kind-hearted man and I wish everything well for him. He is inspiring and invested in his students and work. He grades very fairly. Take the time to get to know him, on top of your other professors. It is so worth it! Miss him already and he doesn't know it! (Go to class, though.)
Very friendly and understanding. Fast paced.
Great guy that makes you laugh every class. Writing tests are very vague and graded very lightly. Speaking assignments are very easy to follow and grades are very easy.

Professor Diaz-Munoz is a great guy, easy to access by email. I took this course with Spartan Early Start asynch so it's definitely a different experience than in-person. He let me turn in many things late with just an email. Problem is the course has so much work. Essays every week, discussion posts, long quizzes. Do not miss the discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I recommend avoiding this professor if you can. Multiple essays a week and discussions that might not ever be good enough for him. Very unorganized. Inconsistent due dates so it's difficult to keep up with. Assignments day-of is frowned upon and will reflect in your grade. As someone who works 45-50 hours a week, this class is nearly impossible
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Part(3/3)... These are barely complaints and more so exactly what the class required. I also did not receive a poor grade (3.5, so this is hardly complaining due to poor results) yet spent way more time than core classes. DO NOT take this class. If you need an IAH, even if you are a second semester senior, go somewhere else. You have been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Part (2/3)...but do not worry you can use your course pack which is two 400 (total 800) page books in which we cover maybe 1/4 of the material... it cost me $130 and is mandatory. Class is never out early, not a major set back, however the class ended at 8:50pm and multiple times we were dismissed past 9pm.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Diaz-Munoz is helpful, caring, and a great professor for Spanish.
Amazing professor! Super kind and caring. Very organized. Doesn't respond to emails fast, but if you have a question, just ask in person. He made it impossible to fail. 100% would take again.

This professor is nice, but he iss quite bad about responding to emails. The lectures are extremely long and hard to get through. The quizzes are more like long exams, so be prepared to study the course packs a ton. The course packs are required, and the structure of study is difficult to grasp. The final paper was rarely discussed.

As a professor, Diaz-Munoz isn't bad. However, this course was not designed properly and rarely covered what should have been addressed. Lectures are scattered and never stay on topic, ideas rarely related back to Cuba. You have to turn in materials via email before it's even due then turn in a hard copy, course pack is a must! No online materials

Take good notes and study the D2L files he posts and you'll get a 4.0. Great dude, always answering questions before and after class. I got covid during finals week and he let me take the final 5 days later on zoom. 10/10 professor if you're willing to do the work he ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very smart man, loves what he teaches, and is a nice guy. BUT his lectures are VERY confusing-he will write whatevers on his mind regardless of whether the class' following or not. Disgustingly horrible at lectures, and its like he's at the age of not caring anymore. You will have to self-study a lot. VERY lenient grading tho (he dont care)

This guy is insufferable -- so condescending if you don't understand content. And trust me, everybody in the class felt that way. Take a class with another professor if you want to spare yourself from horrible lectures and aggression and insults if you don't understand it.
He is extremely generous and clearly wants his students to succeed. Excellent professor. He is the reason why I enjoy math.

You have to suck up to get a good grade. If are in the Honors College, do her honors option (even though it's a bit more work than other projects I've done) just to introduce yourself. She uses AI more than is needed, and grading criteria is often unclear. Focus on neatness, read your textbook so you don't miss specific quiz questions, and DONTskip

Prof. Dilley is a nightmare. Don't take any of her classes if you have other options. She talks in circles. She's impossible to understand. Office hours were unhelpful. Participation was graded subjectively, & no free/excused absences without heavy documentation from school. She also made us do a huge group project on AI (in our PHONETICS class).

The exams are hard to study for and hard to complete with a time constraint. The worst part of this class is the second half of the semester. Exam 2, a huge term paper that is really confusing, and final exam. These determine a big portion of your grade. She is understanding and cares about what you have to say, but get ready to read and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst class I have taken at MSU. Super disorganized class, slow lectures, and quizzes on info we hadn't learned. Prof is obsessed with AI, despite teaching phonetics. Everything was constantly unclear, which was very frustrating. Our huge final project's info was given to us ~3 weeks before end of sem.. it was impossible. I'm so mad.

She is the worst professor I've ever had. Dilley always changed her grading expectations and deadlines, making it difficult to keep up with the class. She never properly taught the course material, then criticized students work in front of the class. The final group project for the class was the most insane assignment ever (master's level).

One of, if not the worst professor I have had MSU. 

Unclear on grading, and on the final project decided to revise the rubric two weeks into us already working on it and expects us to go back and redo it if already finished. Needs to focus less on QAnon Clout Chase articles and more on teaching.

She was constantly changing her deadlines and expectations last minute, so it's like playing catch-up the whole semester. It took more time to figure out what she actually wanted from us on the project than to do the actual project itself. In class when asking questions about it, her answers were always wishy-washy, so nobody ever fully understood.

Graded by attendance, quizzes, homework, a huge final project, and a final exam. Very unclear with requirements for assignments, would say things in class that weren't outlined in assignment and explanations were unclear. Took a long time to grade, final project is huge- a 12 page group paper, presentation, and an individual paper and 3 min video.

Her lectures were so long and she only got through two slides by the end of the hour and 50 mins. gives you a term project that is 50 pages plus long and barely explains anything. expects you to already know phoentics and the IPA, very tough grader as well as she grades on neatness.

This is the only prof for phonetics but this is a warning. This woman is off her rocker and and will not teach you anything. She is constantly off topic and yelling at 8 in the morning. The only good part was that the quizzes were online.  She will spring a huge project on you at the end of the year as well as an in person exam.

She makes you submit notes based off each chapter in the textbook (has to be 500+ words), there were so many homework questions. When I was taking an exam, I oftentimes ran out of time because there's so many questions to do in an hour. The term project was on AI and the instructions weren't really clear and it felt so pointless. Do not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible professor who had her TA teach more than her because most times she couldn't be bothered to show up to her own class. Her grading was highly subjective with very little standardization, her timelines changed every other day, and the syllabus was inaccurate by the second week with no updates. MSU CSD needs to rethink her as a prof.

This professor knows what she is talking about, but her grading is insanely tough for a 200 level class. The final project is on artificial intelligence, which has zero correlation to communication sciences and disorders. The guidelines are vague. All for 15 pts.
Grades super hard. Also has a huge group assignment at end of the semester that does not make any sense. The assignment takes forever and her rubric is very confusing and all over the place.

Attendance is mandatory even though she recorded every class. Would give assignments in class, and would give limited amount of time. Didn't respect the end time of the class, would often go over. Homework would be 45 questions long, 1 question requiring 5 written transcriptions of IPA. I cannot stress enough how much I dislike this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Attendance is 12% of your grade, you will need to turn on your camera for the Zoom meeting and answer her questions in the chat because she will keep track. The most difficult part of this course was the exams, she was very vague on certain topics and terms to focus on, so there is a lot of studying. However, I do like how the course is laid out.

Barely ever answers emails, if she does it's maybe once a week. Doesn't listen when the class says they're struggling and don't have enough time to complete an exam. Sent out a study guide the night before a morning exam. If you dont do well in a single exam good luck bringing up your grade because there are only 2 exams and the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Dilley is great! Her setup for the online course is easy to understand and flows well. She is very easy to reach through emails, which is very nice since this is an online course. Attendance is required for her webinars, but I always enjoyed them because of Prof. Dilley's pleasant personality
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Berlinsky is the most amazing music professor I have ever head. His artistry and musical experience influenced my musical development a lot. You should always be ready for a lesson because he will give you more information and things to work on to improve. On the top of the educational process, he cares about his students.
Professor Berlinsky is the best teacher I have ever had! He is very supportive and always available for his students when we need him!
Would not recommend. He's a good performer, but not very good at education.

Professor Berlinsky is an amazing violinist, incredible musician and gifted teacher. He completely transformed my understanding of the violin and the repertoire. After studying with him I realized my potential in music understanding and interpretation. I am very grateful for being his student for 8 years.
I wouldn't recommend anyone to this Professor.
doing the extra credit really helped me. also, after i had surgery, he invited me to come in for office hours and gave me extension on homework. he is a kind guy.
Very average professor, the lectures can be long and boring but it is stats class so. He does ok. He is very caring and does care about his class.

He has been my fav so far. His lectures are engaging and enthusiastic, he spends plenty of time on each topic, and he even sends out helpful emails each week. He goes the extra mile, even offering an outside-of-class study group before exams! I've never liked math, but he makes it more enjoyable.

Had for STT315 but couldn't select that option. Easy going professor. Very understanding if you show up to class. Pay attention and do the extra credit and you'll be fine. Practice exam questions every similar to actual exams so they're helpful.
Professor Dikong is a fantastic professor. Very straightforward, just go to the lecture and spend a decent amount of time preparing for exams, and you'll be good.
Very solid professor, you can always get help from him. Only problem I had was that my TA was not very helpful.

As long as you show up and do the extra credit you'll do good in this class. Helps you a lot with preparation for exams and truly wants the best for his students. Engaging lecture. Attend the recitations they actually help a lot.
Very good professor and always looks for the best in you. if you put in the time and effort to prepare for this course, you will be successful.

Prof. Dikong is amazing! He is very clear about due dates and assignments. This class has a substantial amount of homework, but completing it all really pays off on the exams. Going to class is a must because he tells you exactly how to succeed on the exams. He is a sweet guy and sends emails multiple times a week to keep everyone in the loop
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Dikong was wonderful. He does have an accent, but you get used to it. He started taking attendance through TopHat, which could be done from anywhere. Although being in class wasn't required, I highly recommend attending to succeed. The material is easy if you apply yourself. Homework and practice exams really help prepare for exams. Easy 4.0

This guy was great. I missed a homework assignment in the first week and came to his office hours. Not only was he very understanding but we ended up having a great conversation. The material can be difficult but doing the homework helps it makes sense. Attendance was taken with TopHat but after the first few months he stopped using it.

Great professor! There was (almost) weekly Top Hat and Webwork but it was never super difficult. He also posts the notes from class, so if you didn't grasp the concept in the lecture it is easy to reteach yourself.

I took STT 315 and I found the class somewhat difficult especially after the 1st test. He teaches decently well but he's not the most responsive when it comes to issues with grading. I would have preferred it not to be so dependent on McGraw hill as the questions are worded strangely and the grading is flawed. Besides that a good class though.

Great profesor. He explained things very clearly. Hard to catch up if you don't go to class because he doesn't post videos or anything. If you go to class, do the webwork, and do the practice exams it is easy to do good in the class. Lots of extra credit but you have to keep up with it and the hw. Overall great guy and he seemed very passionate.
AMAZING!
Great professor. Only thing I struggled with was his foreign accent, but after a few weeks I became familiar with it. You can tell he cares about the students success.

Prof. Dikong was amazing; very lecture-heavy, so be ready for that. Homework was once a week most weeks except for exam weeks. He is very fair, so you will most likely get the grade you have earned. Would definitely take again!

Professor Dikong tries to make his class sound hard but in reality, it is pretty easy. His lectures are easy to understand and he is pretty funny. Don't skip the lectures though or you will fall behind. Do all the extra credit before the webwork and that makes it much easier. And don't hesitate to go to his office hours if you are confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Some of the notes were hard to take becuase his slideshows didn't always line up with our packet. I skipped a lot of lectures and did fine but if you want to fully understand the content than you should go to class. He gave a homework assignment every week that was easy for the most part and an extra credit that went with it.
overall bad experience

Dikong is a pretty good teacher to have. He does tend to be very slow when lecturing, but his slides are amazing, and he gives a practice exam that looks identical to the test. He is pretty funny and as long as you go to class you will get an A.

Lectures are painfully slow and go over the easy topics and ignores the hard stuff on your own. the exams were also so out of pocket and way worse than any homework problem/lecture. dikong is funny in your senile grandpa sort of way but that's kind of it. if you have to take it make sure to go to recitation bc that's the only place where I learned

Dikongs lectures are unbearable, I ended up teaching myself. It seemed like he was teaching the simplest concepts but ignoring the complex ones found on the homework and exams. Maybe he would be alright if you really struggle with math (to the point that you dont understand mean) otherwise his pace is too slow and impossible to stay engaged with.

Great professor and great person but his accent is incredibly heavy. So much so that I still can only tell half of what he's saying at the end of the year. He's a good professor but there are definitely better ones out there.

Dikong is a pretty good professor, although I think that his slides are more helpful than the lecture. He's very nice, and clearly cares about his students. The course gets harder as you go on, but as long as you do the work - reasonable amount btw - you'll probably be okay.

STT200 is a difficult course. It is complex material and the course moves rather quickly. However, Dikong was extremely accommodating. At first, I was terrified to take this course, (its a requirement for my psychology major) but with Dikong's help, I passed with a 4.0. Be resourceful, ask for help, attend the lectures, and do the homework.

I didn't go to class a lot but if you are taking STT 200 it is an easy class if you attend your recitation and stay on top of the notes. From what I've heard he is a kind professor and I believe that! For HW, we used webwork and tophat and I struggled on some of the units and workload but going to my recitation helped a lot! Also uploads lectures.

I really enjoyed having Professor Dikong for STT 200. I thought he explained course concepts and expectations really well. His accent can be a tad hard to understand sometimes, but if you sit closer to the front and pay attention you'll be fine. He is really accessible outside of class and wants students to do well. Good for "math-hating" students.

Professor Dikong is my favorite professor ever. He is very caring and is great at explaining the material. He spends lots of time on subjects and doesn't rush through it like other math classes. Lectures are posted online and are very easy to understand. I don't like math and am bad at it but he makes it enjoyable and easy. Strongly recommend

Super genuinely nice guy. Really cares about his students and that is very evident throughout his class. If you pay attention and do notes you will have no problem passing the class. However, it is very easy to fall behind if you don't pay attention or skip.
Professor Dikong is amazing. He is so caring and understanding. Lectures are very clear and helpful for the work to be completed. Take stats with him.

-Prof Dikong uploads the lecture slides so if you miss a lecture you can look back to see what you missed
-Attendance is based on a weekend assignment
-Weekly webwork + extra credit
-Prof Dikong is very kind and cares about the students success
- No quizzes and 3 exams total
-The practice exam is usually what the actual exam looks like

An overall great professor and a very easy class. You can tell he really cares to make sure everyone understands the concepts. If you do the home work and attend lectures the material is not at all difficult. There are only 3 exams in total and the study guides and practice exams provided to study with are very comparable to the actual exams.

he is a really nice professor! there are many opportunities to bring up your grade (weekly webwork, tophat quizzes, extra credit) if you don't get your participation points in class. a lot of lectures but they aren't mandatory (recitation is tho so make sure you go). i probably spent an hour per week on homework. def would recommend this professor!

DiKong was fantastic! Showing up to lectures made you feel like he enjoyed teaching the material and was enthusiastic, and has great insight to explain concepts. Preparing for exam was also straight forward, DiKong released a practice exam that was comprehensive and very easy to study. Would definitely recommend this class anyone.
Good lectures and assessments align with the material we covered.

If you need to take a pre-req class, I can recommend him. A lot of lectures but they're only 50 mins each. Recitations are mandatory (don't miss them!) and u need a doctor's note to be excused. Otherwise, there is weekly webwork homework and a quiz that lets you catch up if u weren't in the lecture. I did hw once a week, can definitely recommend :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor! Sometimes hard to understand because of his accent, but if you sit closer to the front you will be fine. 1 homework assignment a week online. Attendance is not mandatory. Posts all lecture slides online and gives a practice exam and study guide before each exam that are extremely helpful!

I love this professor. He wants all his students to succeed and it is easy to ask him questions and get help. He has an accent but it is easy to understand him. Attendance isn't mandatory but the more you go the easier it is to understand the material. He does review sessions for exams and is always open to answering questions. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he makes stats easy to understand, as long as you attend lectures and do the work, you'll do great. you can tell that he wants his students to succeed. he creates study guides and practice exams that are similar to the actual exams that prepare you well. our section does better on exams than other sections because of him.

Prof Dikong is very nice and you can tell that he wants his students to succeed. He mentions quite often that our lecture hour consistently had the best exam scores. He uses TopHat sometimes in class but more often outside class.

Professor Dikong is an amazing teacher. You get used to the accent, it is not that difficult to understand. I feel like he gets a bad rap and I don't know why. He is so funny and really cares about his students and very willing to help you succeed. It does get harder as the course goes on but there are many resources.

He explains everything really well and has detailed slides to go with each lecture. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you don't attend the lectures then you'll definitely miss out on a lot of content.
Keep up weekly and youll do fine
